Hello, Adventurers!
Here are the changes included with the scheduled maintenance on:
November 10 at 2:00 AM PT (10:00 UTC) for players in the Amazon Game Studios service.
November 10 at 12:00 PM PT (20:00 UTC) for players in the NC Service.
*Maintenance schedules will be unified after the transition. See below.
Policies that previously differed between the NC and Amazon Game Studios services have been unified.: ■ \[All Services] Scheduled Server Maintenance

The scheduled server maintenance time has changed.: [table colwidth=",,"]: Category: Time: Previous: NC Service: Every Tuesday at 01:00 UTC: Amazon Game Studios Service: Every Thursday at 06:30 UTC: Updated: Unified Service: Every Wednesday at 05:30 UTC: ■ \[All Services] Content Reset Time Changes

The weekly reset day and time for various content have changed.: [table colwidth=",,"]: Category: Time: Previous: NC Service: Every Tuesday at 02:00 UTC: Amazon Game Studios Service: Every Thursday at 08:00 UTC: Updated: Unified Service: Every Wednesday at 06:00 UTC: ■ \[Former NC Service] Server Transfers

Server Transfers will be temporarily unavailable for the first few days following the update. Afterward, they will remain available at all times.: > A 720-hour (30-day) cooldown applies after each use of Change Servers.
Server Transfers can now be used to transfer between servers in different regions.: ■ \[Former NC Service] Character Creation
The maximum number of characters that can be created has increased to 6.: ■ \[All Services] First Launch
Initial setup options and the terms of service will appear the first time the game is launched.

Some existing settings will be reset and replaced with default values.: > Affected settings: Language, Control Mode, Sound, and Graphics Quality: > The default Language setting will be based on the platform or operating system language.: > Custom Graphics Quality settings will be reset and the recommended preset will be applied.: > These options can be configured during initial setup or changed later in the Settings menu.: ■ \[All Services] Duplicate Character Names

If a character was assigned a temporary name during service integration, the following features may be restricted until the character name is updated.: [table colwidth=","]: Category: Restricted Functions: Chat: Select and send Whispers, block and unblock Chat users: Group Chat: Invite players, search for characters, view invites, transfer room ownership, change permissions, remove players, mute and unmute Chat: Mail: Send Mail (recipient cannot be entered): Relationships: Send Friend Requests, add Interest and Feud targets, block players: Guild: Invite to Guild: Housing: Add players to the Visit Permission list: Arena: Invite opponents: War Games: Invite to Spectator Mode, remove players, accept invitations, join through invitation links: Character: View a profile card by character name: > Claim the Name Change Ticket delivered by Mail, then change the character's name from the Character Select screen to restore access to these features.: ■ Settings
\[All Services] The Privacy tab has been removed from Settings.
\[Former NC Service] The Game Access Voice Guide option has been added and is disabled by default.

\[Former NC Service] Additional in-game languages are now supported.: [table colwidth=","]: Display Language: Voice Language: Korean: English: Japanese: Traditional Chinese: French: German: Spanish: Brazilian Portuguese: Korean: English: Japanese
Character Boost Tickets can now be applied to an existing character without needing to create a new character.
The character will advance to Level 60 and receive equipment and combat settings for the selected weapon combination.
The updated specifications detailed below also apply when using previously acquired Character Boost Tickets.: ■ Character Boost Ticket Requirements

An existing character must meet all of the following requirements to use Character Boost Growth.: [table colwidth=","]: Category: Requirement: Character Level: Level 2-59: Adventure Codex Progress: A character that has not completed \[Part 3 Chapter 1: The Forbidden Tome of the Order > A Welcome Ally > Conversation with Benny]: ※ Characters that use a Character Boost Ticket on or after November 11, 2026 cannot use another Character Boost Ticket.: ■ Character Boosts on Existing Characters: (1) Select the character to receive Character Boost Growth from the \[Character Select] menu.

Open the Character Boost Growth menu and confirm that the correct character is selected.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/c5327354c4851062bef2430cb1812b6aef5a9acb.jpg"]: (2) Select the desired weapon combination.

Character Boost settings will be applied based on the selected weapon combination.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/68325dd59a1ebc6bdf39b436dc0281c279549b87.jpg"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/0f8ce515fdda35a16895dc4b606f4690f818df57.jpg"]: (3) Character Boost Growth begins after the weapon selection is confirmed.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/0cf221ed56e5f3979fdabf4fcad56a723fdd6eba.jpg"]: ■ Existing Items and Settings

All equipped items and items in your Inventory will be moved to Storage.: > Items will be moved to Storage even if this exceeds the Storage capacity.: > Once the storage limit is reached, you cannot store additional items until space becomes available.

Equipped Artifacts will be unequipped and moved to the Artifact Inventory.: > Artifacts will be moved to the Artifact Inventory even if this exceeds its capacity.: > Once the Artifact Inventory limit is reached, you cannot store additional items until space becomes available.
All Equipment Presets will be reset, and the Character Boost equipment will be applied to Equipment Preset 1.
The Weapon Mastery settings for the selected weapons will be applied to the first Weapon Mastery preset, replacing its existing settings.
Currency, tickets, and tokens provided through Character Boost will be added to the amounts already owned.: > However, Regional Contribution Certificates will only be added up to the maximum limit.

Incomplete Character Boost content, including Codex quests, Achievements, the Leveling Log, and Path of Ascension, will be marked complete.: > Previously completed entries will remain complete.: > Existing progress for content not included in Character Boost Growth will be retained.: ■ Character Boost Flow
After using a Character Boost Ticket, the character will begin in a new temporary zone instead of immediately arriving in Solisium.

The temporary zone teaches the basics of combat and movement, provides a brief recap of the story up to the point where the Character Boost places the character, and applies the recommended settings for the selected weapon combination.
The character can travel to Solisium after progressing through the tutorial in this temporary zone.
This applies to both new and existing characters.: The recommended Character Boost settings have been updated.: ■ Character Settings
Level: 60
Default Equipment: 2 selected weapons, armor, accessories, and Artifacts (approximately 9,000 Combat Power)
Recommended Settings: Weapon Mastery for the selected weapons (Level 200 each), Skill Specializations, Skill Set, Stats, and Runes
Runes (Attack/Defense/Support): Each Weapon and Accessory Rune is set to Level 100, each Armor Rune is set to Level 10
Includes a starter PvP Equipment Set and a Fishing Rod normally acquired through a completed Codex quest
Unlocks all field and dungeon Waypoints in Laslan, Stonegard, and Talandre
Grants the Spiritful Warrior outfit and Throne Pose.
Membership: Blessing of Solisium (28 days): ■ Content Progress
Adventure Codex: Progress through Part 3 Chapter 1: Prologue will be completed and all rewards will be set as claimed.
Leveling Log: Progress through Level 60 will be completed and all rewards will be set as claimed.

Path of Ascension: Beginner Missions will be completed through Stage 5 and all rewards will be set as claimed. Intermediate Missions will be completed through Stage 1 and all rewards will be set as claimed.
Morphs, Guardians, Amitoi, Titles, and Starry Memories available only through this content will be granted.
Achievements granted by completing the above content will be marked complete.
Platform Achievements and Trophies will not be completed automatically due to platform policies. A separate character must be created to complete them.: ■ Starting Currency and Items
Abyssal Contract Tokens: 20,000
Dimensional Contract Token I: 2,700
Dimensional Contract Token II: 5,400
Resistance Contract Rights: 10
Mystic Key: 1
Regional Contribution Certificates: 3
Contract Coins: 1,100
Weapon Mastery Conversion Books: 5
Skill Conversion Books: 24
Precious Ore Selection Chests: 100
Entropy Shard: Calanthia: 45
Adventure Coin: Fortitude: 26
Special Resistance Medal: 21
Other consumables, including World Tree Leaves, Stellarite, Mana Regen Potions, and Recovery Crystals: ■ Character Boost Tickets for New and Existing Accounts

All new and existing accounts will each receive 1 Character Boost Ticket once per account.: > The ticket can be used directly from the Character Selection Screen after the release of 4.20.0 without a separate claim process.: > New accounts created after the update will also receive 1 Character Boost Ticket when logging in.

The provided Character Boost Ticket can be used until further notice. Its availability may later change or reset through a separate announcement.: > Purchased Character Boost Tickets are not subject to this reset.
Skill Cores are now registered to the character and equipped in dedicated slots instead of being engraved directly onto equipment.
Skill Core Imprint and Extraction costs have been removed, allowing Skill Core configurations to be changed more freely.: ■ Skill Core Registration and Equipment Changes
Added a \[Skill Core] tab to the Skills menu.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/04c520a3fa9ed9044b7417fcab282391ffd73ee9.jpg"]

Skill Cores are now consumable items. Using one automatically registers it to that character's Skill Core list.: > Skill Cores are automatically used and registered when acquired. Tradable Skill Cores are not used automatically.: > Registering a Skill Core removes the item from your inventory and cannot be reversed. A warning denoting this is shown when using a Tradeable Skill Core from the Inventory.
Registered Skill Cores can be equipped, replaced, or removed with no cost or usage limit.
Skill Cores are assigned to equipment slots rather than individual equipment pieces, and their effects apply only while Heroic Equipment is equipped.

Equipped Skill Cores are retained even when equipment is changed. The effect applies when the equipped Heroic Equipment matches the Skill Core's required equipment type.: > A Skill Core can be configured without equipment or with a mismatched weapon type, but its effect will not apply until the requirements are met.
Equipping the same Skill Core in multiple slots does not apply the effect multiple times.
Skill Core Presets have been added which save Skill Core configurations and allow them to be switched immediately. Skill Core Presets can be set in the Combat Settings menu as well.
Skill Core icons now show the weapons that can use the Skill Core.: ■ Skill Core Imprint and Extraction Removed
Removed Skill Core Imprint and extraction from the Recombination Device.: > Stat Conversion remains available.

Dissolving equipment with a Weapon Skill, excluding Archboss weapons, now guarantees that the corresponding weapon’s Skill Core will also be granted.: > Dissolve costs remain unchanged.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/700222074dce3e85bc388fec522c0178a5dfa306.jpg"]: Existing Skill Core Conversion: ■ Engraved Skill Cores be Returned
Skill Cores engraved on existing Heroic Equipment will be removed and delivered by Mail.
Returned Skill Cores can be used from the Inventory to register them, allowing them to be equipped in dedicated slots.
Archboss Skill Cores will be processed according to \[Archboss Skill Cores and Weapons] details below.: ■ Duplicate Skill Cores Consolidated
The Black Anvil Skill Cores, previously separated by weapon type, have been consolidated into one Skill Core.: ■ Removal of Imprint and Extraction Scrolls
Removed the crafting recipe for Skill Core Extraction Scrolls.
Skill Core Imprint Scrolls can no longer be purchased from the Raid Supply Exchange Merchant.

Existing Skill Core Imprint Scrolls and Skill Core Extraction Scrolls will be removed. The following replacement items will be delivered via Mail.: [table colwidth=","]: Affected Item: Replacement per Item: Skill Core Imprint Scroll: 1,220,000 Sollant: Skill Core Extraction Scroll: 5 Precious Marind Ores / 5 Refining Catalysts / 2 Adventure Coins: Fortitude / 1,220,000 Sollant: ■ Archboss Skill Cores and Weapons

Added Archboss weapon acquisition Achievements that also grant the respective weapon's Skill Core when the weapon is acquired.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/8ec6351f6556c34f61dbfd92d95260ad622800ea.jpg"]: > The weapon's Skill Core is granted as an Achievement reward and is automatically consumed upon being claimed.

Characters that already own an Archboss weapon will have its acquisition Achievement marked complete and the Skill Core automatically registered.: > The Achievement reward will be marked as claimed and cannot be claimed again.
All Skill Core crafting recipes have been removed, except for Resin Flowers.

All existing Archboss Skill Cores will be removed and automatically registered, and their corresponding Archboss weapon will be delivered by Mail.: > This also applies to characters receiving weapons through Skill Core conversion.: ■ Raid Exploration Codex Reward Changes

Due to the removal of Skill Core Imprint Scrolls, the final reward for the Raid Exploration Codex has been changed.: [table colwidth=",,"]: Category: Previous: Updated: Altar of Calanthia: 1 Skill Core Imprint Scroll: 1 Entropy Shard: Calanthia: Altar of Calanthia: Nightmare: 5 Skill Core Imprint Scrolls: 3 Entropy Shards: Calanthia

Guild Alliances have been removed.: > Removed all Guild Alliance information from the Guild UI.: > Removed the Set A effect that increased resource production for an occupation stone when an Allied Guild owned its paired stone.: > Removed the Allied Guild Chat and Alliance notifications.: > Removed Friendly Guild settings from Astral Vision.
Existing Alliances and pending Alliance requests will be removed.

notes.title: New Skill Cores and Skill Core Availability

items.text: Added 30 new Skill Cores.
Added additional Skill Core acquisition sources and increased their drop rates.: ■ New Armor and Accessory Skill Cores

Added 3 Armor and Accessory Skill Cores for each weapon, for a total of 30.: [table colwidth=","]: Weapon: New Skill Cores: Greatsword: Earth Shatter, Earth Explosion, Great Earthquake: Sword: Obsessive Barrier, Willpower Barrier, Resolute Barrier: Daggers: Bloodlust Boost, Assassin Arts, Divine Assassin Arts: Crossbows: Lightning Expansion, Piercing Mark, Barrage Mark: Longbow: Stealthy Breathing, Hyper Focus, Drawn Bowstring: Staff: Focused Fire Shot, Heavy Fire Bombs, Colossal Fire Bomb: Wand: Angel's Blessing, Demonic Contract, Spiritual Calling: Spear: Celestial Cleave, Annihilating Slash, Divine Guillotine: Orb: Rift Fracture, Void Fracture, Erosion Rift: Gauntlets: Bloodthirsty Claws, Laceration Boost, Exploit Weakness

The new Skill Cores can be acquired from the following sources.: > Resin Flowers: > Field Boss and Archboss participation rewards and defeat rewards: > Rift Treasure Chests, Tumgir Hollow, Open-world PvP rewards, Elite and Epic Co-op Dungeons, and Tower of Greed
New Skill Cores will not be available from Resin Flowers or participation reward chests acquired before the update.: ■ Increased Skill Core Drop Rates and Acquisition Sources
Increased Skill Core acquisition rates from Resin Flowers, Rubrix Resin Flowers, and Marind Resin Flowers.
Added Skill Cores to Tower of Greed rewards.

Added a \[Stalon Resin Flower] recipe that can be crafted once per month granting a guaranteed Skill Core of your choice.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/9c2d82b804cd6c5bb412a75b84641466df5cbe9f.jpg"]: > Any Skill Core can be selected from the Stalon Resin Flower regardless of tier.: > This can be crafted once per month per account, and the crafted Skill Core cannot be traded.: > Crafted Skill Cores can also be dissolved, and the number of Resin Cores granted is unchanged.
150 Resin Cores can be obtained from the Shop for 100 Sollant for a limited time, available once per account.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/ec40739286eb2fb3886797da5a5e5fbf83a9fd8f.jpg"]
Condensed Tower of Greed areas into 5-floor structures and updated the tower-exclusive Augment system and rewards.
New regular seasons will begin for Tower of Greed, Dimensional Trials, Gate of Infinity, Battlegrounds, and Hall of Illusion.
Added Activity Points to content that previously did not grant them and adjusted the points granted by each activity.: ■ Tower of Greed
A new season begins on Wednesday, November 11.

The Tower of Greed structure has changed as follows.: [table colwidth=",,"]: Area: Previous Floors: Updated Floors: Awakening: 5 Floors: 5 Floors: Dawn: 10 Floors: 5 Floors: Dusk: 15 Floors: Removed: Twilight: 10 Floors: 5 Floors: Abyss: 10 Floors: 5 Floors
The Orb of Greed’s engraving stages and the total amount required for each stage have been adjusted.

Tower of Greed rewards have been adjusted.: > Added Resin Flowers.: > Increased the amounts of Precious Marind Ore and Weapon Mastery XP granted.: > Removed Noble Polished Crystals, Rare Artifact Selection Chests, Accessory of Greed Selection Chests, Armor of Greed Selection Chests, Precious Recovery Crystals, and Conversion Stones.

Augment effects can now be acquired while progressing through the tower.: > Augments are active only within Tower of Greed. They are removed when leaving the tower and reapplied upon re-entry.: > Augments can be acquired from a Ring of Augmentation that appears after clearing the first section of each floor, excluding Abyss.: > Standard Augments can be acquired repeatedly to strengthen their effects. If an acquired Augment is already at its maximum level, the Ring of Augmentation options can be refreshed or the selection can be skipped.: > Selecting a Chaos Augmenter grants a random Weapon Augment for an equipped weapon. Previously acquired Weapon Augments will not be granted again. If all available Weapon Augments are owned, the options can be refreshed or the selection can be skipped.: > All acquired Augments are reset upon entering Awakening Floor 1.

The objectives for the Tower of Greed Extra Codex Quest have changed.: > In Codex > Extra > Tower of Greed > The Real Investigation Begins, the objectives Clear Awakening Floor 2, Clear Awakening Floor 4, and Obtain the Additional Reward on Awakening Floor 5 have been changed to Clear Dawn Floor 1, Clear Twilight Floor 1, and Obtain an Additional Reward in the Tower of Greed, respectively.: ■ New Content Seasons
New schedules for Dimensional Trials, Gate of Infinity, Battlegrounds, and Hall of Illusion begin on Wednesday, November 11.: ■ Lithograph Book
Added 120 Nix Season 2 entries to the Lithograph Book.
Complete Lithograph Book entries to obtain Trait and Resonance materials, various Gems, and Resin Flowers.
The Season 2 Lithograph Book will be available through February 3, 2027.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/7731c41657b3e3352f0f7fca673054d8757a8dac.jpg"]: ■ Path of Ascension
Increased rewards from the Beginner Missions and Intermediate Missions stages.: > The granted Equipment Set gear and their Item Levels have changed.

Changed some missions in Intermediate Missions Stage 2.: [table colwidth="70,220,450"]: OrderPrevious MissionUpdated Mission: 8thPurchase any item from a Sundries Merchant at all bases.Complete the Adventure Codex Part 1, Act 8 appendix missions: "Appendix ▶ How to Hone Your Equipment," "Appendix ▶ How to Unlock Equipment Traits," and "Appendix ▶ How to Enhance Equipment Traits.": 9thPurchase any item from a Guild Merchant at all bases.Complete the Adventure Codex Part 1, Act 9 appendix missions: "Appendix ▶ Steps toward Greater Power" and "Appendix ▶ How to Inherit Equipment."
Characters that have already completed Path of Ascension can receive the same equipment by using the free Character Boost Ticket.: ■ Activity Points

Adjusted Activity Points for the following content.: [table colwidth=",,,"]: Content: Previous: Updated: Notes: Dimensional Trials – Cumulative Point Rewards: 0: 40: Co-op Dungeon: 50: 45: Raids: 50: 70: Hall of Illusion: 50: 180: Gate of Infinity: 0: 90: Guild Contract: 1 point per contribution unit: Maximum 100 points: 50 points per contribution unit: Maximum 150 points: Cannot exceed the maximum points granted: Mystic Globe: 10: 15: Mystic Portal: 25: 30: Tumgir Hollow: 0: 80: Nix Field Event: 0: 10: Rift Rebellion and Artifact Fishing: 0: 40
Fixed an issue where previously granted Activity Points were not displayed.
■ Hit Chance Benefits
[table colwidth=""]
\[Dev Comment]
The benefit of investing in a high Hit Chance stat was relatively low compared with other stats, so effects have been added to selected weapons.
Added effects to Longbow and Orb weapons that provide benefits based on Hit.: ■ Daggers
Fatal Stigma Skill Core: \: > When Fatal Stigma deals damage to a player target at or below 10% Health, the effect now executes the target instead of dealing additional damage.
Venomous Edge Skill Cores: \[Creeping Death] and \[Venomous Swamp]: > Fixed an issue where “Miss” appeared when a poison cloud was not created.: ■ Longbow

\[Devoted Shield]: > At Heroic Lv. 5, reduced base Shield Health from 6,500 to 5,500 and added 120 Shield Health for every 100 Ranged Hit Chance.: > Fixed an issue where Buff Duration did not apply to the Damage Reduction effect.
Weapon Mastery Advanced Tactics Achievement Effect \[Battle Tempo]: > At Heroic Lv. 5, added 1.5 Maximum Damage for every 100 Ranged Hit Chance when Rapidfire Stance is activated.

\[Begin the Hunt]: > At Heroic Lv. 5, attacking an enemy with Deadly Marker, Brutal Arrow, or Flash Arrow now also increases Hit by 120 for party members within 16m for 3 seconds, or by 300 when alone.
Nature's Blessing Specialization 4 \[Concentration Stance]: > Increased the duration from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.: ■ Crossbows
\[Mortal Mark]: > Fixed an issue where the debuff effect appeared even when the target successfully defended with a Defense Skill.: ■ Staff

Weapon Mastery Rare Tactics Achievement Effect \[Heat Fusion]: > Clarified that \[Detonator Bombardment] immediately deals 18% of all remaining Ignition damage over time and removes all Ignition stacks, rather than applying the effect for each lightning spear.
Chain Lightning Specialization 1 \[Chaining Bolt]: > Fixed an issue where enhancement details were not displayed in the Skill Enhancement window.
\[High Focus] and High Focus Specialization 2 \[Max Damage Increase]: > Updated the enhanced buff effect to appear when Specialization 2 is applied.

Skill Core: \[Thunder's Shadow]: > Updated the \[Thunder's Shadow] Skill description for clarity.: >> Skill Core Description: Clarified that Thunder's Shadow itself cannot be evaded or cleansed.: >> Skill Effect Description: Clarified that Thunder's Shadow is applied to an enemy target and cannot be evaded or cleansed.

Skill Core: \[Lightning Condensation]: > Fixed an issue where the effect dealt damage one additional time.: > Fixed an issue where Damage Boost per Weaken: Thundercloud stack was lower than intended and adjusted the value to 20%.: ■ Wand
\[Blessed Barrier]: > Fixed an issue where the effect duration modified by the caster's Buff Duration did not apply to party members.: ■ Orb
\[Rift Fracture]: > At Heroic Lv. 5, added 8 Weaken Chance for every 100 Magic Hit Chance while Rift Fracture is active.

Distortion Veil Specialization 1 \[Amplification Veil]: > At Heroic Lv. 5, reduced Base Damage Amplification while the Shield is active from 15% to 13%. For every 100 Magic Hit Chance, added 1.2% Shield Health and an additional 0.2% Base Damage Amplification.: ■ Items
Last Dragon's Thunder Greatsword \[Dragon's Counterattack]: > Increased counterattack damage from 75% to 160% of Base Damage and added a limit of 5 counterattack damage activations per second.
Giant Cordy's Snowsoul Crossbows \[Ruthless Giant Cordy's Bog]: > Fixed an issue where Ruthless Giant Cordy's Bog did not activate when a Longbow Skill triggered an explosion at 25 Gale stacks.

Last Dragon's Thunder Daggers \[Atirat's Claw]: > Fixed an issue where damage based on a player target's maximum Health could deal excessive damage to targets transformed into Titan Cargo during Tax Delivery content.
Coldblooded Commander Pursuit Crossbows \[Blessing Steal]: > Fixed an issue where the effect of Longbow Skill Healing Touch Specialization 4 \[Concentration Stance] could not be removed.
Devotion of Justice Wand \[Redemptive Barrier]: > Fixed an issue where the weapon effect also affected Corrupted Magic Circle.
View all in-game matchmaking content together and apply for up to 3 queues at the same time.
Select a Combat Settings preset when applying for matchmaking. The selected preset will be applied automatically upon entry.

The matchmaking penalty for declining a match has changed to support simultaneous matchmaking.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/11494db9fa722101c9a187228fe58370f9fa7050.jpg"]: ■ Integrated Matchmaking

The Party Matchmaking menu has been changed to Integrated Matchmaking.: > Battleground and Remnants of Nix matchmaking are displayed alongside existing matchmaking content. Future matchmaking content will also be added to the Integrated Matchmaking menu.

Up to 3 queues can run simultaneously.: > Matched content appears in the HUD party management area. Hover over it to view progress in a tooltip.: > A completed match can be accepted or declined. The player enters the first matched activity accepted by all matched players.

Integrated Matchmaking requires selecting the Combat Settings preset to use after entry in addition to the existing role selection.: [table colwidth=","]: When Role Selection Is Available: When Role Selection Is Unavailable: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/2964822993fb7ec38d8538c3ede334302749f419.jpg"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/e0b2390f5b52c5f35f1d84eac491a7032d964725.jpg"]: > Role and minimum Combat Power requirements are evaluated using the selected Combat Settings preset when applying for matchmaking.: > Upon entering matched content, Combat Settings automatically change to the preset selected in the application.

Repeatedly declining matchmaking popups will apply a matchmaking penalty.: > The matchmaking penalty for declining a match has changed because multiple matchmaking searches can now run simultaneously.: > Declining during the accept or decline stage increases the consecutive match decline count.: > A matchmaking penalty applies after 3 consecutive declines.: > The consecutive decline count resets automatically after playing content entered through matchmaking.: > However, allowing the full acceptance timer to expire and automatically declining applies the matchmaking penalty immediately.: ■ Related Changes
If Combat Setting preset 1 has 0 Combat Power, the current Combat Settings will now be applied automatically to Combat Settings 1.
Character names are no longer displayed when hovering over matchmaking progress.
Changed how Guild-type Boss Event applications work.
Changed how Voice Chat is used.
Added a UI display option that makes interactable targets easier to view.: ■ Guild Boss Event Applications

Changed Guild-type Boss event applications so that an application submitted by an authorized Guild member appears as a participation notification for all Guild members.: > When a Guild Leader, Advisor, or Guardian applies, the application appears in the notification area for all Guild members.: > Guild members can apply or cancel through the participation button in the notification.: ■ Interaction

Added an option to keep the interaction UI fixed on the screen when interacting with a target.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/764e12e97510fcb562e1630d4207a2a8bf90244b.jpg"]: > Select Screen under \[Settings > Gameplay > UI > Interactable Target Display Method].: > When Screen is selected, the interaction UI position can also be adjusted.: > Cooperative interactions are displayed on the target regardless of the selected display method.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/8c1d93e34242a72631f8f85aa047ed4f3c874c25.jpg"]: ■ PC Voice Chat

Enable \[Settings > Voice Chat > Voice Chat Activation] to use in-game Voice Chat.: > When the game is launched through PURPLE, it connects to in-game Voice Chat instead of PURPLE Talk.: > When the game is launched through Steam, the existing Voice Chat method changes and proximity-based Voice Chat is unavailable.
Channel-based Voice Chat is supported.: > Party, Guild, and Team (Dominion) Voice Chat channels are supported.: > Group Voice Chat is unavailable.
Removed the Voice-to-Text feature that displayed spoken Voice Chat as text and its related options.: ■ Joining and Leaving Voice Chat
Select an available channel under \[Chat Menu > Voice Chat].: > Players do not join automatically when a channel becomes available after joining a Party or Guild or entering a Dominion event.

Icons in the Chat menu show Voice Chat availability, microphone status, and the current channel.: > Voice Chat Channel Availability: [table colwidth=","]: Inactive: Active: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/c5118c607dfd81524a707e051d02927b1f552986.png"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/1155d9d05531745d742ed67eeb75cf2596fdd56d.png"]: > Current Channel and Microphone Status: [table colwidth=",,,"]: Party: Guild: Team: Microphone Off: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/d7f27f16e760538542326eca8fe518b821a59083.png"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/f763139ed63adb8d7eb3c1f6437acbf104cecd19.png"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/5e8557093955b83c1ab1e38d35c84ceab23f7353.png"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/eea10993f3d11d6a8cdcd2fa97953f40bdd872e8.png"]
Only one Voice Chat channel can be joined at a time.
Select \[Leave Voice Chat] while in a Voice Chat channel to leave the conversation.

Microphone status appears in the HUD and Nameplate while participating in Voice Chat.: > The status may not appear on your own Nameplate depending on Nameplate settings.: [table colwidth=",,"]: Voice Input Active: Microphone Disconnected: HUD: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/ebbac56c540c68fd02e5eda345d08dbcbede2b84.jpg"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/58c91f8519fb3528648e5022a8f41b7df58dbd6a.jpg"]: Nameplate: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/913582e7aa91ff38ea1761e16287e483f9c232ea.jpg"]: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/7b49217c2ece04277bc48d00059651fc140ab399.jpg"]: ■ Voice Input and Settings
Configure Voice Input Mode, Microphone Sensitivity, and Voice Volume under \[Settings > Sound > Voice Chat].

Select one of the following Voice Input Modes.: > Always On: Transmits microphone input continuously.: > Toggle: Press the assigned Voice Input key to turn voice transmission on or off.: > Hold: Transmits voice while the assigned Voice Input key is held.
Configure the Voice Input key under \[Settings > Shortcuts > Character].: > A shortcut must be assigned to use Toggle or Hold Voice Input.: ■ Console Voice Chat

In-game Voice Chat will be temporarily unavailable on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.: > Related Voice Chat menus, settings, and Help entries will no longer appear.: > Removed Voice Chat from the Ring Menu.
The fourth item on Page 1 of the default Ring Menu has been changed to \[Party Ready Check].: ■ Crafting

Locked crafting materials are now identified by an icon.: > Crafting cannot proceed while a required material is locked. Unlock the material before crafting.: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/da8ebfa641c03489a558c672a015d1f72fcc71b0.jpg"]: ■ Emoticons and Emotes
Emoticons and Emotes can now be assigned to Quick Slots.
■ Nix
Reduced how often the Ice Eye Sentry Elite uses its movement Skill.
Ice Eye Sentry now uses its movement Skill to return to its starting position after moving a certain distance away.: ■ Entropic Tundra
Changed Sailor Sorrel's attack that inflicts Stun in Remnants of Nix to a Fury Attack.
Removed the chance for the Arsenal Ruffian and Powder Keg Rascal's charge attacks to inflict Prone.: ■ Remnants of Nix

Throne and Liberty update 4.15.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on October 7 and last approximately 3 hours.
Added Lucky Reward Chests.
Increased Trait Resonance growth success rates and added a recipe for crafting Trait Resonance Stones directly.
Unique Heroic Trait Enchantment Stones previously dropped by Vegamor will now be obtained from Lucky Reward Chests.
Lucky Reward Chests are granted by chance to all characters who contributed to the encounter.
Lucky Reward Chests are excluded from Guild Distribution.
Certain Amitoi, Shapeshifts, and materials dropped by bosses can now be registered for Guild Distribution.
Eligible items include 11 Amitoi, 11 Shapeshifts, Chaos Prisms, and Snow Flowers.
Increased the success rate of Trait Resonance enhancement rolls.
Added a recipe for crafting Trait Resonance Stones using 6 Trait Resonance Stone Pieces, 25 Precious Magic Powder, and 30,000 Sollant.
Adjusted weapon Skill and Potential Ability effects and fixed related issues.
Potential Ability \[Chain Hook Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 6 seconds to 4 seconds.
Potential Ability \[Ankle Strike Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 9 seconds to 5 seconds.
Shadow Walker: Changed the activation condition to require a Dagger Mobility Skill or a Dagger Skill that moves the caster.

Skill Core: Creeping Death: Increased the Venomous Edge activation chance from 10% to 12%. The resulting 1.5m poison cloud follows the target for 3 seconds, deals 140% of Base Damage + 100 each second, gains 3% Damage Amplification per Poison stack, and deals 15% increased damage.

Skill Core: Venomous Swamp: Venomous Edge can also activate on melee Critical Hits. Reduced the poison-cloud activation chance from 10% to 5%, or 12% while Creeping Death is equipped. Reduced the monster damage increase for Venomous Edge and the poison cloud from 80% to 15%.

Skill Core: Foretold Agony: Venomous Edge now has a 12% chance to activate on melee hits, or 20% while Creeping Death is equipped. Applying Collision: Prone or Bind to a player activates Venomous Edge once at a 100% rate. With Creeping Death or Venomous Swamp equipped, each activation summons a poison cloud that deals fixed damage. Venomous Edge and poison-cloud damage ignore player Shield Health and are applied as fixed damage, and cannot trigger Heavy Attacks or Critical Hits.
Mortal Mark: Fixed an issue where additional damage from accumulated damage exceeded the intended value at Legendary Lv. 1 and above.

Potential Ability \[Deadly Marker Enchant]: Changed the affected target from the caster to party members. Critical Hit decreased from 240 to 120 and Side and Rear Critical Hit decreased from 360 to 180.

Potential Ability \[Distorted Sanctuary Enchant]: Increased Skill Sustained Healing per party member from 2.5% to 3%. Clarified that Attack Range is amplified by 100% of its existing value per party member.
Distorted Sanctuary: With Specialization \[Combat Sanctuary], increased Attack Range per party member from 0.75% to 1.1% at Legendary Lv. 5.
Potential Ability \[Blitz Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
Potential Ability \[Clay's Salvation Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 9 seconds to 6 seconds.
Potential Ability \[Selfless Soul Enchant]: Fixed an issue where the effect applied correctly but the displayed value indicated that it was not applied.
Potential Ability \[Tempest Strike Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 10 seconds to 8 seconds.
Potential Ability \[Supernova Collapse Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 30 seconds to 20 seconds.
Advanced Tactics \[Flesh Rupture]: Fixed an issue preventing Shapeshift use when Flesh Rupture hit.
Potential Ability \[Indomitable Carapace Enchant]: Reduced the cooldown reduction from 25% to 15%.
Skill Core: Crimson Imprint: Clarified that Blood Explosion deals 40% less damage as fixed damage over 3 seconds on hit, stacks up to 3 times, and cannot trigger Heavy Attacks.
Fixed an issue preventing defense when a Defense Skill was used.
Fixed an issue where Specialization 2 \[Additional Effect] and Specialization 3 \[Shield Weakening] did not apply.
Fixed an issue where Damage Amplification per Bleed stack did not apply.

Skill Core: Crimson Afterimage: Blood Explosion damage increased by 10%. At Heroic Lv. 5, deals 720% of Base Damage + 85 to targets within twice Attack Range, gains 8% Damage Amplification per Bleed stack, and deals 80% increased damage to monsters. Removed the separate 10% player damage increase.
Fixed issues where Crimson Imprint caused Blood Explosion to remove Bleed or prevented Damage Amplification per Bleed stack from applying.
Scale Lord's Massacre Sword \[Wall of Bitter Cold]: Corrected the description to state that the effect applies for its duration.
Black Lament Dawn Set (2-piece): Increased Critical Hit Damage from 15% to 17% and PvP Melee Critical Hit per 10 Fortitude from 30 to 36.
Ashen Oath Brand Set (2-piece): Increased Critical Hit Damage from 15% to 17% and PvP Ranged Critical Hit per 10 Dexterity from 30 to 36.
Returned Lord Set (2-piece): Increased Heavy Attack Damage from 20% to 22%.
Frost Lord Black Scale Set (2-piece): Increased Heavy Attack Damage from 20% to 22%.
Azure Vow Set (2-piece): Fixed an issue where removing the equipment through Equipment and Stat Sets did not remove the Skill Damage Amplification effect.
Ascended Leviathan's Gauntlets \[Enraged Leviathan's Incineration]: Fixed an issue preventing defense when a Defense Skill was used.
Thunder Ascension: Fixed an issue where the equipment appearance was displayed as Cloak of the Frozen Expanse.

Changed the calculation for Critical Hit Damage, Critical Hit Damage Resistance, Heavy Attack Damage, and Heavy Attack Damage Resistance so decreasing a stat removes only the amount previously gained.
The current Tower of Greed season has ended and will be unavailable until the next season begins.
Tower of Greed is no longer available through matchmaking.
The Tower of Greed Extra Codex cannot be completed until the new season begins.
Fixed an intermittent issue in Phase 2 where operating the ice-pillar piton moved players to an inaccessible location.
Fixed an intermittent issue in Phase 2 where Snowstorm Crystals spawned beneath terrain.
An Ego-less Great Tree Warrior now appears during Phase 3.
Fixed an issue preventing the revival UI from appearing after death during Faction Battles.
Fixed an intermittent issue preventing players from rescuing an ally from Mana Prison by jumping nearby.
Fixed an issue where Conquest Participation Rewards incorrectly granted Grimturg rewards.
Stone Grave Cradle: Fixed an issue preventing players from attacking the boss after leaving and re-entering the dungeon.
Deathless Queen's Lair: Fixed an issue where the Mana Core Bind effect remained after defeating the boss.
Tumgir Hollow: Fixed an issue where monsters near the pipes were visible but could not be attacked.
Ice Survival: Fixed an issue where Coin Pouches on certain floors granted 2 points.
Earth's Memory: Fixed an issue where Old Red Frost was included in the additional reward pool.
Danger and High-Risk areas are now selected randomly from all 7 areas without using the previous candidate-area groups.
Certain areas of the Tumgir Ruins are excluded from Danger and High-Risk areas, and monster difficulty in the excluded locations has been adjusted.
Player-selected Profile Frames are now displayed in Combined Rankings.
Abyss Points granted through Nix Contracts are now provided as items that are used automatically when obtained.
Fixed duplicate Star Crystal quantities displayed on the Point Shop Claim Additional Rewards button.
Fixed an issue where Purification items could not remove Winter Storm Wand \[Dragon's Intimidation].
Fixed an issue where the use effect was not displayed in the Erosion Remedy cooking recipe.
Fixed an issue where dye was not applied to Noble Shoes of the Resistance on male characters.
Changed the icon and appearance of the Thunder Ascension cloak.
Fixed an issue where certain areas displayed with unintended shapes.
Fixed an issue where obtaining a Coin Pouch did not progress the achievement Capitalism Colder Than Ice I.
Removed expired Refined Catalyst recipes that use Extraction Stones as materials.

items.text: Throne and Liberty update 4.13.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on September 23 and last approximately 3 hours.
Added the new Colossus Vegamor and 10 Eye of Chaos Weapon crafting recipes that upgrade Heroic Weapons to a higher tier.
Peace and Guild events featuring Vegamor will be held each Tuesday.
Added Peace and Guild events featuring Vegamor.
Peace and Guild events alternate each Tuesday at 7:00 p.m. and 10:00 p.m. local server time.
Added 10 Eye of Chaos Weapon crafting recipes that upgrade Heroic Weapons.
Eye of Chaos Weapons can be crafted using a Heroic Weapon, 60 Otherworldly Mind's Eyes obtained from Vegamor, and materials.
The material equipment's Traits, Resonance, and random stats transfer to the crafted equipment. Players can choose whether to transfer its Potential Ability.
Fixed a variety of Skill Core effects and incorrect descriptions.
Adjusted the balance of equipment effects and stats.
Skill Core: Gravity: When Gravity applies Collision: Pull to a player, the same Collision effect cannot be applied to that target again for 3 seconds.
Potential Ability \[Willbreaker Enchant]: Added information around the Defense Reduction applied in the Debuff tooltip.
Skill Core: Venomous Swamp: Corrected an incorrect radius in the Skill Core description from 6m to 3m.
Skill Core: Creeping Death: Corrected an incorrect radius in the Skill Core description from 3m to 1.5m.

Elemental Awakening: Fixed an issue where Elemental Awakening's remaining cooldown reduction did not apply to Inner Peace Specialization 1 \[Thunder's Blessing] or the related Skill Cores Thunder's Shadow, Thunderclouds Explosion, and Lightning Condensation.
Skill Core: Nightmare Concerto: Fixed an issue where the effect could apply more than once if multiple attacks hit a target at the same time Sleep was removed.
Skill Core: Nightmare Conductor: Fixed an issue where the screen-darkening effect did not apply correctly when Graphics Quality was set to Low.
Skill Core: Wave of Punishment: Corrected an incorrect radius in the Skill Core description from 5m to 2.5m.
Skill Core: Purifying Star: When 2 or more Purifying Stars are applied to the same player, their purification effects no longer apply multiple times.

Skill Core: Crimson Imprint: Blood Explosion now deals 40% less damage and applies the damage as fixed damage on hit. The fixed damage effect lasts 3 seconds, stacks up to 3 times, and cannot trigger Heavy Attacks.

Scale Lord's Massacre Sword \[Wall of Bitter Cold]: The effect now deals 150% of Base Damage when the affected target is attacked by an enemy within a 15m radius. Previously, the trigger distance was 1.3 times Attack Range, or 4.3 times Attack Range for Ranged and Magic attacks.
Last Dragon's Thunder Daggers: Corrected the Weapon Skill description from all damage dealt to players to all damage dealt to players with Mad Sword Dance.
Reverse Scale Tracker's Judgment Crossbows \[Atirat's Flame]: The Skill visual is now always displayed, regardless of the player's Effect Display Range setting.
Storm Lord's Judgment Spear: Added missing information to the Weapon Skill description.
Deluzhnoa's Serrated Shard: Adjusted Base Damage from 138~361 to 172~327.
Deluzhnoa's Chilling Spear of Frost: Adjusted Base Damage from 163~428 to 204~387.
Deluzhnoa's Snowsoul Spear: Adjusted Base Damage from 180~473 to 221~432.

Ascended Leviathan's Gauntlets \[Enraged Leviathan's Incineration]: When Evaporation is used, targets within the area are now afflicted every 0.5 seconds with a 1-second fixed damage-over-time effect that deals 50% of Base Damage + 120 and stacks up to 3 times. Previously, the effect dealt 125% of Base Damage + 300 as fixed damage every 0.5 seconds. The additional 20% damage taken reduction and 25% Movement Speed reduction remain unchanged.

As a result of these changes, all Traits and Trait Resonance on the Ember of Birth Earrings and Spring Daydream Earrings will be reset. Compensation will be calculated separately for each affected item instance owned and sent via in-game Mail within 48 hours of the update:
Trait Unlocks: For each unlocked Trait on affected gear: 100 Trait Unlockstones, 150,000 Sollant
Trait Enhancement: For every 2,500 cumulative Trait growth EXP invested in affected gear: 1 Trait Enchantment Stone, 75,000 Sollant
Trait Resonance Unlock: If Trait Resonance was unlocked on affected gear: 3 Trait Resonance Stones, 1,500,000 Sollant
Trait Resonance Attempts: All Trait Resonance Stones and Sollant spent on Trait Resonance attempts for each affected item will be refunded.

Added 3 new armor sets and 20 new Accessories.

Added 2 new Level 60 Field Bosses to Tumgir Hollow in Nix, Grimturg and Exodus.

notes.title: Item Level Expansion and New Equipment

items.text: Added 15 new Armor pieces and 20 new Accessories.
Verdigris Covenant Set 1: 2-piece effect: Block Chance +12%, Skill Damage Resistance +80.
Verdigris Covenant Set 2: 2-piece effect: Heavy Attack Damage +2.5% per 10 Strength, Melee Heavy Attack Chance +200.
Ancient Resolve Set 1: 2-piece effect: Critical Damage +2% per 10 Dexterity, Ranged Critical Hit +200.
Ancient Resolve Set 2: 2-piece effect: Critical Hit Chance +175, on Critical Hit restores 3% of damage dealt as Health.
Azure Sanctuary Set 1: 2-piece effect: Heavy Attack Damage +0.8% per 1,000 Max Mana up to 30,000, Heavy Attack Damage +10%.

Azure Sanctuary Set 2: 2-piece effect: If Mana is at 30% or below, boosts Mana Regen by 100% until it reaches 70%. If Mana is above 30%, Skill Damage Boost +160 and total Mana Cost Efficiency -30. Cannot be activated during Mana Regen increase effects.
Increased the maximum equipment Item Level from 80 to 90.
Equipment that previously had a maximum Item Level of 80, including the newly added equipment, can now be upgraded to Item Level 90.
Equipment obtained from reward chests acquired before the release of Version 4.12.0 will remain at Item Level 80.
Equipment obtained by purifying Redfrost Items owned before the update will also remain at Item Level 80.
Increased the Fixed Item Level of Nix and Snowsoul Archboss Weapons to 93.
Significantly increased equipment growth rates from Item Levels 51 to 80 and reduced Inheritance costs.

Updated rewards for Nix Contracts, Purification, Ascended Talandre and Nix Archbosses, Ascended Talandre and Nix Field Bosses, Co-op Dungeons, Hall of Illusion, Dimensional Trial Golden Chests, Battlegrounds, Raids, Crafting, and Material Transmutation.
Existing Nix Contract reward chests and Contracts accepted before the update will retain their current rewards.
Added recipes for Verdigris Covenant, Ancient Resolve, and Azure Sanctuary equipment sets.
These recipes require Adventure Coin: Fortitude, Shemir's Armor Cinder, Precious Magic Powder, and Noble Polishing Crystals.
Added 10 crafting recipes that use the corresponding Enraged Skill Core to create its Ruthless Skill Core variant.

Added 22 Lithograph Book entries using 15 new Armor pieces and 14 new Accessories.
Completing these entries rewards Trait Unlockstone Fragments, Trait Enchantment Stone Fragments, and various Precious Ores.
Donating resources designated as recommended by your Guild now grants bonus rewards alongside the standard donation rewards.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/4d700c51ec432085751b36b86019942f1cb03ae0.png"]
During Raids, if a Helping Hand-eligible player belongs to another party within the same raid group, Helping Hand rewards are now granted to the entire raid group.
Increased the availability of Trait Unlockstone Fragments and Relic Analysis Crystals.
Improved Purification rewards by removing equipment with a maximum Item Level of 50 and adding equipment that can reach Item Level 90.
Increased equipment growth rates from Item Levels 51 to 80 and reduced Inheritance costs.
Increased Dimensional Trial point rewards and Golden Chest appearance rates.
Increased rewards from Dynamic Events and adjusted their schedule.
Added Trait Unlockstone Fragments and Relic Analysis Crystals to Dynamic Event rewards.
Trait Unlockstone Fragments are granted as participation rewards.
Relic Analysis Crystals are granted as ranking rewards from Guild-type Dynamic Events.
Players with Regional Contribution Certificates can earn up to 250 additional Trait Unlockstone Fragments, depending on the Event type.
Increased the chance of obtaining Heroic Trait Enchantment Stones from Heroic Trait Enchantment Stone Chests.
Chests obtained before the update will retain their current acquisition rates.
Consolidated Heroic Trait Enchantment Stones for Armor and Accessories.
Armor and Accessory stones are no longer separated by individual equipment type.
Each stat now has one Heroic Trait Enchantment Stone for Armor and one for Accessories.
Heroic Trait Enchantment Stones obtained through Login Events will be automatically converted into the consolidated stones after the update.
Stones obtained through other content can be dissolved to receive the corresponding consolidated stones.
Significantly increased equipment growth rates from Item Levels 51 to 80.
Reduced equipment Inheritance costs.
Added new equipment to Purification results and adjusted acquisition rates.

Equipment with a maximum Item Level of 50 can no longer be obtained when purifying Weapon, Armor, or Accessory Redfrost Items, significantly increasing the chance of obtaining equipment that can reach Item Level 90.
Removed Uncommon Redfrost equipment from drops and rewards.
Adjusted the equipment available from Rare and Epic Redfrost Items:
Rare Redfrost Items grant equipment between Item Levels 51 and 80.
Epic Redfrost Items grant equipment between Item Levels 51 and 90.
Added level indicators to Redfrost Items to show the maximum Item Level of the equipment they can provide.
Reduced the weekly purchase limit for Resistance Contract Scroll: Nix to 1 and doubled its rewards.
Scrolls obtained before the update and Contracts already in progress will retain their current rewards.
Significantly increased Flames of Purification Points granted by NPCs and gathering objects in Remnants of Nix.
Increased the Accumulated Points earned per clear to 6,000.
Increased the base appearance rate of Golden Chests at Stage 6 and above from 20% to 40%.
Increased the additional Golden Chest appearance rate granted by each debuff selected in the Additional Effects menu from 5% to 10%.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/b5b751aced6e09b7e955fad3d7c810b4a8375a71.png"]
Dynamic Events are now held at 00:00, 12:00, 18:00, and 21:00 local server time daily.
Dominion and Guild Dynamic Events now alternate between time slots based on the day of the week and the week.
Reduced the number of Region Contribution Certificates granted each week from 7 to 3.
Increased Dynamic Event rewards.
The Primal Trial: Reduced monster damage and the number of enemies required to complete the objective.
The Candle That Melts Eternity: Reduced the boss monster's Movement Speed.
Updated Skill and Skill Core descriptions to reflect recent balance changes and clarify effects.
Adjusted equipment effects and fixed various issues.
Reduced the difference between the maximum and minimum Hit Chance and Evasion limits in Battlegrounds and Arena.
Guillotine Blade: Fixed an issue where the tooltip incorrectly stated that damage increased against Prone or Shocked targets. The effect applies against targets affected by Collision or Shock.
Defense Skill \[Iron Point Parry]: Reflected damage is now affected by Hit Chance and Evasion.
The Stun applied when defending against a Fury Attack within 0.5 seconds is now resolved separately from reflected damage.
Skill Core: Rear Strike: Expanded the activation condition to include both Greatsword Mobility Skills and Greatsword Skills that move the caster.
Skill Core: Wave: Updated the description to clarify that Wave changes Slash Wave into a single-strike attack.
Ankle Strike: Added the missing duration of Collision: Prone to the Skill description.
Camouflage Cloak Specialization 1 \[Crowd Control Immunity]: Fixed an issue where the Specialization did not grant immunity to Fear applied by Winter Storm Wand \[Dragon's Intimidation].

Frenzied Sword Dance / Frenzied Sword Dance Specialization 1 \[Mad Sword Dance]: Fixed an issue preventing these Skills from being used against targets made Airborne by Deluzhnoa's Torrent or Deluzhnoa's Cold.
Skill Core: Triple Snipe: Increased the speed of the leap and attack animations.
The player is now immune to Stun, Collision, Bind, Sleep, and Fear while leaping.
Increased the distance traveled by the third leap.
Reusing the Skill before firing now immediately performs the next leap.
Updated the Skill Core and Skill descriptions to reflect these changes.
Elemental Awakening: Combined Fire, Ice, and Lightning Elements into a single Elemental Energy resource.
The effect now activates upon reaching 7 Elemental Energy instead of requiring separate Fire, Ice, and Lightning values.
Reduced the period during which Elemental Energy cannot be gained after activation from 10 seconds to 5 seconds.
Increased the duration of the Species Damage Boost effect from 4 seconds to 6 seconds.
Reduced the remaining cooldown reduction applied to elemental Staff Skills at all growth levels.
At Heroic Lv. 5, the remaining cooldown reduction has been reduced from 15% to 12.6%.
Skill Core: Thunder's Shadow: Renamed the Crowd Control effect applied to enemies from Thunder's Blessing to Thunder's Shadow.
Thunder's Shadow's cooldown now begins when the effect is applied to an enemy instead of when the Skill is used.
Fixed an issue where the Mana Regen Increase buff icon did not appear while Inner Peace Specialization 3 \[Duration Increase] was active.
Skill Core: Thunderclouds Explosion: Removed the effect that reduced falling lightning to 2 strikes per second. Lightning now strikes 5 times per second.
The area effect continues to deal 60% increased damage to up to 3 targets within 1m.
When 2 of Thunder's Shadow, Lightning Condensation, and Thunderclouds Explosion are active simultaneously, only the highest Damage Amplification effect is applied.
Updated the Skill Core and Skill descriptions to reflect these changes.
Skill Core: Absolute Zero: Significantly reduced the casting time to improve synergy with Icebound Explosion and Ice Mist.
The designated area retains its 6m radius.
Enemies within the area receive 1 stack of Weaken: Frostbite every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds.
Each Frostbite stack reduces Movement Speed by 20%. Reaching 5 stacks applies Bind: Icebound for 3 seconds.
Updated the Skill Core and Skill descriptions to reflect these changes.
Skill Core: Ice Mist: The caster can now enter Stealth again while remaining within the area after the 5-second Stealth reactivation restriction expires.
Updated the description to clarify that Stealth cannot be applied again for 5 seconds after it is granted.

Adjusted Base Damage from 187~274 to 162~299.

Adjusted Base Damage from 232~398 to 174~456.

Lightning Orb of Vengeance \[Stellar Star Destroyer]: Improved the Skill's visual effects.

Until October 8, Guilds can challenge Tevent and Queen Bellandir through special Guild Raids.

Each attempt requires a Turkan's Archboss Punishment Stone, available from the Guild Supplies Merchant.
Guilds must be Level 20 or above to access the event Guild Raids.

notes.title: Escape Ports now activate in stages

items.text: Three Escape Ports activate after 5, 12, and 19 minutes have elapsed from the start of the session.
Each activated Escape Port is randomly assigned a duration of 3, 5, or 7 minutes.
The final remaining Escape Port activates after 26 minutes and remains active for 3 minutes.

Emergency Escape Devices can be found at Escape Ports located near Nixberry River, Altar of Corruption, Blacksword Shore, Arkeum Fortress, and Mirror Lake of Eternity.

Defense Skill \[Patient Block]: When blocking a Fury Attack with a stationary Defense Skill, counterattacks against targets within Attack Range can now activate up to 5 times. Previously, the number of counterattacks was unlimited.
Abyssal Cleave Specialization 1 \[Ascending Cleave]: Changed the midair attack area to extend the full Attack Range, with a width equal to 50% of Attack Range.
Potential Ability \[Rising Slash Enchant]: Reduced Burst Damage amplification based on Weaken: Burst, Ignite, and Shock stacks from 40% to 30%.
Skill Core: Night of Thunderstorms: Fixed an issue where the Lightning effect accumulated when defeating enemies with Flame Javelin or Spear while Night of Thunderstorms was equipped.
Skill Core: Purifying Star: Fixed an issue where Purifying Star could not remove the Fear effect from Winter Storm Wand \[Dragon's Intimidation].
Skill Core: Star of Rest: Fixed an issue where Star of Rest did not apply to Healing Star while Star Destroyer Specialization 4 \[Additional Effect] was active.
Stellar Dash: Reduced Monster Damage Amplification at all levels.
At Heroic Lv. 5, Monster Damage Amplification decreased from 100% to 60%.
Starlight Rush Specialization 1 \[Damage Amplification]: Reduced Damage Amplification from 8% to 6%.
Summon Constellation Specialization 1 \[Milky Way]: Reduced Monster Damage Amplification at all levels.
At Heroic Lv. 5, Monster Damage Amplification decreased from 60% to 35%.
Incapacitate: Fixed an issue where Stun had a chance to apply at 5 Overwhelm stacks instead of 3 stacks.
Short Jab Specialization 4 \[Chain Skill]: Fixed an issue where movement inputs did not function when Bloodstorm and Blood Talon were entered consecutively.
Bulwark of Invulnerability \[Devastating Chain]: Reduced the number of additional enemies affected by Chain Hook from 3 to 1.
Scale Lord's Massacre Sword \[Wall of Bitter Cold]: Fixed an issue where Buff Duration did not affect the counterattack duration while Wall of Bitter Cold was active.
Fixed an issue where the Frost effect icon displayed an incorrect stack count when Frost was applied through counterattack damage.

Stone Grave Cutting Daggers \[Thunder Call]: When the skill hits a monster, it now removes 5 Weaken: Thundercloud stacks and deals damage equal to 700% of Base Damage. Previously, it removed 3 stacks and dealt damage equal to 400% of Base Damage.
Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death \[Deluzhnoa's Cold] / Deluzhnoa's Bow of Frigid Frost \[Enraged Deluzhnoa's Cold]: A notification is now displayed when the skill effect is resisted.
Frozen Inferno Longbow / Frost Comet Longbow \[Purifying Cry]: Updated the description to clarify that CC effects are removed in the same manner as Purifying Touch.
Effects are removed in the following order: action-disabling effects, movement-disabling effects, Weaken effects, Shield Health Reduction, and Healing Received Reduction.
Purifying a Weaken effect removes up to 20 stacks.
Endless Winter's Lightning Staff \[Elemental Fusion]: Removed the cooldown from Special Skills, allowing them to be used immediately when their activation conditions are met.
Deluzhnoa's Ancient Petrified Staff \[Deluzhnoa's Hail] / Deluzhnoa's Staff of Frozen Flames \[Enraged Deluzhnoa's Hail]: Corrected the displayed casting area from 4m to 5m.
Coldblooded Commander Magic Staff \[Icebound Spike]: Added Icebound Tomb's Movement Speed reduction effect and enabled the effects of Icebound Tomb Specializations 2 and 3.
Updated the description to clarify that the effect cannot be used with Icebound Tomb Specialization 1.
Winter Storm Wand \[Dragon's Intimidation]: Changed the height range of the effect from -1m to 3m to -3.5m to 3.5m.
Clarified that Fear can affect enemies already within the area when the skill is used, as well as enemies that subsequently enter the area.
Adjusted the description to make it clear that Dragon's Intimidation ignores Evasion and Resistance when applying Fear.

Cordy's Grasp of Manipulation \[Giant Cordy's Blessing] / Giant Cordy's Ascension Wand \[Enraged Giant Cordy's Blessing]: Fixed an issue where the effect could not remove Fear applied by Winter Storm Wand \[Dragon's Intimidation] and added the missing Fear Immunity information to the effect description.
Frigid Flower Crimson Lotus Wand / Crystalblossom Clearmoon Wand \[Clay's Purification]: Fixed an issue where the effect could not remove Fear applied by Winter Storm Wand \[Dragon's Intimidation].
Arctic Roar Resonating Orb \[Tectonic Shift]: Fixed an issue where Tectonic Shift did not deal damage when the skill effect hit a target.
Lightning Orb of Vengeance \[Stellar Star Destroyer]: Fixed an issue where the Healing Received debuff was not applied on hit after activating Star Destroyer Specialization 4 \[Additional Effect].
Ascended Leviathan's Gauntlets \[Enraged Leviathan's Incineration]: Changed the additional fixed damage dealt every 0.5 seconds from 300% of Base Damage to 125% of Base Damage + 300.

Ascended Queen Bellandir's Gauntlets \[Enraged Queen Bellandir's Gravity Field] / Queen Bellandir's Burning Gauntlets \[Queen Bellandir's Gravity Field]: Fixed an issue where the effect did not activate when Blood Spiral hit a target.
Dawn of Black Lament: Fixed an issue where the set bonus description incorrectly stated that the effect scales with Fortitude instead of Strength.
Soundless Mage Taliesia: Corrected the tooltip from removing all Crowd Control effects from party members to removing Stun, Bind, Sleep, Silence, and Fear from party members.
Fixed an issue where Fear could not be removed.
Lightning Speed: Fixed an issue where the chained lightning activation effect applied incorrectly.
Improved equipment crafting by giving players greater control over material selection and Potential Ability transfers.
Added Auction House price searches for untradeable items when a tradeable version exists.
Added Launch Circles and improved destination guidance throughout Nix.
The equipment selection window is now always displayed when using equipment as crafting material.
Eligible equipment will no longer be selected and consumed automatically from the Inventory.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/3e3bf738c64fd4d248cd8c4570170e0b3858abec.png"]
When using lower-tier equipment to craft higher-tier equipment, players can now choose whether to transfer the material equipment's Potential Ability.
If the transfer option is not selected, the crafted equipment will have a chance to receive a randomly determined Potential Ability.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/2b5b2b188ad952dec50e8fe4817b1e273561fd42.png"]
Untradeable items can now be included in Auction House price searches when a tradeable version of the same item exists.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/b50777b46e8fe02b2b9cd6251ff059ecd71d5c81.png"]
Added Launch Circles near the Star Beacon in each area.
Added Launch Circle destination guidance for Field Events.
Launch Circle icons are now always displayed on the Map.
Replaced Boss Expedition rewards with the new Boss Expedition Bundle.
The new pouch does not grant Trait Unlockstones. All other acquisition rates remain the same as the previous pouch.
Previously owned chests remain unchanged and can still be used.
Added a new Mystic Key Chance Chest that does not contain Extraction Stones.
The acquisition rate previously assigned to Extraction Stones has been transferred to Precious Parchment, increasing its acquisition rate.
Existing chests remain unchanged and will no longer be supplied.
Added Fermented Rotein to the chest contents.
Changed the location of the Honor Coin Merchant.
Changed the location of the Rift Contract Manager.
The Resolve of the Star Fragment buff granted after a party wipe no longer applies in Raid \.
Improved the visibility of equipped skills.
Teleporting with a Guild Summon Stone no longer forces the player to return when the destination is a PvP-enabled area.
When players die inside a Talandre Riftstone instance, they now revive at the instance starting point.
Affected areas: Quietis's Demesne, Swamp of Silence, Black Anvil Forge, Crimson Mansion
Players can now enter an Inter-Server Event from their home server only while the activity inside is in progress.
Once the activity has been completed, players who leave cannot re-enter.
Fixed an issue where an effect occasionally did not apply to Atirat.
Fixed an issue where damage did not apply to Atirat during certain mechanics.
If Atirat reaches 0 Health during certain mechanics, Atirat now dies after the mechanic ends.
Ramux now removes harmful effects from itself when taking flight.
Fixed an issue where Ramux could occasionally not be selected as an attack target.
Fixed an issue where players could become stuck after being positioned incorrectly on the Dragonstrike Spear.
Fixed an issue where attacking from the side Ramux was not defending with the Dragonstrike Spear created additional projectiles.
Fixed an issue rarely causing Ramux to become invisible after respawning.
Fixed an issue where Guild Territory ownership information for Boonstones and Riftstones was displayed incorrectly in the Schedule for cross-server matchmade content.
Fixed an issue where swimming could be canceled in parts of Crystal Lake in Quietis's Demesne, Talandre.
Fixed an issue where tooltips incorrectly indicated that ineligible items could be registered in the Lithograph Book.
Fixed an issue where animated emojis were not displayed.
Fixed an issue causing Redfrost Trousers to occasionally grant Gloves.
Corrected an issue causing the Azure Moon Gauntlets to not be displayed.
Fixed an issue causing some textures to not render correctly on the Umbral Phantom Gauntlets.
Fixed an issue where unlocking the Ascended Leviathan's Bow Illusion incorrectly granted Velentra’s Arc of Obsession.
A "Cannot interact with target" prompt will no longer be shown while actively interacting with furniture.
Fixed an issue causing a tree to clip through the ground in Kastleton 4-1.
Announced in the latest Resistance Report, Vegamor has been rescheduled to the end of September. Aligning with this, the Primordial Wanderer Milestone end date has changed to September 24th.
The Traces of Spacetime Double-Up event will be available for 3 weeks.
During the event period, twice as many Special Resistance Medals can be earned from Rift Rebellion events and Relic Fishing Locations.
A 35-day login event will grant rewards for logging in each day.
Key rewards include a Heroic Weapon Selection Chest, Armor Chest, and Accessory Chest, as well as an Archboss Weapon Selection Chest including all Tevent and Queen Bellandir Archboss Weapons.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/b2bc7683ff4ced72fc09ebd3c98d105450978945.png"]
Battle Pass: Smoldering Vow is now available.

Moving forward, Battle Pass event shops will contain a Premium section allowing purchase of additional Trait Unlockstone Fragments, Trait Enchantment Stone Fragments, and Heroic Trait Unlockstone Fragments for players that have purchased the Premium Pass.
Throne and Liberty update 4.5.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 29 and last approximately 3.5 hours.
※ The following changes will not be applied during the July 29 maintenance. Instead, they will be applied on August 26th with the release of 4.9.0.
A crafting recipe will be added to upgrade Talandre Ascended Archboss weapons into Snowsoul weapons.

notes.title: Talandre Snowsoul Weapon Crafting Recipes Added

items.text: As previously announced, crafting recipes will be added that use new materials to upgrade Ascended Deluzhnoa and Ascended Giant Cordy weapons into Snowsoul weapons.
The new Archboss Ramux is now available.
New Dimensional Trials and Guild Raids have been added.
Peace and Guild-type events for the Ramux Archboss have been added, and the Archboss schedule has been changed.
Archboss schedules have been added on Tuesdays and Fridays at 7:00 PM and 10:00 PM.
Weapons — The item level of each new Archboss weapon is fixed at 85.
Last Dragon's Thunder Greatsword: Strength 17, Dexterity 13, Heavy Attack Damage +11.5%, Melee Heavy Attack Chance 210

Weapon Skill – Dragon's Counterattack: On Valiant Brawl or Slash Wave hit, has an 80% chance to apply Weaken: Provoke to the target for 4s and grants the attacker an effect that has a 70% chance to deal counter damage equal to 75% of Base Damage when hit by a taunted target within 15m. Boosts Valiant Brawl, Cruel Smite, and Slash Wave damage by 35% and increases their cooldown by 3s.
Scale Lord's Massacre Sword: Fortitude 17, Wisdom 12, Damage Reduction 69, Hit Chance 230

Weapon Skill – Wall of Bitter Cold: Changes Stalwart Bastion to \[Wall of Bitter Cold] and decreases its cooldown by 30%. While the effect lasts, deals damage equal to 150% of Base Damage when attacked from within 1.3x Attack Range (4.3x for Ranged and Magic) and has a 30% chance to apply Weaken: Frost that decreases Movement Speed by 35% for 3s. Affected targets cannot receive Stalwart Bastion from another caster for 45s.
Last Dragon's Thunder Daggers: Dexterity 17, Perception 12, Critical Damage +9.2%, Melee Critical Hit Chance 230

Weapon Skill – Atirat's Claw: Changes the range of Mad Sword Dance to 10m. Deactivates all targets to self upon skill activation. Boosts Off-hand Weapon Attack Chance by 70% and makes all attacks back attacks for 2s. Ignores PvP target's Shield Health. With every damage dealt on PvP targets with Health at 50% or lower, ignores Defense by 2.5% of the target's Max Health. Boosts damage against monsters by up to 50% proportional to Frenzied Sword Dance's growth tier.
Reverse Scale Tracker's Judgment Crossbows: Dexterity 17, Perception 12, Bonus Damage 69, Critical Damage +9.2%

Weapon Skill – Atirat's Flame: Changes Wild Barrage to an instant cast skill and changes the Attack Range to a 60-degree cone. On hit, has an 80% chance to apply a Weaken effect to the target for 9s that deals Defense-ignoring damage equal to 30% of Base Damage + 6 damage per second and decreases all CC Resistances by 20. Stacks up to 25 times.
Reverse Scale Destroyer's Execution Bow: Perception 17, Dexterity 12, Critical Damage +9.2%, Ranged Critical Hit Chance 230

Weapon Skill – Ice Dragon Strike: Changes Flash Wave to Ice Dragon Strike. Depending on charging time, deals Frost Damage equal to Flash Wave boosted by 50% and applies the Frost effect. Frost effect has a 70% chance to apply Bind: Icebound for 3s. Deals bonus damage to Bound or Oppressed targets. When Specialization 3 \[Effect Time Increase] is applied, increases Bind: Icebound duration by 1s.
Endless Winter's Lightning Staff: Wisdom 17, Perception 12, Heavy Attack Damage +11.5%, Cooldown Speed +11.5%

Weapon Skill – Elemental Infusion: Changes the Elemental Awakening Passive Skill to \[Elemental Infusion] and activates Special Skills when conditions for 2 element types are met. When 5 Fire Elements and 2 Ice Elements are stacked, Frost Smokescreen and Burning Smokescreen Skills change to \[Lava Dust] (Fury Attack). Deals 250% of Base Damage per second to foes within range and applies Weaken: Lava Dust for 6s. When Weaken: Lava Dust reaches 4 stacks, applies Petrify for 4s. When 2 Ice Elements and 7 Lightning Elements are stacked, Ice Spear Bombardment and Detonator Bombardment Skills change to \[Magnetic Field]. Deals Lightning Damage equal to 1,100% of Base Damage to hit enemies and applies Weaken: Magnetic Field which decreases Movement Speed by 60% for 2.5s. Magnetic Field transfers to foes within 5m up to 2 times, with 1 additional transfer if the target is Wet or affected by your own Frost effect. When 7 Lightning Elements and 5 Fire Elements are stacked, Inferno Wave and Frenzied Lightning Wave skills change to \. Firestorm follows the target for 4s and deals damage equal to 300% of Base Damage and applies Weaken: Burning.
Winter Storm Wand: Wisdom 17, Fortitude 12, Healing +24%, Cooldown Speed +11%
Weapon Skill – Dragon's Blessing: Fountain of Life follows the target and has a 60% chance to apply Fear to enemies within range for 3s.
Storm Lord's Judgment Spear: Strength 17, Perception 12, Attack Speed +15.3%, Range +23%

Weapon Skill – Ramux's Judgment: Constricting Tempest always hits and additionally triggers on 2 enemies within a 5m radius of the target. When the chain ends, has a 100% chance to apply Collision: Pull and decreases Heavy Attack Damage Resistance of pulled targets by 15% for 6s. Upon successfully pulling a target, your PvP damage taken decreases by 30% for 6s.
Lightning Orb of Vengeance: Wisdom 17, Perception 12, Cooldown Speed +12.5%, Attack Speed +13.9%

Weapon Skill – Stellar Star Destroyer: Boosts Star Destroyer damage by 30% and the Star Destroyer skill changes to \[Stellar Star Destroyer]. Summons 6 Stellar Star Destroyers on the target, each dealing 275% of Base Damage + 225. Damage increases up to 2x proportional to charge time.
Snowfield Destroyer Lightning Gauntlets: Dexterity 17, Strength 12, Cooldown Speed +12%, Melee Heavy Attack Chance 220

Weapon Skill – Last Dragon's Blessing: Increases Threat Boost's Block Chance Boost effect duration by 0.5s and increases Base Damage by 1 for 6s every time Weaken: Bleed is applied. Stacks up to 100 times.
Equipment — Values shown are granted at Item Levels 51 and 80 respectively.
Heavenly Lightning Cloak of Flying: Critical Damage +3.2%~+6.1%, Heavy Attack Damage +4%~+7.6%, Range +8%~+15.2%, Cooldown Speed +4%~+7.6%, Max Health 500~1,040
Stone Grave Cradle has been added to Dimensional Trials.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/b09db1bce53fb746a0a0948847a9c97df301a990.png"]
Two new Guild Raids have been added, available at Guild Level 30.
Thuban
Porfos
