notes.title: Talandre Ascended Archboss Material Drop Increase

items.text: Crafting recipes and crafting materials used to upgrade Ascended Talandre Archboss weapons will be added on August 26.
Accordingly, the number of scorched materials provided from Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy part destruction and drop rewards has been increased.
Inject Venom: Additional-use skill effect changed.
Previous: When an attack succeeds against a target with 20 Poison stacks, consumes 10 Poison stacks and increases Heavy Attack Damage by 20% for 6 seconds.
Updated: When an attack hits a target with 20 Poison stacks, increases Heavy Attack Damage by 20% for 6 seconds.
Inject Venom Specialization 1 \[Lightning Infusion]: Additional-use skill effect changed.
Previous: When an attack succeeds against a target with 20 Thundercloud stacks, consumes 10 Thundercloud stacks and increases Critical Damage by 15% for 6 seconds.
Updated: When an attack succeeds against a target with 20 Thundercloud stacks, increases Critical Damage by 15% for 6 sec.
Weapon Mastery \[Venomous Edge]: Fixed an issue where attack power increase effects equivalent to base damage were not applied to Venomous Edge skill damage.
Skill Core: Support Fire: The 30% PvP damage reduction effect has been removed from Quick Fire, Recoil Shot, Wave Shot, and Explosive Arrow.
Chain Strike - \[Smash Down]: Hit range increased from 4m to 5m. An effect has been added so Chain Strike – Smash Down can be used while using the Earthquake skill.
Mobility Strike Specialization 2 \[Mobility Enchant]: Specialization name changed to \[Range Increase]. Required points reduced from 5 to 3. The effect of the Specialization has been adjusted:
Previous: Mobility Strike - Can now charge while moving. Afterimage - Attack range increases by 20%.
Updated: Afterimage - Attack range increases by 20%. Mobility Strike can now be charged while moving by default, without the need for a specific Specialization.
Sweep Specialization 3 \[Movement Speed and Range Increase]: Movement Speed bonus has increased from 25% to 50%.

Explosive Flurry: New specialization \[Cooldown Reduction] has been added. Requires 5 points. Reduces Explosive Barrage skill cooldown by 15%, and each Explosive Flurry hit reduces One-Inch Punch's remaining cooldown by 5%.
Explosive Flurry Specialization 2 \[Range Increase]: Required points reduced from 5 to 3.
Consecutive Claws: Improved so the skill can be used while jumping.

Skill Core: Fear Erosion: Fixed an issue where the movement speed and defense reduction values were applied incorrectly when Fear Erosion was active, and the values in the effect tooltip were incorrect.
Flash Arrow Specialization 1 \[Flash Wave]: Fixed an issue where the effect was occasionally not applied to the caster when moving backwards or used from an elevated location.

Skill Core: Torrent, Eye of Ventius: Monster Damage Amplification value now grows with the respective Skill level. Fixed an issue where the stated damage increase against Monsters was displayed as a sum which included the original skill's monster damage amplification.
Torrent: The damage increase value displayed has been reduced from 185% to 50%.
Eye of Ventius: The damage increase value displayed has been reduced from 260% to 50%.
Skill Core: Gale Arrow: Fixed an issue causing Gale Arrow to share a cooldown with Flash Arrow.
Blitz Specialization 1 \[Limit Break]: Fixed an issue causing the DoT effect from Decisive Sniping to ignore Defense and Evasion when enhanced with Limit Break.
Inner Peace: Fixed an issue where the description for Specialization 1 \[Thunder's Blessing] was incorrectly applied to \[Inner Peace].
Skill Core: Thunder's Shadow: Damage increased from 60% to 120%.
Skill Core: Lightning Condensation: Damage increased from 90% to 180%. Growth values per skill level have been adjusted to match \[Inner Peace].

Skill Core: Thunderclouds Explosion: Damage increased from 60% to 120%. Fixed an issue where the stated PvP damage reduction effect was not applied. Monster Damage Amplification display changed from 50% to 150%. Growth values per skill level have been adjusted to match \[Inner Peace].
Skill Core: Absolute Zero: Frost Smokescreen's cooldown is now properly reduced based on the skill's level while the Absolute Zero Skill Core is equipped.
Mastery \: Description has been updated to include Nightmare Melody in the list of skills that trigger the effect.
Skill Core: Magic Circle Expansion: Fixed an issue where the cooldown reduction value was displayed as seconds instead of a percentage.
Skill Core: Nightmare Melody: Added sleep duration increase effect when leveling the respective skill.

Rising Slash / Cross Cut Specialization 4 \[Slaughtering Slash]: Fixed an issue where, when the final attack of \[Rising Slash] or an attack from \[Slaughtering Slash] hit a target with Weaken: Brand, the skill cooldown was reduced by up to 15 sec based on stacks of Weaken: Burst, Ignite, and Shock.
Crimson Snow Annihilation Greatsword, Azure Snow Dragon Greatsword - \: Damage amplification of Guillotine Blade against monsters at 50% Health or lower increased from 50% to 80%.
Stone Grave Executioner's Greatsword - \[Battlefield Momentum]: Fixed an issue where entering and leaving water reset the cooldown of Precision Dash.
Flash of Justice Crossbows - \[Disruption Shot]: Fixed an issue where the Weaken effect duration shown in the tooltip differed from the actual duration.
Crimson Snow Tracking Crossbows, Azure Snow Crystal Crossbows - \[Double Trap]: Fixed an issue where entering and leaving water reset the cooldown of the Explosive Trap skill.
Frozen Inferno Longbow, Frozen Comet Longbow - \[Purifying Cry]: Skill effect has been adjusted.
Previous: Area of effect: 3m radius, number of targets: 6.
Updated: Area of effect: Radius equal to 25% of the player's Range, number of targets: 3.
Fixed an issue causing the effect to be applied to allies, instead of just party members.
Updated the skill description to clarify that the effect applies to 3 party members, excluding the caster.
Coldblooded Commander Magic Staff - \[Icebound Spike]: Fixed an issue where the Icebound Spike effect was not properly applied. Adjusted so the charge gauge is displayed when using the skill.
Coldblooded Wand - \[Prismatic Beam]: Fixed an issue where Prismatic Beam could be summoned without limit.
Frigid Melody 4-set effect: Health recovery value when applying a shield changed from 160% of base damage + 600 to a flat value of 750.
Equipment growth costs have been reduced, and Resonance enhancement rates have been changed.
Probabilities have been adjusted so attempting Resonance Enhancement will no longer result in a lower number than before.
The number of gems required for Inheritance has been reduced to 50% of the previous amount.
The difference in Gems already spent for previous Inheritance will be refunded via Mail within 48 hours of the update.
The existing recipes that used Adventure Coin: Fortitude to craft previous Unlockstones have been removed, and new recipes that craft the new variant of Unlockstones have been added.
The number of Adventure Coin: Fortitude required for the new recipes was set based on the conversion ratio from previous Unlockstones to new Unlockstones.

Heroic Equipment can now have Potential Abilities.
Upon being obtained, Heroic Equipment may have a Potential Ability available:
Weapons have an 8.3% chance to receive a Potential Ability.
Armor and Accessories have a 5% chance to receive a Potential Ability.
Potential Abilities can now be transferred onto and off of Heroic Equipment.
Removed the shield pattern used by Dragaryle when reaching 50% HP on Normal difficulty.
On Difficult/Nightmare difficulty, Dragaryle will no longer interrupt special patterns upon reaching 50% HP.
Fixed an issue where some floors and staircases were invisible while using low graphics settings.
Movement skills can no longer be used while carrying a relic.
Exception: Players morphed into Air Raid or Blitz (Disruptor) can still use movement skills regardless of relic possession.
Fixed an issue where the "Defeat Vulcanus without taking damage from Fury or Wrath attacks" Exploration quest was not achievable.
Fixed an issue where pillars would not collapse when a power source spawned at certain locations during the boss fight.
Nightmare Conductor's attack power has been reduced.
The minimum number of participants required for Guild Portals has been adjusted from 36 to 24.

Porfos: Fixed an issue where the Ice Prison was instantly destroyed by player attacks, preventing players from responding to the follow-up attack. Fixed an issue where, if the Ice Prison was destroyed quickly, distant players were hit by the follow-up attack projectile. Some regional background elements have been adjusted.
Thuban: Fixed an issue where Thuban did not attack players when they were positioned against outer structures.
Ascended Ahzreil: Fixed an issue causing Ahzreil's Flying Strike Gauntlets to not appear in the Ahzreil Equipment Selection Chest.
Fixed an issue where the region name was displayed abnormally when entering Pakilo Naru's Guild Raid instance.
The display range for system messages when monsters appear has been changed.
When an event occurs in Laslan, Stonegard, or Talandre, a notification message will be displayed across the entire region.
When an event occurs in Nix, a notification message will be displayed while inside Nix.
Fixed an issue in Scarlet Dream where the boss soul did not use skills.
Fixed an issue in Scarlet Dream where the boss could continue to be summoned even after the boss soul owner died.
Fixed an issue causing reward availability cooldowns to be shared across characters on an account.
Pitons have been added in Stillreach and an entry pathway leading to Ramux has been opened.
Removed a floating Piton in Tumgir Hollow.
Fixed an issue causing some players to be stuck with no contracts being displayed at the Nix Contract Manager.
Fixed an issue in \[Eternal Tundra] - \[Guild Proclamation: Sinking] where the field boss event activation text for Porfos and Thuban was not displayed.
Fixed an issue preventing Remnants of Nix from being accessed on Enforcer, the PS5-only server.
Fixed an issue causing some Guild Distribution settings to appear editable by players that did not have the respective permissions.
Fixed an issue where, when using Guild Distribution, the guild member list did not refresh properly according to the sale method settings.
Gems dropped by bosses can no longer be distributed through Guild Distribution.
Fixed an issue where the red dot did not appear or did not disappear in Mirror Boutique when acquiring some items.
Fixed an issue where some equipment appearance names were applied incorrectly.
Appearance: Northern Wind's Roaring Staff has been changed to Appearance: Coldblooded Commander Magic Staff.
Appearance: Endless Winter's Lightning Staff has been changed to Appearance: Endless Winter's Lightning Staff.
Fixed an issue where, when a female character equipped the Sunswell Drifter Headpiece together with certain outfits, the Sunswell Drifter Headpiece changed to a different appearance.
Weapon icons related to a Skill Core's respective ability have been added to the Skill Core title.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/883407e8b57be57e6d495a881f3bdf445027e2fd.png"]
Fixed an issue where item level, stats, and Trait Resonance values were not reflected correctly when linking items in chat.
Changed so the tooltip explaining acquisition rates is no longer displayed when linking an item with no Potential Ability assigned in chat.
Fixed damage that ignores Defense stats granted by monsters can no longer be reduced by the Species Damage Resistance stat.
Unlockstones have been removed from Fishing Sacks, and the remaining rewards have had their drop rate adjusted respectively.
Existing Fishing Sacks will no longer drop Unlockstones.
Unlockstones have been removed from Expedition Pouches, and the remaining rewards have had their drop rate adjusted respectively.
Existing Expedition Pouches will no longer drop Unlockstones.
The quantity of Magic Powder obtained when dissolving gear with Traits has been changed.
Extraction Stones can now be sold to shops as they are no longer used.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/f434536a235c8c9ea500f471ba27a419c491a557.png"]
Changed so the auto-acquisition grade filter option for Redfrost items can be selected from All, Rare or Higher, and Epic or Higher.

Ascended Archboss Grand Assault!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44224534/2fc072153d2cbc002360bd144cb74e35db914a8e.png"]
Available for 2 weeks, 4x Ascended Archbosses will spawn during each event instead of just 2.

items.text: Throne and Liberty update 4.3.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 15 and last approximately 3 hours.
A new Battlegrounds mode, "Seal Battle: Frostbite Fortress," has been added, and Battlegrounds Regular Season 2 begins.
A new Battlegrounds mode with relic transport and sealing mechanics has been added, and different Battlegrounds will be active depending on the day of the week.
Frostbreath Cave has been added to Dimensional Trials, and 4 new Guild Raids have been unlocked.
Additional rewards can be earned when playing Co-Op Dungeons and Raids with New/Returning characters.
A new 12 vs 12 matchmade Battlegrounds mode.
The objective is to transport relics to the enemy team's altar and seal them.
The first team to seal relics 2 times wins.
The base match time is 10 minutes; if no winner is determined, a 5-minute overtime period begins.
Air Raid: Appears with a certain probability when a relic is obtained.
Blitz: Appears near the center of the Battleground at regular intervals after the round starts.
New Achievements for Seal Battle: "Frostbite Fortress" have been added.
With the addition of the new Battleground "Frostbite Fortress," Regular Season 1 has ended and Regular Season 2 begins.
In Season 2, the Battleground mode changes depending on the day of the week.
Sunday - Tuesday: Conquest (Giant's City / Floating Elf Garden)
Wednesday - Saturday: Seal Battle (Frostbite Fortress)
A game rules guide has been added in the Battlegrounds menu so players can review the rules of each mode.
Frostbreath Cave has been added to Dimensional Trials.
Ascended Daigon
Ascended Leviathan
Ascended Pakilo Naru
Ascended Manticus
Available upon reaching Guild Level 30.
Additional rewards are provided when completing Co-Op Dungeons and Raids with New/Returning characters and claiming rewards.
Additional rewards can be obtained from the chest that appears after defeating the boss.
Achievements for Temple of Slaughter and Frostbreath Cave have been added.
Skill mechanics have been adjusted to prevent excessive damage accumulation and shield stacking, and Heavy Attack and Bonus Damage values have been adjusted per weapon.
A new "Weaken: Shock" effect has been added to the Spear, and Gauntlets' Eclipse of Blood now gains additional Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction per skill level.
Skill Core effects from previous Heroic armor and accessories have been incorporated into equipment options.

notes.title: Cumulative Growth Content: Stellar Journey has been added

items.text: Your in-game actions can now contribute to your character's growth.
The \[Stellar Journey] menu has been added to \[Main Menu]-\.
Stellar Journey becomes available after completing Adventure Codex > Prologue > Prelude. The Star-Born.
You can obtain "Starry Memory" from content such as the Adventure Codex, Exploration Codex, and Traces of Spacetime, and each Starry Memory permanently increases your Stats.
When "Starry Memory" is obtained in your inventory, it is used automatically.
Stat increases from "Starry Memory" are applied to each character that obtains it.
Starry Memory is not provided from Nebula Island in the Exploration Codex, or from the raids "Altar of Calanthia" and "Altar of Calanthia (Nightmare)."
You can check the maximum Stats that can be increased through "Starry Memory" and the Stats obtained so far through "Record of Stars."
Selecting each item in the "Stellar Journey" menu, such as Adventure Codex, Exploration Codex, or Traces of Spacetime, opens the corresponding menu.
When entering "Stellar Journey," a cutscene plays. You can skip it using the "Don't show cutscenes again" button in the lower-right corner.
In \[Main Menu]-\-\[Character Info], you can separately view Stat increases from "Starry Memory."
Rift Rebellions and Relic Fishing Locations have been added to each region in each dominion.
The Traces of Spacetime in each region can be viewed after activating that region's Waypoint.
You can obtain "Starry Memory" which grants Stats from Rift Rebellions and Relic Fishing Locations in each region.
Rift Rebellion
Rift Rebellion portals have been added to each region in each dominion.
You can obtain "Starry Memory" by completing objectives for each Rift Rebellion after entering them via the portal.
Relic Fishing Location
Relic Fishing Locations have been added to some regions of each dominion.
You can obtain "Starry Memory" by fishing at these locations.
When you reach 100% completion in Stellar Journey - Traces of Spacetime, 2 random Rift Rebellions and 1 Relic Fishing Location appear each day across all dominions.
Completing each objective grants a Special Resistance Medal, and progress resets daily at 10:00.

Throne and Liberty update 3.28.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 8 and last approximately 4 hours. It includes a new Battlegrounds map, the Brooch equipment slot, new Co-Op Dungeons, and balance changes. Check out the full list of changes below.

[p align="start"]Magical energy is surging across Solisium. As a result, Archbosses are becoming more active than ever. Until the start of maintenance on April 23, in accordance with the spawn schedule, 4 types of Archbosses and Ascended Archbosses will spawn simultaneously. Jump in now and take on the challenge against these even more formidable Archbosses.
During each Archboss event, 4x Archbosses will spawn instead of 2x.
1x Archboss will be a Guild event and the other 3 will be Portal events.
[p align="start"]A new map is now available for Battlegrounds: Floating Elf Garden.
The Battlegrounds map is set to Floating Elf Garden for the remainder of the season.
Matchmaking is now restricted to parties of up to 3 players.
Loosened matchmaking requirements to improve queue times.
Debuffs are now applied limiting healing and shield health depending on role type:
Tank: -95% healing, -95% healing over time
DPS: -95% healing, -95% healing over time, -95% shield health
Added more Achievement missions for Battlegrounds.
Dimensional Circle
Two new Co-Op Dungeons have been added to the Epic tier: Hellfire Crucible and Deathless Queen's Lair. These dungeons require a minimum of 5500 Combat Power to enter.
Co-Op Dungeon difficulty has been reclassified into 3 tiers: Epic, Elite, and Normal.
As a result, Fighting Spirit and Loyalty Adventure Coins can no longer be obtained from lower-tiered dungeons and will be replaced with Fortitude Coins.
All content previously granting Fighting Spirit or Loyalty Coins will now grant Fortitude instead.
Dimensional Trials
Doomrot Grove and Chapel of Madness have been added to Dimensional Trials.
New affixes added to customize challenge levels.
All tiers now grant 3000 points upon completion.
Reward chests will no longer spawn in Dimensional Trials.
Increased the Golden Chest spawn rate in tiers 9 and 10.
[p align="start"]A new accessory equipment slot has been added: Brooch!
The Brooch slot is available automatically to all characters after the 3.28.0 update.
Brooches can be acquired through various content such as Nebula Island, Co-Op and Solo Dungeons, and Archbosses.
Brooches support Gear Sync but cannot have runes attached.
New Achievement missions added related to Brooches.

Arena

Critical Hit Chance / Endurance: 2250 ~ -1500
Heavy Attack Chance / Heavy Attack Evasion: 2250 ~ -1500
CC Chance / CC Resistance: 900 ~ -600

Support your morph of choice until the very end, even if it means betraying a beloved, inferior favorite. How far will you go to make your morph the last one standing?
[img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/1417dyzwdFjJ8nW4KH5FGe/e5a99ddd3e1985a5d106b324926d32a3/TL_MorphMadness_WithText_1920x1080.jpg"]

Rep your morph, protect them both inside and outside of Solisium, and determine which one will receive a new skin. Welcome to Morph Madness, an elimination bracket where the most popular morphs will compete for supremacy over Solisium. Any Dash, Glide, Swim, or Special morph can win, but it is up to you to rally support around your champion.
Round One: Castle Gate (March 9 - March 16)
The qualifiers are entirely in your paws, claws, or mouth. Regardless of category, the top 16 morphs with the most time equipped in-game will reach the castle courtyard for round two.
Round Two: Castle Courtyard (March 16 - 23)

Get ready for the first elimination round featuring your top 16 qualifying morphs. In-game morph equips still matter, but Starbloom Festival races, community shares, and social media polls will also influence the results moving forward. Good luck breaking into the final four.
Final Round: The Throne Room (March 23 - 30)
The final four. Maybe your favorite is still in it or you’re seeking vengeance against the morph that struck down your dreams. Either way keep that momentum going and aspire for the throne.
Alongside announcing the event’s winner on March 31, we will also highlight our favorite community shares from throughout Morph Madness. We look forward to watching your treasured morphs shine.
Check out the announcement article for more information.

[p align="start"]Starting March 1, we will focus our marketing localization efforts for the Throne and Liberty website, campaigns, and marketing materials on English, Japanese, and German. items.text: Throne and Liberty update 3.19.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on January 28 and last approximately 6 hours. It contains the Tower of Greed, Lucky Mystic Portal event, Housing wall shapes, and more. Check out the full list of changes below.

[p align="start"]Investigate Calanthia’s past and the true purpose behind this mysterious tower. Throughout the Tower of Greed you’ll encounter randomly generated floors featuring unique rooms, mechanics, and quests. Difficulty scales with party size, making this PvE activity accessible for both solo and group players (maximum party size of 6). You can also save your progress or party up with different players at checkpoints following each floor. Discover why Calanthia was really here, overcome increasingly difficult challenges, and score even greater rewards as you climb the tower.

The Expedition duration is now determined by location instead of the previous 1, 2, 4, and 8 hour interval options.
Amitoi now become fatigued after returning from expeditions and cannot be sent on another expedition until they recover.
Matching Amitoi to their regional location type reduces both expedition duration and fatigue recovery time.
You can now run up to 3 expeditions simultaneously, one per region.
Completing expeditions grants both Expedition XP and XP for the Lifeskill associated with the gathered materials.
Completing expeditions grants progress toward unlocking a Boss Hunt Expedition, which offers bonus XP and rewards for a limited time.
Individual wall and fence shapes within houses can now be modified by crafting the desired shape from the Craft Furniture menu.
Two different sets of region-specific wall and fence shapes are available, one for houses in Kastleton and another for houses in Vienta Village.
Wall shape recipes require Adhesive, a new item crafted with Lime Powder and Volcanic Ash.
Lime Powder and Volcanic Ash are rarely obtained when gathering Rocks and Dirt respectively, or can be purchased from the Furniture Workshop Merchant for Life Coins.
Wallpaper and flooring can now be applied to individual sections instead of the entire house.
Collaborators can now be added in the Manage House menu, allowing other players to place furniture, move items, apply wallpaper, edit wall shapes, and apply flooring changes.
Collaborators can be added or removed at any time and can only place furniture already stored in the house, they cannot dye furniture or add new items to storage.
Furniture tooltips now display the total amount owned and which houses contain that specific furniture piece.
Players and NPC’s outside of a house are now visible from inside the home.
Artifacts: Individual stats on Rare Artifacts can now be swapped and upgraded using a new tab in the Artifact menu requiring materials obtained from the Tower of Greed.

Cosmetics: Custom Footprint, Return, and Morph visual effects can now be configured in the Mirror Boutique, also allowing for Return and Morph visual effects granted by DaVinci's Favor to be disabled if desired.
Codex: The Adventure Codex has been expanded with a new chapter, Oath Ritual.
Codex: Reduced the completion requirements for most Dimensional Circle Exploration Codex entries.
Combat Meter: Added a dropdown in the Combat Analyzer to view past encounter data and a reset button to the Combat Meter HUD widget.
Runes: Equipment type compatibility icons now appear in Rune tooltips.
Material Effects: Improved the Skills menu tooltip to display stat values based on equipped matching material types and added indicators for equipment slots with matching gear.
Inventory: Tab icons now display an indicator when the respective inventory tab is full.
Storage: Added a new button that automatically consolidates duplicate item stacks up to their maximum capacity.
Guild Treasure Chest notifications now show the individual items received rather than the chest icon.
Fixed an issue where allied guilds could be matched against each other in Boonstone and Riftstone battles when the stone was unclaimed.
Fixed an issue where rankings were displayed incorrectly in the Talisman Delivery Operation results window during Inter-Server events.
Fixed a rare issue preventing players from bidding on or receiving items via Guild Distribution.
Chat: Party Matchmaking links can now be posted in chat by Alt + Left Clicking options in the Party Matchmaking window.
Shop: Added additional information to Amitoi and Morph item tooltips.
Ore Selection Chests can now be opened directly within the Crafting NPC menu when insufficient ore is available for the selected recipe.
The Sollant cost displayed in the Crafter List now includes applicable taxes.
Added a search bar to the top of the item list.
The default sort order has been adjusted to group items with multiple crafting methods together.
A search bar has been added to the Settings menu.
A shortcut to swap between available Stellarite types has been added.
An 'Include Vanguard Members' option has been added to the Skill Effect Animation Display setting.
Adding "\[**]" to Greeting Messages in the Set Phrases Settings tab will now automatically replace the text with the respective character's name.
A yellow indicator now appears next to furniture that is required for accepted Contracts in the Furniture Crafting menu.
A yellow indicator now appears next to meals in the Cooking menu that are required for accepted Contracts.
Updated the Taedal's Tower Contract item icons so they can easily be differentiated from other contracts.
The item acquisition notification queue on the HUD will now clear when teleporting.
The Matchmaking button has been repositioned next to the Enter button in Co-op Dungeon, Trials, and Raid menus.
A new icon for the Weekly Mission widget will now display on the HUD after all Weekly Mission rewards have been claimed and improved all mission descriptions.
Fixed an issue causing the Astral Vision popup to appear when pressing 'PvP Counter' hotkey without taking damage from other targets.
Fixed an issue causing the latency value shown on the HUD to be much higher than it actually was after teleporting or while in large-scale battles.
Colossal Coliseum: Fixed an issue causing void tiles would appear without proper textures when viewed from across the arena.
Halls of Tragedy: Adjusted objects around the maze to prevent players from jumping over walls.

Tyrant’s Isle / Isle of Terror: Fixed an issue occasionally causing players to get stuck when moving to a geyser while in rat form, and slightly adjusted the position of crystals that were placed too close to geysers.
Fixed an issue causing shields from the same skill at varying levels to incorrectly stack on a target.
Fixed an issue causing the HP bar to not display multiple shield effects applied from different sources.
Adjusted the wording in various skill descriptions to clarify that the debuffs applied are Weaken effects.
Sword and Shield: Fixed an issue where Stalwart Bastion displayed an incorrect Damage Reduction value when Stalwart Ego Specialization was active.
Sword and Shield: Fixed an issue where the Movement Speed reduction from Annihilating Slash's Movement Speed Slowed Specialization bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Longbow: Fixed an issue where the Movement Speed reduction from Arrow Vortex bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Longbow: Fixed an issue causing the Devoted Shield Passive Skill to not activate when damaged by Orb Basic Attacks.
Staff: Fixed an issue where the Burning Weaken effect from Infernal Meteor and Hellfire Rain bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Staff: Fixed an issue where Velentra's Staff of the Charred Moon Weapon Skill description incorrectly displayed PvP Damage Taken debuff value as 0%.
Staff: Fixed an issue where the Healing Reduction from Infernal Meteor's Health Recovery Slowed Specialization bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Wand: Fixed an issue where the Movement Speed reduction from Ray of Disaster's Movement Speed Slowed Specialization bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Wand: Fixed an issue where the Endurance Reduction from Slothful Cage bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Spear: Fixed an issue where the Movement Speed reduction from Javelin Surge's Hamstring Specialization bypassed Weaken Resistance.
Spear: Fixed an issue where Junobote's Inferno weapon skill on Junobote's Extra Smoldering Ranseur failed to consistently apply the Ignite effect on critical hits.
Orb: Fixed an issue causing additional projectiles from Summon Satellite's Basic Attack effect to incorrectly be affected by Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction.
Orb: Fixed an issue where Orb Basic Attacks were not affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Orb: Fixed an issue where party members received the Distortion Veil effect after using Copy Satellite from Summon Satellite.
Orb: Fixed an issue where Celestial Guard Mastery failed to apply when using Distortion Veil from Summon Guardian Satellite.
Siege: Removed shelving along the perimeter of the throne room that prevented players from being targeted from certain angles.
Camera: Fixed camera zoom settings resetting after entering a Glide Morph.
Console: Fixed an issue causing textures to not appear properly on the Frost Warrior Staff.
Gigantrite/Minutrite: Fixed an issue causing players to occasionally fall through Gigantrite and Minutrite.
Floating Islands: Fixed an issue causing Lifeskilling XP to not be granted when gathering specific nodes.
Stability: Reduced memory usage on Xbox which led to frequent crashes.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

Throne and Liberty update 3.18.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on January 21 and last approximately 2 hours. It contains weapon changes alongside bug fixes. Check out the full list below.
Fireball Barrage: Added a new Specialization requiring 5 points.
When enabled, Fireball Barrage has an 80% chance to reduce the target's Damage Reduction by 30 for 5 seconds with a max stack count of 10.
Fireball Barrage's cooldown is increased by 9s when the Specialization is enabled.
This Specialization cannot be activated alongside the Mana Burn Specialization.
The Damage Reduction effect is only applied once even if multiple players hit the same target with Fireball Barrage while the Specialization is active.
Mastery: Added additional effects to Dark Apostasy.
Corrupted Obliteration and Obliterating Swamp now have an 80% chance to reduce the target's Damage Reduction by 40 for 3 seconds with a max stack count of 5.
Slothful Cage now has an 80% chance to reduce Shield Block Chance by 30% for 4 seconds.
Summon Satellite: Increased the damage dealt when using Stellar Dash from 145% + 53 to 181% + 66.
Summon Satellite: Decreased the damage dealt against monsters from 100% to 60%.
Summon Constellation: Added a new Specialization requiring 5 points.
When enabled, has an 80% chance to reduce Shield Block Chance by 30% for 4 seconds.
This Specialization can be used alongside the Milky Way Specialization.
Flash Wave: Fixed an issue causing the Range Increase Specialization to not increase Flash Wave's width.
The Indomitable Roar buff will be updated every minute rather than 2 minute cycles.
Indomitable Roar buff tiers 4 and 5 have been removed.
The score difference required to receive Indomitable Roar buff tiers 1, 2, and 3 have been adjusted:
20,000 points or more ~ Below 30,000 points: Attack Power +15%, Damage Taken -10%.
30,000 points or more ~ Below 50,000 points: Attack Power +20%, Damage Taken -15%
50,000 points or more: Attack Power +25%, Damage Taken -20%.
Fixed an issue causing the CC Resistance reduction to not immediately apply while interacting with a Control Stone when the Indomitable Roar buff was updated.
Action Mode: Fixed an issue preventing skills from being used while hovering the cursor over a target without it being selected.
UI: Fixed an issue causing a Cumulative Access Rewards window to occasionally appear when changing instances.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.
Throne and Liberty Update 3.17.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on January 14 and last approximately 4 hours. Find the full list of changes below.

Fight back invaders from the Arkeum Legion for unique rewards including a new gesture, Shapeshift Morph, and Chaos Prisms after maintenance through January 28. Remember to exchange your event currency with special NPCs in town to reap your hard-earned spoils of war.
The Arkeum Invasion field event will spawn 3x per day on weekdays and 4x per day on weekends, across multiple zones.
Monday - Friday (UTC): 01:30, 12:30, 17:30.
Saturday and Sunday (UTC): 01:30, 12:30, 17:30, 21:30.

Various Skills, Specializations, and Masteries that result in additional projectiles/hits will no longer apply Bonus Damage, have their incoming damage reduced by Damage Reduction, or have additional effects from other Skills, Specializations, or Masteries applied. See a list of everything impacted below.
Damage Reduction and Bonus Damage from all Armor Set effects, Weapon Skill effects, Food buffs, Artifacts, Mastery nodes, and Stat Achievement effects have been doubled.
Stalwart Bastion: Increased Damage Reduction from 103 to 123 and the Front Damage Reduction from 20 to 24.
Controlling Rake: Increased Damage Reduction when hit from behind from 25 to 50.
Counter Barrier: Decreased damage dealt from 250% of the players Damage Reduction to 125%.
Spectrum of Agony: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Mastery: Roar Amplifier is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
DaVinci's Courage: Increased Damage Reduction granted by the respective Specialization from 25 to 30 and Front Damage Reduction from 10 to 12.
Devastating Tornado: The Additional Damage Specialization is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Devastating Tornado: Fixed an issue causing players to receive the Bind: Icebound effect upon reaching 11 Weaken: Frost stacks instead of 10 while the Ice Tornado Specialization was active.
Blood Devotion: Fixed an issue causing the Damage Reduction value to display as 40% even while the Damage Transfer Increase Specialization was inactive.
Devoted Shield: Increased Damage Reduction from 50 to 60.
Flash Arrow: Fixed an issue causing the AoE size of the skill preview to not match the actual size of the skill's effect while the Range Increase Specialization was active.
Roxie's Arrowhead: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Mastery: Roxie's Arrow Storm is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Nature's Power: Increased Bonus Damage from 26 to 58 and Skill Damage Boost from 19 to 25.
Piercing Strike: Increased Bonus Damage from 13 to 36.
Nimble Leap: Fixed an issue causing the Whirlpool area to not last for the full duration while the respective Specialization was active.
Explosive Trap: Fixed an issue causing the trap to not last for a full 10s while the Duration Increased Specialization was active.
Recoil Shot: Fixed an issue causing the Offhand Weapon Attack Increase Specialization to not grant the described benefit.
Recoil Shot: Fixed an issue causing twice as many Gale stacks to be applied than expected while both the Gale and Wave Shot Specializations were active.
Mother Nature's Protest: Fixed an issue causing a 30% Movement Speed debuff to be applied while the Frost Shot Specialization was active instead of 10%.

Mother Nature's Protest: Fixed an issue causing the additional damage from the Lightning Shot Specialization to not transfer to another enemy when the target has a Frost debuff applied by the Greatsword's DaVinci's Chill or Ice Tornado skills.
Mother Nature's Protest: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Mortal Mark: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Protective Satellite Summon: Removed the 50% Shield Health boost when used on party members with the satellite effect.
Protective Satellite Summon: Added a new effect increasing Distortion Veil's Shield Health by 20% for each orb in range.
Stellar Dash: Increased Damage Reduction from each stack of the Pierce Damage Specialization from 20 to 40.
Stellar Dash: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Stellar Echo: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Rift Fracture: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Summon Satellite: The Basic Attack Effect is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Cleaving Moonlight: The Additional Damage Specialization is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Umbral Spirit / Thunder Spirit: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Mastery: Venomous Edge is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Inner Peace: Direction-specific stats are no longer considered while the Thunder's Blessing Specialization is active.
Mastery: Flame Discipline is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Vampiric Contract: Fixed an issue causing the skill effect to not trigger on Staff and Orb Basic Attacks.
Mastery: Fixed an issue causing damage from Slothful Cage to only last for 3s instead of 5s while the Dark Apostasy Rare Tactics Achievement Effect was active.
Mastery: Direction-specific stats are no longer considered when using Slothful Cage while the Dark Apostasy is active.
Mastery: Abyssal Burst is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Mortal Wrath: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Bloodleech Aura: Direction-specific stats are no longer considered when using the skill.
Falling Flower: Fixed an issue causing some on-hit skill effects to be triggered multiple times when damage was applied.
Lightning Speed: Bonus Damage and Damage Reduction no longer affect damage dealt.
Tevent's Fangs of Fury / Tevent's Inferno Fangs: Added a 10 second cooldown to the Tevent's Furious Rage weapon skill.
Flashfire Fanatic: Added an "on attack" trigger condition to the Endurance reduction 4-set effect causing it to apply for 3s.
Lucien's Repeaters of Termination: The Silver Reaper's Soul Harvest Weapon Skill is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Akman's Bloodletting Crossbows: The Akman's Fragment Weapon Skill is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Luminous Longbow of the Abyss: The Stealthy Arrowhead Weapon Skill is no longer affected by Bonus Damage or Damage Reduction.
Tevent's Grasp of Withering: Adjusted the Tevent's Hunger weapon skill description to state that it deals 100% increased damage against monsters.

Treacherous Tome of the Abyss: Fixed an issue causing the shield effect granted by the Spectral Defense Rare Defense Achievement Mastery Effect to not spread to allies when using the Blessed Haze weapon skill.
Reckless Repeaters of the Abyss: Updated the Acidic Poison Weapon Skill description to state that the Weaken: Poison effect only stacks up to 10 times.
Wrap of Uncanny Nimbleness: Fixed an issue causing the item to state it grants Heavy Attack Damage Resistance rather than Critical Damage Resistance.
The Indomitable Spirit buff granted to the losing team now scales based on how much they are losing by:
4,000 points or more ~ Below 6,000 points: Attack Power +15%, Damage Taken -10%.
6,000 points or more ~ Below 10,000 points: Attack Power +20%, Damage Taken -15%
10,000 points or more ~ Below 15,000 points: Attack Power +25%, Damage Taken -20%.
15,000 points or more ~ Below 25,000 points: Attack Power +30%, Damage Taken -20%, HP +15%.
25,000 points or more: Attack Power +35%, Damage Taken -20%, HP +30%, Movement Speed +15%.
The score difference will be checked every 2 minutes for the buff to be updated.
CC Resistances will now be changed when interacting with a Control Stone, also scaling with the Indomitable Spirit buff:
No Buff: All CC Resistances -40%.
Tier 1 Buff: All CC Resistances -30%.
Tier 2 Buff: All CC Resistances -20%.
Tier 3 Buff: All CC Resistances -10%.
Tier 4 Buff: All CC Resistances +20%.
Tier 5 Buff: All CC Resistances +30%.
Added settings to display equipped weapons in place of a guild icon within player nameplates.
Added a shortcut to cycle through the equipped Stellarite type.
Added a new shortcut to open the Vanguard List.

Skill Specialization: Fixed an issue allowing more than 100 Skill Specialization points to be allocated in some rare cases. Characters with more that 100 points allocated will have their Skill Specializations reset upon logging in.
Housing: Added Tevent table, chair, bed, and lamp furniture pieces.
Fixed an issue causing the incorrect weapons to occasionally be shown in player's Character Cards and on Scoreboards.
Fixed an issue causing the Total Housing Rating to appear as 0 when viewing your own Character Card.
Cosmetics: Fixed an issue causing the Kowazan's Daggers of the Blood Moon to appear with white textures.
Achievements: Fixed various Gathering-related Achievements which weren't tracking progress correctly.
Storage: Fixed an issue preventing items from being deleted from Storage after its expiration date has passed.
Codex: Fixed an issue preventing the Tiny Friend's Swimming Practice Exploration Codex quest from being started.
Fixed an issue causing the designated Special Morph to be reset upon relaunching the game.
Fixed an issue causing players to suddenly drop to the ground when gliding long distances.
Raids: Fixed an issue preventing players from obtaining rewards when dying during Calanthia's first phase on the Difficult and Nightmare difficulties.
Map: Fixed an issue causing Wild Red, Blue, and Yellow Herb map indicators to not be displayed.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

Throne and Liberty Update 3.12.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on December 10 and last approximately 4 hours. It includes a new Christmas event, balance changes, and more. Find the full list of changes, alongside various fixes, below.

[p align="start"]Join us in spreading holiday cheer by participating in the Startree Solstice event! Running from December 11 - December 31, this event is filled with activities ranging from a new Amitoi Arena to holiday-themed contracts.
Added a new Extra Codex Quest serving as an event guide.
Join the Amitoi Snowball Fight Arena through the Special Events menu, granting Startree Coins after winning a set number of times.
Use Golden Paste Bait to catch fish worth up to 10,000,000 Sollant each.
Amitoi Expeditions will grant Startree Solstice Food Selection Chests equal to how many hours the Expedition ran for.
Startree Solstice Helper Contract Scrolls are available as Attendance Event rewards, granting additional Startree Coins when completed.
Additional Startree Coins are granted when receiving rewards from Co-op Dungeons and Trials.

Startree Coins can be spent at the Startree Coin Exchange Merchant available in Kastleton, Vienta Village, and Herba Village to obtain new cosmetics, furniture, Noble Chaos Rune Selection Chests, Unlockstones, and more.
Mastery: Roar Amplifier now decreases the user's Defense by 7% instead of a flat 250.
Mastery: Power Breach now decreases the user's Defense by 7% instead of a flat 200.
Mastery: Devoted Strike now decreases the user's Defense by 9% instead of a flat 200.
Mastery: Blade Momentum now decreases the user's Defense by 14% instead of a flat 300.
Mastery: Increased the Skill Damage Resistance from by Unyielding Aegis from 100 to 150.
Mastery: Further decreased the Melee Heavy Attack Chance from Unyielding Aegis from -200 to -350.
Mastery: Increased the CC Resistance granted by Unshakeable Will from 150 to 200.
Mastery: Increased the Damage Reduction granted by Unshakeable Will from 15 to 20.
Mastery: Adjusted the decrease in Base Damage granted by Unshakeable Will to be -13% rather than a flat 25.
Mastery: Adjusted the decrease in Base Damage granted by Life's Bargain to be -16% rather than a flat 33.
Mastery: Life's Bargain will now decrease Base Damage for every 100 Health up to a cap of 40,000 Health rather than 30,000 Health.

Giant Cordy's Ascension Greatsword: Fixed an issue causing the Enraged Giant Cordy's Spore Poison weapon skill to deal 2.5% of the target's max health over 4s instead of each second for a 4s duration in PvP.
PvP: Doubled the amount of potential spawn points for Elites.
PvP: Elites now spawn within a 7 minute window rather than a set time.
PvP: The map icon showcasing the Elites location is now only shown while in close proximity to it.
PvP: The red pillar of light shown at the upcoming Elite spawn location will now only display 1 minute before it spawns instead of 3 minutes.
PvP: Added a notification when an Elite is defeated.
Enemies will now respawn in Syleus's Abyss 6F after a Territory Event has taken place.
Battlegrounds: The current Pre-Season will wrap up on 12/18.
Battlegrounds: Added 2 new Titles available from the Combat Coin Merchant after achieving a Ranking of 1,500 or higher and 500 or higher.
Housing: Fixed an issue blocking furniture from being placed on a specific wall in Kastleton 3-4.
Housing: Added interactions to Chairs and Beds placed inside houses.
DaVinci's Favor: Added notifications shown when DaVinci's Favor expires, or expired while offline.
Minutrite / Gigantrite: Added an Event Information window displaying expected rewards when selecting the Minutrite or Gigantrite icon on the Map.
Codex: Fixed an issue occasionally causing players to get stuck in a table during the Home, Sweet Home Extra Codex Quest.
Pitons: Fixed a piton that could not be interacted with in Abandoned Stonemason Town.
Crafting: Fixed an issue allowing only 1 item to be favorited at a time in the Crafting menu.
Cosmetics: The Jolly Orb has been re-added to the Mirror Boutique.
Archboss: Ascended Tevent and Queen Bellandir once again grant 8x Archboss Materials instead of 4x as Conquest Rewards.
Material Transmutation: T3 gear can now be added to Material Transmutation and can be received as rewards from Tier 5 Transmutation.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the Guardian list from being scrolled in the Combat Settings menu.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.
