Throne and Liberty Update 3.11.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on December 3rd and last approximately 8.5 hours. It includes the Hyperboost Server Integration, Abyss Dungeon Events, new Tier 3 gear, Combat Meter, and more. Find the full list of changes, alongside various fixes, below.
[p align="start"]We're completing the integration of Hyperboost servers with Legacy servers.
The "Hyperboost" tag on the Server Selection screen has been removed.
Players in Legacy servers can now transfer to/from Hyperboost servers.
All inter-server content will now match players in Hyperboost servers with players in legacy servers.
The Hyperboost server Auction House has been merged with the Legacy server Auction House instance in each region.
Any active posts on the Hyperboost server Auction House will be force-canceled and returned to Storage.
Any unclaimed Lucent in the Hyperboost server Auction House will be added directly to your account balance.
Any Guild items posted on the Hyperboost server Auction House will be canceled and returned to the Guild Storage Chest.
Any undistributed Guild funds from items sold on the Hyperboost server Auction House will remain available in the Profit Distribution menu.
Abyss Dungeon Events have been added, starting at 18:00 and 21:00 local server time daily and running for 1 hour.
Two Abyss Dungeons will have the event preset during each timeslot.
Abyss Dungeon events can either be Peace or War.

During Peace events, defeat enemies within the Abyss Dungeon to obtain a buff. Once enough stacks of the buff have been received, a chest can be opened which spawns every 5 minutes to receive rewards. Only 1 chest can be opened each event.
During War events, rewards will be received upon defeating an Elite enemy within the Abyss Dungeon which will spawn 3 times throughout the event.
Enemies spawned during the event will be level 55 in all Abyss Dungeons.

notes.title: New T3 equipment pieces have been added including

items.text: 9x new Weapons, each with a new Weapon Skill.
4x new Armor sets, each with new set effect bonuses.
2x new Cloaks.
4x new Necklaces, Bracelets, Earrings, and Belts.
8x new rings.
The new T3 gear is primarily obtained from Abyss Dungeon Events, but can also be obtained as drops from Archbosses and Nebula Island.
A Combat Meter is now available, accessed through the Ring Menu.
Add the "Turn On Combat Meter" option to the Ring Menu in the Ring Menu Settings > Quick Menu section.
Turn on the Combat Meter from within the Ring Menu.
The Combat Meter can be moved from within the Edit HUD menu.
Only stats for your personal damage dealt will be displayed, damage from other players will not be shown.
The Combat Meter will only track combat against boss-type enemies within Solo Dungeons, Trials, Co-op Dungeons, and Raids, as well as Practice Dummies in Safe Zones.
A detailed breakdown of skills used and stats related to them can be viewed in the Combat Analyzer, opened through the Ring Menu or by clicking on the Combat Meter on the HUD.
A Detailed Combat Log file can be generated on PC which can be started/stopped through a separate Ring Menu option.
The Equipment and Stats presets have been expanded to include Runes attached to equipment as well.
The layout of the Rune Book menu has been adjusted so gear in the equipped loadout is more visible.
Each Preset allows for different Runes to be equipped on the same item.
Chaos Runes can be equipped to multiple items, so long as it isn't equipped to another item within the current preset.
With the release of 3.11.0, Rune Slots on all gear pieces will be reset.
Runes on all gear will be unequipped and returned to the Rune Book.
Expect to see a drop in Combat Power upon logging in until Runes are re-equipped.
As compensation, all players will receive 10,000,000 Sollant to cover the cost of setting up your first Rune Preset.
Added a Furniture Storage Chest, available upon achieving 7,800 Housing Power.
The Furniture Storage Chest serves as a shared storage place, separate from your inventory.
Furniture can be moved from your Inventory into the Storage Chest for free.
Furniture can also be moved from the Storage Chest to any owned house for free.
Furniture can be moved from a house into the Storage chest, however this will require Furniture Tickets.
The Furniture Storage Chest can hold 50 items by default, which can be expanded to 140 slots with Sollant, then 340 slots with Lucent.
Placed furniture can now be dyed.
Gather new herbs found throughout Solisium to collect different color Dyeing Materials.
Collected Dyeing Materials can be used to craft Dye Ampoules within the Furniture Workshop Crafting Table.
A new Dyeing tab is available while in Arrange mode.
Furniture can have up to 4 different sections that can be individually dyed.
Applying a color to any section of a specific furniture piece will require 1x Dye Ampoule of the matching color.
Dyes applied to furniture will be retained even if the furniture is moved back into Storage or another house.
The base number of slots available within the Miscellaneous Inventory tab have been increased from 100 to 120.
Queen Bellandir Bed, Lamp, Table, and Chair can now be crafted requiring Queen Bellandir's Soul Fragments, Vitalstones, Rare gathered materials, and Additives.
Over 40 new Lifeskilling-related Achievements have been added.
Added a toggle to hide/show your character while in Arrangement mode.
Added a toggle to hide/show Arrangement mode shortcuts.
The Manage House menu can now be opened from the Main Menu while outside your home.
Added a filter option for the number of starred stats on Artifacts.
Added a filter option allowing for searches of Artifacts containing a set number of selected Sub Stats.
Selected search criteria is now displayed at the bottom of the Search Criteria menu and at the top of the results list.
Added a shortcut to the Material Transmutation menu in the Artifact menu.
Artifact Material Transmutation now grants significantly more Artifacts in the form of Rare Artifact Selection Chests, however each tier will require more points.
Quick Fire: Fixed an issue causing a higher amount of damage to be applied to Weakened enemies than intended.
Quick Fire: Increased the damage boost against Weakened enemies from 20% +7 to 30% + 10.
Lucien's Repeaters of Termination: Adjusted the Silver Reaper's Soul Harvest weapon skill to grant 25 stacks of Soul Harvest when using Mana Exchange while the Effect Boost Specialization is active.
Mastery: Fixed an issue causing the Abyssal Burst Epic node to not function when attacking a target from a higher elevation.
Arena S4 will end on 12/18. Season 5 will start immediately afterwards.
S5 will revert back to 3v3 matches instead of 6v6.
Trials: Elite tier dungeons are now included in the Dimensional Trial rotations.
Co-op Dungeons: Removed the role requirement when matchmaking for Entry, Normal, and Elite tier dungeons.
Added a new Extra Codex Quest: Tales Flowing Through the Desert.
Shop: Increased the quantity of Noble Rune Chance Chests received from the Ornate Coin Shop offer from 1 to 10.
Morphs: Up to 10 Glide, Dash, and Swim morphs can now be designated. Each time a morph form is entered, 1 of the designated Morphs for the respective type will become active.
Items: The Exit Game confirmation message will now display a warning listing all items expiring within 24 hours.
Battlegrounds: Adjusted how the schedule is displayed within the Battlegrounds menu.
Battlegrounds: Fixed an issue rarely causing options shown in the Accept Battlegrounds Match popup to be disabled.
Combat Coin Merchant: Replaced the Noble Equipment Chance Chest: Antimagic with a chest that contains some of the newly added T3 gear.
Nebula Stone Merchant: Added a new Greater Nebula Accessory Chance Chest available once weekly for 30x Greater Nebula Stones.
War Games: Added a toggle to allow or prevent Spectators from joining.
Guild: Added a View Probability button in the Guild Rewards menu to showcase potential rewards from the Guild Treasure Chest.
Chaos Runes, Chaos Rune Chance Chests, and Chaos Rune Selection Chests present in your Inventory can now be destroyed.
Vanguard: Party Invite links can no longer be sent or accepted after a Party is converted into a Vanguard.
Added Cooking Ingredient Merchants to the Guild and Legion Bases.
Achievements: Fixed an issue preventing the Running Dry, Normal Dimensional Trials Conqueror, and Normal Dimensional Trials Overlord Achievements from completing.
Controller: Fixed an issue causing the Check Placement Size toggle within the Shop to not function.
Solisium Sage: Fixed an issue preventing the Defeat Field Bosses objective from progressing when defeating T2 or T3 Field Bosses.
Morphs: Fixed an issue rarely preventing movement when landing while in a Glide Morph.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

topNew: 9x new Weapons, each with a new Weapon Skill.
4x new Armor sets, each with new set effect bonuses.
2x new Cloaks.

items.text: Throne and Liberty Update 3.9.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on November 19 and last approximately 4 hours. It includes the new Rift Rebellion event, plus a variety of weapon balance tweaks. Find the full list of changes below.

[p align="start"]Temporal portals have appeared in Herba Village and Stonegard Castle where historical attacks against the cities are unfolding once again. Help protect the cities and their citizens to earn unique rewards including new Titles, an Amitoi, and Gathering Materials.
The Rift Rebellion event will occur 3x per day on weekdays and 4x per day on weekends:
Mon ~ Fri: 18:30, 20:30, and 22:30 local server time.
Sat ~ Sun: 16:30, 18:30, 20:30, 22:30 local server time.
Event locations will alternate between Stonegard Castle and Herba Village.
Quick Fire: Decreased damage from 150% of Base Damage +32 to 135% of Base Damage +32.
Quick Fire: Added a +100% damage buff against monsters.
Quick Fire: Removed the 30% additional damage buff against other players from the Damage Specialization.
Quick Fire: Increased the damage boost granted by the Damage Specialization from 20% to 30%.
Nimble Leap: Decreased the distance travelled from 5m to 4m.
Shadow Strike: Decreased the attack range from 12m to 9m.
Shadow Strike: Decreased the additional range granted by the Skill Range Specialization from 40% to 20%.
Camouflage Cloak: Decreased the stealth time from 7.5s to 6s.
Camouflage Cloak: Decreased the additional stealth time granted by the Duration Increased Specialization from 1.5s to 1s.
Cleaving Moonlight: Added a +50% damage buff against monsters.
Umbral Spirit / Thunder Spirit: Added a +100% damage buff against monsters.
Fatal Stigma: Increased damage from 405% of Base Damage +110 to 490% of Base Damage +140.
Fatal Stigma: Increased the damage boost against monsters from 40% to 80%.
Fatal Stigma: Increased the maximum damage boost granted by the Damage Specialization from 30% to 50%.
Precision Dash: Decreased the attack range from 12.5m to 9m.
Precision Dash: Decreased the additional range granted by the Skill Range Specialization from 20% to 10%.
Stunning Blow: Decreased the stun duration from 3.2s to 2.7s. The stun duration from Heavy Attacks has decreased as well from 3.7s to 3.2s.
Stunning Blow: Decreased the additional stun duration granted by the Effect Duration Increase Specialization from 1s to 0.8s.
Devastating Smash: Decreased the stun duration from 2s to 1.5s.
Mastery: Decreased the additional stun duration granted by the Stun Duration Augment Uncommon Tactics node from 0.5s to 0.4s at level 10.
Gale Rush: Decreased the attack range from 16m to 12m.
Rising Slash: Decreased the attack range from 12m to 9m.
Abyssal Cleave: Decreased the stun duration from 2.9s to 2.28s.
Strategic Rush: Decreased the attack range from 11.6m to 9m.
Chain Hook / Controlling Rake: Decreased the attack range from 11.6m to 9m.
Chain Hook / Controlling Rake: Decreased the additional range granted by the Skill Range Specialization from 3.75m to 3m.
Sword and Shield: Fixed an issue allowing the cooldown of Piercing Strike to be immediately reset when combined with Counter Barrier and the Agile Strike Crossbow Mastery node.
Zephyr's Nock: Increased damage against monsters from 20% to 40%.
Decisive Sniping / Decisive Bombardment: Increased damage against monsters from 110% to 140%.
Strafing: Increased damage against monsters from 25% to 40%.
Ensnaring Arrow: Decreased the bind duration from 5.5s to 4.2s.
Ensnaring Arrow: Increased the oppress duration from 5.5s to 6.3s.
Mastery: Decreased the additional bind duration granted by the Greater Bind Duration Augment Rare Tactics node from 1s to 0.8s at level 10.
Icebound Tomb: Decreased the movement speed debuff duration from 4s to 3s.
Icebound Tomb: Decreased the freeze duration from 6.3s to 4.9s.
Ice Spear: Decreased the movement speed debuff duration from 3s to 2.5s.
Cursed Nightmare: Decreased the sleep duration from 6s to 4.6s.
Summon Satellite: The effects applied when using Distortion Veil have been removed.
Summon Satellite: The benefits from the Satellite Copy Specialization are now granted by default.
Summon: Satellite: The Satellite Copy Specialization has been re-worked:
This Specialization now grants additional effects when using Distortion Veil instead of Basic Attacks and Stellar Dash.
The required number of Specialization Points has been reduced from 10 to 7.
The name of the Specialization has changed to Summon Guardian Satellite.
Supernova Collapse: Decreased the stun duration granted by the Enhanced Link Specialization from 3s to 2.5s.
Interstellar Explosion: Decreased the stun duration granted by the Stun Specialization from 3s to 2.5s.
Brute Slayer: The 4-set effect now only stacks up to 4 times, down from 5.
Tevent's Omniscient Eye / Tevent's Cinderdust Eye: Added a +200% damage buff against monsters to the Tevent's Corruption weapon skill.
Housing: Added an "All" tab in the Furniture Crafting menu to view all available furniture.
Guilds: Added settings to manage Archboss Item Acquisition Settings separately from other equipment.
Skill Points: Added an icon next to Stat Points in the Character Info menu when they are above the cap of 99.
Floating Islands: Additional islands are now available across each Gigantrite and Minutrite flight path.
Floating Islands: Map icons have been added showcasing floating island locations.
Codex: Fixed an issue preventing various objects from being interacted with during Chapter 14.
Battlegrounds: Fixed an issue rarely causing the Resurrect button to be permanently disabled after dying.
Battlegrounds: Fixed an issue preventing purchases which required a specific ranking at the Combat Coin Merchant when Ranking Points were greater than 1,000.
Controller: Fixed an issue causing the Max Quantity shortcut to not function in the Shop.
Vanguards: Party invitation links can no longer be created while in a Vanguard.
Performance: Fixed an issue occasionally causing characters to disappear while in large-scale combat, preventing skills from being used.
Daggers: Fixed an issue causing Phantom Smokescreen's 30% Cooldown Reduction to not be granted by Deluzhnoa's Piercing Daggers weapon skill.
Controller: A/X can now be used to claim rewards from the end of week Dimensional Trial Ranking Reward popup.
Archboss: Ascended Queen Bellandir and Ascended Tevent Conquest Rewards now grant 8x Archboss Materials instead of 4x.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

Throne and Liberty Update 3.7.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on November 5 and last approximately 3 hours. It includes ranked Battlegrounds, the party and guild ping system, and bug fixes. Find the full list of changes below.
[p align="start"]Ranked mode is now available for Battlegrounds!
The ranked pre-season is estimated to last 6 weeks.
Initially, ranked mode will only be available 16:30 ~ 19:30 and 22:00 ~ 01:00 local server time daily.
Ranked mode can only be queued for as an individual, entering with a pre-formed party is not permitted.
Additional items are now available at the Combat Coin Merchant, locked behind a specific ranking requirement.
If not enough players are available to start a 24 vs 24 Battlegrounds match, an 18 vs 18 match will be started instead.
Once matched with 36 players, 12 additional players will be searched for before the match starts.
If the remaining 12 players cannot be found, the match will commence as 18v18 with a new score limit of 80,000.
Healing teammates now grants points within Battlegrounds matches.
10 points, times by any active multipliers, will be granted for every 50,000 health healed.
Score is only granted for effective healing, over-healing will not grant points.
Equipped weapon combinations are now displayed on the Scoreboard.
A new ping system is available to Parties and Guilds, allowing players to place down a temporary indicator.
4 different ping types are available: Attack, Warning, Move, Support.
Pings will be displayed for 5 seconds before disappearing.
On Mouse and Keyboard, shortcuts to access this feature will be unbound by default.
Key bindings to open the Ping menu can be adjusted in the Shortcuts and Features tabs of the Settings menu.
With a Controller, pings can be accessed through a new tab in the Ring Menu.
When viewing the Ping menu, a shortcut will be available to switch between Party/Guild pings.
For Parties, new settings within the Party Management window are available controlling who can use pings.
For Guilds, these settings can be found in the Guild Settings menu.
Minutrite and Gigantrite lamps and bed furniture have been added.
This furniture will require new Divine Beast Crystals obtained from either Gigantrite or Minutrite, alongside rare gathered materials, Vitalstones, and Additives.
New floating islands can now be found around Solisium, only accessible by riding on Gigantrite or Minutrite.
A mix of existing and new gatherable nodes will be available on each island granting all tiers of gathered materials with increased yield and higher chances to receive Rare materials.
These islands will also have nodes available which can be collected to acquire Vitalstones and the new Divine Beast Crystals.
Divine Beast Crystals obtained directly from Gigantrite and Minutrite will be untradeable, but will have a chance to be tradeable when obtained from the floating islands.
This new furniture is Epic tier and will grant significantly higher Housing Power compared to Rare tier furniture.
All newly available furniture has a small chance to grant a Great Success when crafted, resulting in a tradeable variant.
Gathering now grants full XP regardless of your current gathering level.
3x Common tier materials are now received when the respective Gathering lifeskill is level 15.
Gathered materials can now be dissolved to receive a lower-tier material at a 1:1 ratio.
The chance of a gatherable leather node dropping from an enemy has been decreased from 40% to 20%, however the quantity of materials received have been roughly doubled.
A new processing queue slot is now available upon reaching level 8 in the respective Processing skill.
A set of 5x Furniture Tickets can now be purchased from the Furniture Workshop Merchant with Sollant.
Added tags indicating the type of furniture displayed displayed at the bottom of the item tooltip.
Search bars in the Manage Storage and Arrange Housing menus can now be used to search for furniture tags.
Players that own multiple houses can now teleport to each from the Manage My House menu.
Interaction sounds have been added to various light fixtures within houses.
The quantity of gatherable nodes on Minutrite will now scale with the tier reached during the Healing Touch for Divine Beasts Dynamic Event.
Skill Core Imprint Scrolls can now be purchased from the Raid Goods Exchange Merchant with Sollant.
The recipe to craft Skill Core Imprint Scrolls has been removed.
Equipment Transferring is now available for Heroic Armor and Accessories of different types (i.e. transferring a Heroic Ring to a Heroic Bracelet, or a Heroic Helmet to a Heroic Cloak).
Heroic gear can now be used within the Sync menu, allowing T3 gear and other Heroic items to by synced to it.
Shields of the same type cast by other players no longer stack including:
Wand: Excavator's Mysterious Scepter, Spectral Defense, Invincible Wall
Sword and Shield: Blessing of Immortality
Orb: Distortion Veil
The Unshakeable Will and Replenishment mastery achievement effects are now applied when using Concentrated Barrier as well.
Stellar Dash: Damage has been reduced.
Damage from the projectile fired has been decreased from 580% of Base Damage +210 to 290% of Base Damage +105.
Damage from the projectiles fired from summoned orbs has been decreased from 191% of Base Damage +69 to 96% of Base Damage +35.
Damage against monsters is increased by 100%.
Summon Satellite: Damage has been reduced.
Damage dealt when using Stellar Dash while the Satellite effect is active has been decreased from being equal to damage dealt by Stellar Dash to 145% of Base Damage +53.
The Movement Speed Debuff granted by Supernova Collapse has been removed.
Focused Fire Bombs: Damage has been increased from 510% of Base Damage +516 to 595% of Base Damage +602.
Ice Spear: Damage has been increased from 430% of Base Damage +77 to 510% of Base Damage +92.
Ice Spear Bombardment: Damage has been increased from 86% of Base Damage +15 to 102% of Base Damage +18.
Judgement Lightning: Damage has been increased from 780% of Base Damage +356 to 880% of Base Damage +402.
DaVinci's Courage: Buffs granted by DaVinci's Courage will no longer stack.
Phantom Smokescreen: The Improved Smokescreen Specialization will no longer grant its effects while not inside the smokescreen area.
Mortal Mark / Detonation Mark: Damage is now capped at 50,000% of Base Damage.
Steady Aim: The Critical Damage increase buff is now affected by Buff Duration.
A new Vanguard Notification chat channel has been added, matching how the current Guild Notification chat channel functions.
Messages in this channel can only be sent by the Vanguard Lead and Party Leads within the Vanguard.
All messages sent in this channel will be displayed as a banner at the top of the screen for each member in the Vanguard.
Hyperboost: Field and Arch Boss events on Hyperboost servers will now only include players from other Hyperboost servers.
Dimensional Trials: The percentage chance of receiving a Golden Chest has been increased:
Tiers 1~5: Percentage chance is equal to the tier number
Tiers 6~8: 10% chance
Tiers 9 and 10: 13% chance
Material Transmutation: Added settings to automatically transmute materials upon reaching a specified level, also allowing selection of a specific equipment type to receive as a result.
Arch Boss: Increased the quantity of Ascended Archboss Fragments received from participation rewards.
Arch Boss: Combat Power granted by enhanced Arch Boss weapons has been increased.
Skill Cores: Crafting recipes have been added allowing T2 Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy Skill Cores to be upgraded to their T3 variants.
Combat Power: Enhanced the tooltip shown when hovering over the Combat Power value in the Character Info menu to display Combat Power sources and the maximum value each can provide.
Items: Enemy loot can once again be picked up by walking over it.
Cooking: Meals placed in Storage can now be used when turning in Cooking Contracts.
Cooking: Recipe items that can only be obtained once can no longer be sold to vendors.
Cooking: A system message has been added when attempting to turn in a locked item to complete a contract.
Cooking: If you already own a Recovery Crystal recipe, then the respective recipe can no longer be purchased from the Contract Coin Merchant.
Cooking: Cooking vendors are now shown in the How to Acquire menu for various items.
Path of Ascension: Adjusted Mission 13 in Step 3 to "Kill 20 monsters" instead of "Defeat a Party Matchmaking Boss".
Gate of Infinity: Achievement Rewards will no longer be displayed in the ranking rewards popup when a Gate of Infinity dungeon rotation has ended.
Dynamic Events: Increased the requirements to reach tier 3 in the Healing Touch for Divine Beasts co-op event.
Lithograph Book: Improved the owned and required quantity display of Meals and Fish.
Crafting: Favorites will no longer be reset upon leaving a cross-server instance.
Amitoi House: The Content Notifications panel on the HUD is now displayed while inside the Amitoi House.
Matchmaking: Penalties granted by leaving a Dungeon before defeating the boss are no longer account-wide.
Vanguard: Fixed an issue occasionally causing HP indicators shown on the Vanguard HUD to be inaccurate.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing Weapon Skins from being equipped in the Illusion Workshop.
Skills: Fixed an issue causing the number of charges a skill has to be incorrect when 2 or more skills that have charges were present on the skill hotbar.
Furniture: Fixed an issue making the Hallow's Eve Velvet Curtain difficult to place due to its shape.
Furniture: Fixed an issue causing some parts of the Classic Arched Drawers to disappear when viewed at a distance.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 3.5.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on October 22 and last approximately 4 hours. Read on for the full list of changes.

[p align="start"]Sweet rewards, spooky decorations, and creepy cosmetics return in Haunted Harvest now through November 13. The Haunted Labyrinth event-only dungeon is also back. What tricks will your guild carry out alongside these treats?
[p align="start"]For more details on Haunted Harvest event activities, look forward to our dedicated article later this week.
Daylight Savings Time will impact European server regions after maintenance, three days earlier than real-world adjustments due to the need for downtime to shift server schedules.
With these adjustments to European servers, your local reset time will shift 1 hour earlier, remaining fixed at 08:00 UTC.
Dynamic Events, Riftstone/Boonstone, Bosses, Siege, etc. will adjust to maintain their current local time slots and the scheduled time will be visible in the in-game schedule.
Battle Pass, Arena, Weekly Mission, and NPC resets will shift time 1 hour earlier on European servers, remaining at 08:00 UTC.
After maintenance is completed, characters on servers newly added with 3.0.0 will be able to transfer to Legacy servers. Characters on new servers can no longer transfer to other new servers.
UI has been improved to allow direct viewing of extract lists when selecting material items.
The amount of Blessing Points used during enhancement attempts is now displayed.
Items that are locked, have runes applied, or are equipped in equipment sets will appear darkened in the material list.
Cooking: Material merchants have been added near cooking hearths in Kastleton, Vienta, and Herba Village, as well as Stonegard Castle. General Merchants will no longer sell cooking ingredients.
Players using DaVinci's Favor can summon the cooking material merchant Solia for immediate access.
Targeting: Removed some unnecessary effect icons when targeting other PCs (such as Gigantrite buffs, Guild Skills).
UI: When editing the Main Menu layout, category names can now be changed (only available on Keyboard+Mouse settings).
UI: Adjusted so that HUD Display and My Party Default HUD Display settings in Raid Settings are maintained after leaving a raid.
Inventory: Added Item Search function to Storage Chest and Inventory.
Mirror Boutique: Added search function to cosmetics menus.
Cloaks: Added the Show Cloak option to Character info so you can show or hide your currently equipped cloak.
Photo Mode: Players may now chat while in Photo Mode.
Party: Fixed a case where you were unable to select stealthed allied party members.
Housing: Fixed several instances of incorrect, unexpected furniture placements.
Movement: Fixed occasionally falling to the ground while attempting to ascend repeatedly during gliding.
Dimensional Circle: Specter's Abyss, Death's Abyss, Abyss of Corruption: Fixed a case where normal mobs could enter boss areas in these dungeons.
Valley of Slaughter: Corrected Turka's AoE attack range.
Runes: Fixed an issue causing the Inventory menu to open when entering "i" into the search bar in the Rune Book menu.
Raid: Fixed an issue causing Lightning Orbs to not spawn when Dragaryle reached 50% health during specific mechanic flows
Achievements: Fixed an issue causing the 'A Great Big Help', 'A Bite-Sized Meal', and 'No Way Out' Achievements to not complete after meeting its criteria.
Processing: Fixed an issue causing placeholder text to appear in place of the owned item quantity when viewing a Processing recipe requiring items that are contained within a chest.
Chat: Fixed an issue causing text to get cutoff when typing a chat message spanning more than 3 lines.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the Party Matchmaking and Party Board buttons from functioning in the Co-op Dungeon menu.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the 'Leave Battlegrounds' button from working within the match results screen.
Controller: Fixed an issue causing the Battlegrounds Matchmaking popup to disappear when Circle/B is held while it's displayed.
Nimble Leap: Immune specialization now has a 3 second cooldown.
Weak Point Shot: Shield Weakening specialization now deals 500% fixed damage to already shielded targets.
Inject Venom: PvE damage increased from 60% to 100%.
Brutal Incision: PvE damage increased from 15% to 50%.
Thundering Bomb: PvE damage increased from 40% to 50%.
Vampiric Strike: Shield Health Reduction specialization now deals 320% fixed damage to already shielded targets.
Frenzied Sword Dance: Added 50% PvE damage boost.
Raging Frenzy: Now receives skill damage boost effect when applying Shock to targets.
Death Blow: Cooldown reduction specialization adds 50% cooldown reduction for Guillotine Blade when hitting Shocked targets.
Valiant Brawl, Cruel Smite, Guillotine Blade: PvE damage increased from 120% to 140%.
Decisive Sniping, Decisive Bombardment: PvE damage increased from 85% to 110%.
Brutal Arrow: Added Oppressed to the list of target effects that receive additional damage.
Steady Aim: Added effect: 20% Critical Damage increase for 4 seconds when applying Oppress.
Strafing - Mobility specialization: Fixed an issue where skills couldn't be used at certain heights.
Distorted Sanctuary: Fixed an intermittent display issue affecting floating damage text 'Miss' labels.
Stellar Dash: Damage reduced
Previous damage: 680%+240 base, 272%+96 orb effect.
New damage: 580%+210 base, 191%+69 orb effect.
for both base damage and orb effect damage.
Void Slash: PvE damage increased from 40% to 60%.
Interstellar Explosion: PvE damage increased from 40% to 60%.
Supernova Collapse: The effect that reduces movement speed to 0 has been adjusted so that it reduces movement speed by 80%.
Weapon Mastery: Stacking Echo: Number of additional projectiles has been reduced from 12 to 9.
Weapon Mastery: Flow Shift: Orb effect damage boost has been decreased from 35% to 25%. Shield Health reduction value for Distortion Veil and Guardian Defensive Wall has been reduced from 30% to 25%.
Weapon Mastery: Seer: Heavy Attack Damage increase has been reduced from 26% to 20% at level 10.
Vicious Fury, Brutal Fury: PvE damage increased from 40% to 60%.
Cyclonic Fury: PvE damage increased from 80% to 100%.
Counter Barrier: Concentrated Barrier specialization reduced from 7 points to 5. Specialization adds reduction to target's Bonus Damage by 5 for 6 seconds.
Morokai's Soulfire Greatblade: The Morokai's Thunderbolt effect that was being applied while ignoring the target's defense has been corrected.
Tevent's Fangs of Fury, Tevent's Ascended Blade: Tevent's Furious Rage and Enraged Tevent's Furious Rage effects have been modified to only trigger against PvP targets.
Ahzreil's Soulless Sword: Skill effect values have been adjusted. Shield Survival Technique now increases damage reduction by 250 while in use.

Cornelius's Blade of Dancing Flame: Skill effect changed. After hitting with Provoking Roar skill damage, the area explodes in a 4m radius after 3 seconds, dealing 400% of base damage to targets in the area. Struck targets have their Bonus Damage reduced by 125 for 5 seconds.
Chernobog's Incubus and Fire Poison's sleep precursor state will no longer increase CC immunity values.
Fixed an issue where Malakar's Blazing Wind effect was not being applied in certain situations.
Fixed an issue where buffs were not properly activating on some shields when 'Chaos Harbinger: Lunarstone' was applied.
Fixed an issue where targets affected by Silver Reaper's Codex of Law's Silver Reaper's Sentence debuff were taking excessive damage under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue where some animations for Deluzhnoa's Ascended Staff's Enraged Deluzhnoa's Hail were not displaying.
CC Chances are now granted when Plate Armor is equipped while using a Spear.
Tier 3 Armor options have been added to the Manticus Equipment Selection Chest.
Cosmetics: Fixed an issue preventing the Flashfire Fanatic Hand Guards and Boots from being dyeable.
Cosmetics: Fixed an issue causing the Kastleton Academy Attire outfit to appear with low resolution textures when used with the feminine body type.
Epic Tier 3 set effects have been modified to be affected by Buff Duration stats.
Blood Knights Assassination Hood's duplicate 'Mana Cost Efficiency' trait has been changed to 'Health Regen'.
Flashfire Fanatic
4-set effect has been modified to apply a cooldown.
Fallen Dynasty's 4-set effect has been changed to increase Base Heavy Attack Damage by 10% and increase Heavy Attack Damage by 10% on Heavy Attack hit (max 3 stacks).
Steel Juggernaut's 4-set effect now includes Magic Endurance, and all Endurance values have been increased to 250.

Battlegrounds base protection: a new protection buff now applies when you're in range of your team's base, increasing survivability. When entering the enemy team's base, the protection debuff will cause you to take additional damage.
AFK player indicators have been added.
Fixed an issue causing the incorrect information shown when viewing an opponents Character Card within the Battlegrounds Scoreboard.

items.text: New Ascended Arch Bosses have been added: Ascended Giant Cordy and Ascended Deluzhnoa.
The health of Arch Boss Queen Bellandir and Arch Boss Tevent have been increased.
Talandre Archboss weapons' main stats have been upgraded to Epic Tier 3.
Ascended Archboss weapons' main stats have been upgraded to Epic Tier 3 or higher, with 1 additional stat added.
New Ascended Archboss weapons have been added.
Crafting recipes for 9 new Epic tier 3 Ascended Archboss weapons have been added.
Previously extracted Archboss Skill Cores may now be reverted to Archboss weapons through newly implemented crafting recipes.
These recipes require fragments dropped by the respective Archbosses
Upgraded fragments for Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy weapons have been added
Archboss Skill Cores converted back to weapons using this method are automatically advanced to +12 enhancement
When moving to a new house or making a purchase, purchase condition fulfillment is now clearly displayed.
House icons on the map have been changed to icons that show house size.
Added filtering functionality in Placement and Storage Management to view furniture based on placement status.
Added search functionality by furniture name in Storage Management.
The waiting time before renaming owned houses is now displayed on the rename button.
Added option to check actual placement size when crafting furniture or purchasing from special shops.
Scores for furniture items that were the same grade but had somewhat lower scores have been increased.
[p align="start"]New Guild Contracts have been added. The appearance rates of existing guild contracts have been adjusted.
Complete Resistance Contract
Defeat Field Boss
Complete Abyss Dungeon Contract
Defeat Co-op Dungeon Boss
Guild Contract Reward Changes: Some contract rewards have been changed. Base materials provided from Abyss Dungeon type guild contracts will be replaced with Abyssal Stone Fragments.
Guild Merchants: New items have been added to the guild merchant's inventory.
Guild Dynamic Event rewards have been adjusted.
Guild Raids: Guild raid information will now be displayed in notifications during raid progress. When selecting "Exit," players will return to the Guild Base.
Guild Storage Expansion: Item grade settings for Guild Storage have been expanded.
Fixed an issue causing Korean text to be displayed in the Sync menu if opened before reaching level 50.
Fixed an issue causing debug text to appear in the Achievements menu while playing in German.
Altered the weapon skill description of Cornelius's Blade of Dancing Flame to state that it only activates while using Provoking Roar's Additional Damage Specialization.
Altered the description of the 'Shining Brightly Together' Achievement to indicate that it can only be completed within Guild or Dominion Events.
Adjusted the description of the Orb's Eternal Veil Passive Skill to state "Shield Health" instead of just "Health".
Clarified the weapon skill description on Junobote's Blade of the Red Colossus to indicate that it's only activated when using skills that apply Stun or Shock.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!
THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 3.2.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on October 1 and last approximately 5 hours. Find the full list of changes below.

notes.title: THRONE AND LIBERTY ONE YEAR ANNIVERSARY

items.text: [p align="start"]It's been one year since launch, and we're so happy to have you with us! The team has a variety of in-game and out-of-game events planned to celebrate the occasion and thank you, our players, for your time with us.

[p align="start"]The Fortune's Calling event returns, with improvements to Fortune Stone earning and reward redemption! Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions for a chance to score extra rewards like the Golden Archboss Weapon Selection Chest throughout this event.
[p align="start"]LOGIN REWARDS

Log in for the event-specific Anniversary Gift Box containing fireworks, an emoji, and a headband. Other login rewards include an Anniversary Housing Cake, an Anniversary Profile Frame, Unlockstones, Entropy Shards, Chaos Prisms, Obsidian Fragments, and Conversion Stones.
[p align="start"]OREMONG HIDE AND SEEK
Hide and Seek Oremong returns with anniversary-specific rewards like Rare Housing Decorations, an Amitoi Selection Chest, and a new Title. Good luck in your search.
Orb: Fixed some Orb items not properly displaying on the character model.
Housing: Added a confirmation pop-up when moving to a new house.
Housing: Added a tutorial pointer that guides players to unlock Housing.
Housing: Fixed an issue where wallpaper and flooring from a visited house were shown on your own house if you owned one at the same address.
Ascended Arch Bosses: Unified the Ascended Arch Boss names and removed 'Frenzied Flame' text.
Movement: Fixed a case where characters could get stuck in the air when jumping while moving.
Party Board: Getting accepted into a Vanguard via the party board now cancels all other pending Party Board applications.

Battlegrounds: After reviewing Battleground queues and player feedback, we have no present plans to restrict Battleground matches to specific times of day. Battlegrounds will remain available around the clock!
Battlegrounds: Added the ability to keybind the battleground Scoreboard, defaulting to caps lock key when in Battlegrounds.
Battlegrounds: Added end of match result messages indicating Victory, Defeat, or Draw.
Battlegrounds: Battle Commander and Healing Master morphs: Additional health gained now recovers immediately.
DaVinci's Favor: Interacting with Solia will no longer place players in a non-combat state.
Processing: New recipes have been added, allowing you to bulk-process 10x of common materials.
When using bulk processing recipes, experience gain is halved.
When using bulk processing recipes, Great Success rate chance is 0%.
Fluff buff: Sheep gathering success rate increased from 70% to 80%. Gathering time reduced from 5 seconds to 4 seconds.
Controller: 'Go to My House' button added to the main menu when using a gamepad.
Map: Minimum level requirements for gathering levels are now displayed with gathering icons on the map.
Fishing: Fishing Codex rewards updated from Precious Base Material Selection Chest to Rare Cooking Ingredient Chance Chest.
Gathering: Fixed an issue where gathering mining nodes on Gigantrite did not grant Mining experience.
Morphs: Zenith Firebird: Fixed a case where character hair color was being incorrectly displayed on the Zenith Firebird model.

Abyssal Dungeons: Fixed an issue causing the Map to appear incorrectly within Syleus's Abyss 3F.
Abyssal Dungeons: Fixed an issue causing some assets to temporarily disappear when jumping while in certain locations of Syleus's Abyss 2F.
Raid: Fixed an issue occasionally causing the blue/red markers to not appear above players when Dragaryle's shield mechanic interrupts his fear mechanic.
Fixed an issue occasionally causing Lucien to get stuck in a wall within the Fate's Abyss Epic Dungeon.
Corrosive Veil and Hellfire effects will now choose random targets instead of selecting based on highest aggro.
Hellfire: Fixed an issue where Hellfire effect was not displaying properly at low graphics settings.
Thorn Armor: Now has a brief warning animation before activating, and damage reflection is limited to a maximum of 10 triggers per second.
Items: Fixed an issue causing some Accessories to have a Material type listed in their tooltip despite not granting a Material Passive effect.
Items: Fixed an issue preventing the Belt of Hypocrisy from being craftable with a Lithograph.
Items: Fixed an issue causing the Necromancer Visage Headpiece to appear incorrectly on consoles.
Items: Fixed some Skill Conversion Books that could not be placed in storage.
Fixed an issue where Lucien's Mercurial Greatblade's Silver Reaper's Gag Order effect was silencing melee and ranged skills.
Lucien's Code of the Heretic's Silver Reaper's Sentence effect duration increased from 2s to 3s, and fixed so duration is not affected by stats.
Grand Aelon's Longbow of Blight's Grand Aelon's Vitality effect now applies to party members.
Blood Hunter’s 4-set effect now displays stack count when stacked.
Morokai's Soulfire Greatblade's \[Morokai's Lightning] effect now works based on base damage at the time of attack.
This update contains adjustments to the high damage combo of Orb and Crossbows, among other skill changes.
Mastery: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect amount of damage to be applied for each stack for the Timebomb Overall Mastery Skill.
Camoflauge Cloak: Fixed an issue causing stealth to be cancelled by regular attacks triggering immediately after using this ability.
Phantom Smokescreen: Specialization: Back Attack: Fixed this specialization effect not being affected by buff duration bonuses.
Mastery: Dexterous Power: Fixed an issue where this effect would not apply when the Dexterity stat was 89.
Selfless Diffusion: The weaken duration increase is now limited to a maximum of 100 applications.
Serial Fire Bombs: Damage against monsters increased from 60% to 80%.
Focused Fire Bombs: Damage against monsters increased from 120% to 160%.
Fireball Barrage: Damage against monsters increased from 60% to 90%.
Touch of Despair, Corrupted Magic Circle, and Tevent's Grasp of Withering: Damage against monsters increased by 100%.
Specialization: Stellar Dash: Fixed an issue where consecutive attack detection was incorrectly set to 3 seconds. Adjusted damage boost per stack from 10% to 8%.
Temporal Leap: Effect now only applies cooldown reduction to Attack and Control skills.
Afterimage Explosion: Fixed an issue where weapon swapping would not work properly when using Afterimage Explosion with Orb not active.
Overcome Crisis: Activation conditions adjusted. Now activates when attacking an enemy within 10 seconds of being affected by the listed special conditions.
Time Bomb: Fixed an issue where damage per stack was being applied incorrectly.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 3.1.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on September 24 and last approximately 6 hours. It includes various bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Find the full list of changes below.
Weekly Missions: The 470-point weekly mission achievement reward has been changed to 'Noble Blessing Pouch: Nebula'.
Nebula Island is now accessible on newly added servers.
Matchmaking: Matchmade content, such as Dungeons and Battlegrounds, on new servers will now be locked to only include other new servers.
Dimensional Trials: Increased the score points accumulated for clearing each tier of Dimensional Trial.
Guild Raid: Guild Activity Scores for Tier 3 bosses are now all equal.
Shop: Extra Solisium Leveling Passes and Artisan Passes may now be Dissolved for Lucent.
Housing: Fixed an issue where furniture placement was blocked when in action mode.
Crafting: Quality Paper: Corrected the crafting materials from Lumber to Paper.
Crafting: Rare Paper: Corrected the crafting materials from Quality Lumber to Quality Paper.
Gathering: Fixed an issue causing a Sandstone Area icon to be shown on the map for Logging Sites in Bercant Manor.
Gathering: Fixed an issue causing a Logging Site icon to be shown on the map for a Soil Area in Swamp of Silence.
The "Randomized Dungeon Party Matchmaking" Path of Ascension missions can now be completed when queuing for a random dungeon while in a party.
Lithograph Book: Adjusted so that Uncommon, Rare, and Epic items can be registered in the Lithograph Book at level 1.
Carmine Rage Island: Fixed a case where the Goblin Shaman's heal ability was not able to be interrupted.
UI: Chat: Fixed an issue where the chat tab icons were reset to default on each login.
UI: An error message is now displayed when attempting to claim items from the Achievements menu while your inventory is full.
UI: Fixed an issue causing roles to be offset with role counts in the Battlegrounds Matchmaking Request popup.
Controller: Fixed an issue causing some skills to not light up on the hotbar while in range of a target.
When a Battleground ends, players now return to their pre-matchmaking location.
Decreased HP values for golems and special morphs.
Thunder Breaker now appears 9 minutes after the start of the match, instead of 10. Players must wait 60 seconds before taking control of Thunder Breaker, up from 10 seconds.
Tier 3 Equipment: Added the missing token crafting recipes for the Flashfire Fanatic armor set.
Fixed three Orb lithographs that were untradable when they should be. This fix also applies to existing owned Lithographs: Eletrum Orb, Shadowy Sphere, Azure Nexus Sphere.

The Wristlet of Cold Revenge, Sash of Rustling Leaves, and Locket of Unregretted Sin can no longer be turned into Lithographs. Note that Crafting NPC's will still have a recipe available that uses the Lithograph for players that have already converted the item.

New recipes have been added to NPC crafters allowing the Sash of Rustling Leaves and Locket of Unregretted Sin to be crafted with Giant Cordy's Branch and Snow Flowers respectively. Note that a recipe to craft The Wrist of Cold Revenge with Giant Cordy's Branch already exists.
Fixed an issue causing Grand Aelon's Longbow of Blight Weapon effect to not apply to party members.
The Plate Material Effect granted when a Spear is equipped now properly states that it grants CC Chance instead of CC Resistance.
Fixed an issue causing Rex Chimaerus's Crossbows to appear incorrectly when zoomed out.
The Zenus Orb obtainable from Twitch Drops can now be obtained from the Storage Chest.
Weapon Mastery Conversion Books can now be placed in Storage.
Mirror Boutique: Fixed a case where Appearance: Boots of the Executioner displayed incorrectly on female models.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support and we’ll see you in Solisium!

THRONE AND LIBERTY Solisium’s Awakening Update (3.00.0) downtime will begin at 6:00 p.m. PT (1:00 a.m. UTC) on September 17 and last approximately 13 hours. Servers will not open before 7:00 a.m. PT on September 18.
What's up Gamers, I am absolutely bursting with excitement as we prepare to unlock the biggest chapter yet in Throne and Liberty's journey!

This massive update isn't just about new content—it's about building a home together, literally and figuratively, as we introduce Housing where you can finally put down roots in Solisium. We're orb-solutely thrilled to put a new weapon in your hands, while Battlegrounds will let you prove your worth against fellow players, and our revamped Dimensional Trials will challenge even the most seasoned warriors. With Hyperboost welcoming both familiar faces and fresh blood into our growing community, plus Tier 3 gear to chase and new dungeons to conquer, I can honestly say we're just getting started on this incredible adventure.
Thank you for being the heart and soul of this community—together, we're not just playing a game, we're building a world, and the best is yet to come!
Read on for the full list of new content, events, store offerings, and other changes here. Thanks for your support and we'll see you in Solisium!

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.26.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on September 3 and last approximately 6 hours. Find the full list of changes below.
The maximum number of guilds that can be joined in an Alliance is now 2 instead of 4.

We will be monitoring the ongoing impact of this change and feedback from the community as we understand there are a range of opinions on Alliance limits, and will consider additional modifications if necessary.
To support this change, existing Alliances will be disbanded to allow guild leaders to re-form alliances with the second guild of their choice.

notes.title: AVAILABLE NAME REFRESH - Deleted Characters and Guilds

items.text: Names previously used by characters or guilds that have been deleted will be available again for use after this maintenance.
The 30-day cooldown period after performing a Server Transfer has been reset in preparation for upcoming content releases.
Coming soon: Mischievous citrus have been spotted popping up in Laslan, Stonegard, and Talandre regions.
Roll out and find the hiding Oremong to ponder their prize list!
Rumor has it, these friendly citrus are selling Rainbewe morphs, titles, portrait frames, fishing rods, and more.
Arena: Season 3 is now scheduled to end on September 17 with the start of maintenance.
Console: Fixed an issue causing players to get automatically kicked shortly after joining a Party or Vanguard.
Wand: Players who are tethered with Ray of Disaster now properly take damage when moving.
Wand: The Ray of Disaster's "Concentration Effect Time" specialization now properly grants a damage boost.
Wand: Ray of Disaster now properly deals damage to a 2nd target after the 1st target dies.
Wand: Fixed an issue causing Vampiric Contract to occasionally stop providing its benefits.
Greatsword: Blood Devotion's "Damage Transfer Increase" specialization no longer displays 2 different values for how much it increases transferred damage.
Spear: Updated the description of the Mortal Wrath skill from "...the attack always becomes a Heavy Attack" to "...the attack always triggers from a Heavy Attack", matching it's functionality.
Localization: Fixed an issue causing Korean text to display in the Heroic Accessory Trait Info page.
Cosmetics: Fixed an issue with the Azure Moon Weapon skins causing the 3rd dye slot to not update the expected areas.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.24.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on August 20 and last approximately 4 hours. Prepare for your fiercest adversary yet in Altar of Calanthia Nightmare Difficulty, plus the introduction of customizable Headstones. How will you be remembered? Special rewards will also be available through the Solisium Grand Morph Festival, Mystic Portal: Lucky Pouch, and Call to Arms Archboss Guild Raid events. Here are the full list of changes.

notes.title: Altar of Calanthia: Nightmare Difficulty Unlocked

items.text: The increased difficulty "Nightmare" mode for the Altar of Calanthia raid is now available.
Featuring increased boss stats and new mechanics, Nightmare mode also offers new and unique rewards for overcoming its challenge.
Players must have 7,000 combat power or higher to enter Nightmare mode.
Defeating Nightmare mode Calanthia guarantees a Heroic accessory drop and a chance to acquire a Nightmare-specific Morph.
Players who defeat Calanthia in Nightmare mode will receive a specially-colored title, 'Calanthia's Nightmare'.
For raid groups who defeat all three phases of the raid with no single player death, they will also receive a specially-colored title, "Total Nightmare".
Five new Heroic grade accessories have been added to the Raid currency shop.

notes.title: Altar of Calanthia: Difficult Mode Adjustments

items.text: Resolve of the Star Fragment: When a team is fully defeated on any boss in Difficult Mode, all players will receive a damage and HP buffs for additional attempts. This buff stacks up to 5 times and can only be applied once every 3 minutes.
Dragar'yle: In phase 2, the number of lightning summoning devices required to be placed on the statue has been changed from 2 to 1.
Dragar'yle: Added an effect that pulls the lightning summoner during the Dragaryle pattern (allowing the use of summoners attached to walls).
From August 21 through September 18, the Solisium Grand Morph Festival comes to town!
Take part in Morph Races throughout the event to collect Festival Commemorative Medals. Trade in your Medals for event-specific rewards including an updated Morph, Gesture, Profile Frame, and Title.

Collect special meal ingredients through daily check-ins, Amitoi Expeditions and Fishing to craft a limited-time event meal that provides bonus Sollant and weapon specialization gain as well as increased Abyssal coin efficiency.

notes.title: Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event - Queen Bellandir

items.text: Between August 21 and September 3, guilds will have access to a special version of the Arch Boss Queen Bellandir fight as a Guild Raid.
The Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
Guilds may enter the Queen Bellandir guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
Defeating the Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
In this run of the Call to Arms event, Guild Raid Queen Bellandir will also drop the new material used in upgrading Bellandir weapons.
Punishment Stones purchased for the Tevent Guild Raid event will be removed during maintenance, and cannot be used for the Queen Bellandir event.

From August 21 through September 3, receive a Plentiful Lucky Pouch when opening Mystic Portals and Mystic Globes. Lucky Pouches contain varying amounts of Sollant, including a chance at a 100,000,000 Sollant prize.
Customized Headstones are all the rage in Solisium! Decease in a style that suits your personality. Pull fast, die often, and leave a pretty grave.
Dying in PvE encounters will leave behind the headstone you've selected through customization.
Dying in PvP will display the customized headstone choice of your killer.
Custom Headstones are set in the new section of the Mirror Boutique, under 'Appearance Effect'.
Dimensional Trial Season End Date: Corrected the display of the current Dimensional Trial Season ending date in the UI.
Rewards will be sent automatically at the completion of the current Dimensional Trial season.
Sword and Shield: Fixed an issue allowing Counter Barrier to block some skills every 0.1 seconds instead of 0.5 seconds.
Wand: Ray of Disaster now damages multiple targets when the Targets Expanded Specialization is applied.
Spear: Fixed an issue causing Rising Slash to not go on cooldown when blocking at the same time it was used while Deluzhnoa's Serrated Shard was equipped.
Archboss: Fixed an issue allowing Tevent to be attacked from a Safe zone in PvP events.
Combat Settings: Fixed an issue preventing some options from being changed within the 'Current' Comat Settings tab.
Chat: Arrow keys can once again be used to navigate the list of chat commands.
Runes: Chaos Rune favorites are now saved when relaunching.
Controller: Controller users can now use the "Follow" option (foot icon) from the Party HUD to quickly move to another player's instance.
Performance: Fixed an issue causing the client to hitch when changing body types in the Change Appearance menu.
Shop: Fixed an issue causing all Shop offers to be displayed in English when launching the game after previously selecting a non-English language.
Localization: Fixed an issue causing Korean text to be displayed in the Sync menu if opened before reaching level 50.
[p align="start"]Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.22.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on August 6 and last approximately 5 hours. It includes the return of the Archboss Guild Raid event, Mystic Portal Treasure Hunt, and more. Find the full list of changes, plus various bug fixes below.

notes.title: Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event Returns

items.text: Between August 6 and August 20, guilds will have access to a special version of the Arch Boss Tevent fight as a Guild Raid.
The Guild Raid version of Tevent has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
Guilds may enter the Tevent guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
Defeating the Guild Raid version of Tevent will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
In this run of the Call to Arms event, Guild Raid Tevent will also drop the new material used in upgrading Tevent weapons.
From August 6 through August 20, daily login rewards will grant you special Mystic Keys. Open Mystic Portals to play a treasure-hunting minigame!
Hunt down hidden treasure chests through different puzzles for a variety of rewards, including an Amitoi, Morph, and character progression materials!
Artifacts: Default artifact inventory size is now 300 slots, expandable up to 500.
Summer Splash: Fixed an issue causing additional Splash Coins to not drop upon defeating enemies while Gigantrite's buff was active.
Queen Bellandir of the Frenzied Flame: Fixed an issue where this version of Queen Bellandir could become un-attackable if a section was destroyed during the leap attack.
Tevent: Fixed an issue allowing Tevent to be attacked from unintended safe locations.

Sword and Shield: Stalwart Bastion: Reduced duration from 9 seconds to 6 seconds. Targets affected by Stalwart Bastion must wait 45 seconds before receiving Stalwart Bastion effects from other casters. This does not apply to effects from the same caster.

Controller: Fixed an issue causing the previously selected rune slot to be updated instead of the current one when adjusting socket types.
Controller: Fixed an issue where skill tooltips would always be shown despite settings selected to not show them.
Raids: Adjusted the movement animations when teleporting between raid locations.
Matchmaking: Fixed an issue causing the accepted role highlight to display incorrectly when the Matchmaking Successful prompt is shown twice before all players have accepted.
Dungeons: Fixed an issue causing the first room in the Crypt of Augmentation to appear much brighter than intended while using Low graphics settings.
Combat Settings: Fixed an issue causing hotkeys to activate when entering a name for a Combat Setting preset.
Auction House: Removed various Earring Lithographs from the Auction House that cannot be obtained.
Shop: Fixed an issue preventing the Congratulatory Packages granted upon completing Chapters 5, 7, 9, and 13 from being displayed in the Shop.
Battle Pass: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect weapon skin to be shown when selecting the Daggers, Crossbows, Staff, or Longbow from the Desert Star Shop.
Fixed an issue that rarely prevented any movement beyond dodge-rolling until relaunching the game.
Battle Pass: The Tidal Weapons and Skill Core Imprint Scroll can now be purchased from the Summer Splash Shop.
Battle Pass: The quantity of Abundance Fruit, Mastery Report, and Dimensional Contract Token II items received from the Summer Splash Shop have increased from 1x to 2x.

Fixed a case where skill effects could display incorrectly when changing weapons that had their appearance customized.

Fixed an issue causing hair to appear translucent on the Eternal Archer Headpiece when dyed silver.
Fixed an issue causing parts of tattoos on the Summer Splash outfit to not display correctly.
Morphs: Fixed an issue causing the Iron Tsarca to not be available in the Morphs menu.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.20.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 23 and last approximately 6.5 hours. Find the full list of changes below.

Hunt down Tidebully Goblins, join the Splash Bash arena for refreshing fun, and receive a Blessing of Summer Buff from Beach Party Gigantrite. The Summer Splash event will send waves across Solisium from July 24 through August 13.

Beyond the sandcastles, colorful parasols, and tropical decorations will be event exclusive fish, cooking recipes, and login rewards. Earn Splash Coins through different festivities for event-specific rewards like the Llama Playful Morph or check out the Store for new summer swimsuits.
For more details on the festivities, see the event article \[HERE].
Optimized some large-scale combat FPS performance for content like Arch Bosses, Field Bosses, and War Games. Significant FPS improvements should be noticeable depending on your hardware setup.
Improved performance when casting multi-target skills against large groups, and reduced motion blur and camera shake effects triggered by critical hits on multiple targets.
Improved positional desync when jumping onto or off of lifts or breezelines.
Improved movement desync when landing on a sloped surface when gliding.
Fixed a client hitch encountered when entering the underground section of Doomrot Grove.
A Miscellaneous inventory has been added to store Fish and Cooking Ingredient type items.
The default storage size is 100 slots, expandable up to 300 slots.
Currently stored Fish and Cooking Ingredients will be placed in your warehouse, and once moved into the Lifestyle inventory, cannot be stored in the warehouse again.
The layout of the Artifact UI has been adjusted to make it easier to see the bonuses of individual artifacts in your inventory.
Added search functionality so you can search Artifacts by set, primary, and secondary stats.
You can also save search filters for easy re-use.
Added the ability to compare a selected artifact against a currently equipped artifact's stats.
Added recommended artifact equipping based on saved search filters.
Added bulk lock and unlock functionaliy for artifacts.
Combat: Fixed an issue preventing some heal over time effects from applying.
Precious Health Regen Crystal
Overture of Eternal Salvation Wand
Greatsword: Davinci's Courage
Arch Boss Weapons: Skill Cores extracted from Tier 1 Arch Boss Weapons can now be crafted into the upgraded Tier 2 version Arch Boss Skill Core.
Davinci's Favor: Weekly Resistance Contract missions now count the additional completion bonus from Davinci's Favor.
Davinci's Favor: Gaining Abyssal Contract Tokens while having an amount above max quantity will no longer reset your total to the max quantity.
Nebula Island: You can now purchase Advanced Nebula Stones for 15 Nebula Stones at the Nebula Stone Merchant.
These items no longer need to be crafted using Nebula Essence, and Nebula Essence is no longer available. Dissolve any leftover Nebula Essence to receive 5 Nebula Stones.
Nebula Island: Reduced the Map Icon clutter at the entry point for Nebula Island.

Nebula Island: Exodus and Grimturg now appear at the same time on the Sunday Nebula Island schedule. We'll keep an eye on feedback and participation after this schedule adjustment and may adjust it again in the future.
Arena: Completing the Weekly arena mission will now automatically grant mission rewards and display them as a system message in the chat window instead of requiring an additional UI confirmation.
Boss Instances: Slightly increased the amount of time between the boss' death and the instance closure to allow players who resurrect late in the fight additional time to pick up loot.
Field Boss: Increased the common rune rewards from Field Boss rune boxes.
Arch Boss: Fixed the Peace and Dominion gates for Giant Cordy despawning after 3 minutes instead of 5 minutes.

Arch Boss: Deluzhnoa: The terrain below Deluzhnoa no longer rotates to increase combat stability and performance. Some of Deluzhnoa's skills have been adjusted to account for the change in ground movement to keep a more dynamic fight experience.
Dagger: Specialization: Thundering Bomb: Fixed an issue preventing Thundering Bomb from consuming Thundercloud stacks.
Crossbows: Concentration Stance: Fixed this ability causing the player to run to the targeted ally when having auto move settings enabled.
Item: Talus' Crystalline Staff: Fixed an issue where being stunned did not trigger the weapon skill.
War Games: Fixed a case where War Games chat was not displaying.
Adventure Codex: Chapter 14: Fixed an issue where the name and codex marker for the NPC Felix were not displayed during Appendix: New Life.
Lithograph Book: Added 9 new collections using Heroic equipment items to the Lithograph Book.
Cooking: Adjusted the names of Cooking recipes to make searching for recipes easier by removing the quality marker from the name.
Crafting: Fixed an issue preventing fishing rods from being crafted at Sundries Crafter NPCs.
Fixed an issue where health would be restored when equipping and unequipping certain armors.
Guild Contracts: Increased the amount of Guild Contract refresh attempts from 10 to 99.
Map Pins: The default interaction for map pins has changed from Left/Right mouse click to CTRL+Left/Right Mouse Click.
Cosmetics: Fixed an unintended change where dyed metallic materials on costumes and illusions was not properly displaying the mettalic effect.
Cosmetics: Fixed an unintended change to the display of dye color D8BE68.
Morph: Shapeshift: Wraith Hound has learned how to climb stairs.
Graphics: Fixed a case where the Resolution Scale option wouldn't take effect if you had DLSS/FSR/XESS active.
Removed some persistent raid buff icons from displaying in the party UI and blocking visibility of other effects.
Calanthia: Fixed the aggro radius of the boss arena to prevent attacks on players in the resurrection area.
Arkeum Shadowmancer's fury attack indicator now matches the actual attack range.
Controller: Fixed an issue where players could not target themselves after certain mechanics in the Altar of Calanthia raid.
Raid Board: Fixed recruitment posts remaining on the raid board after leaders disband the party.
Added the ability to hide the Spectator Mode control UI while in Spectator Mode.
You can now set a focused team while spectating PvP content to highlight that team's used skills for better visibility.
Increased the number of lines displayed on the kill feed.
Buffs: Remaining buff timers now display in buff tooltips on the main HUD.
Warehouse: Added options to adjust the displayed item icon size as well as hiding equipped items from the list.
Vanguards: Added Vanguard UI to the available HUD editing functions.
World Map: Adjusted the size of the content settings window when viewing the Schedule → Content Settings UI.
War Games: Fixed a case where the Kill and Assist counts in the Guide UI could be reset.
Guild UI: Fixed an issue that could cause duplicate entries for individual Guild Raids in the raid history UI.
Party Matching: Added status messaging to the standby UI when waiting for Party Matching.
Party Matching: Fixed an issue where the Raid tab would not be visible when opening the Party Matching UI through a shortcut key.
Character: A red notification dot now appears on presets that have unspent stat points.
Waypoints: Using Waypoints from the Schedule UI now works without showing the local map.
Tradable equipment in your inventory is now shown in the Material Transmutation item list to help display that you have it, but it is unable to be selected or used as a material.
Adjusted the sort and filter display on the Material Transmutation UI.
A notification dot now appears on the Material Conversion icon in the main menu when automatic material conversion is complete.
Fixed an issue where the Weapon Mastery Battle Pass bonus reward button could not be selected.
Fixed an issue preventing the Vanguard Party controls from opening when using a controller.
Mirror Boutique: Fixed an issue leading to unintended results when confirming changes while hovering over hairstyles.

To better focus our resources on future updates, all web and in-game content moving forward will no longer receive localized support for Spanish. This content will instead be localized into LATAM Spanish.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.18.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 9 and last approximately 4.5 hours. It includes the new 4-Star Dimensional Trial: Crypt of Augmentation. Find the full list of changes, including bug fixes, below.
[img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/2MKziWC3kNjIc5oKw3u4sW/fe935b5ef918767d1602552a77fffcda/TL_Crypt_of_Augemtation_Raid_01_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019299.jpg"]
Challenge Velentra in the latest addition to Dimensional Trials, the new 4-Star Dimensional Trial: Crypt of Augmentation.

This update marks the end of Dimensional Trial Season 2. Strive for new personal bests alongside new seasonal score rewards, including a new Morph, Title, and Epic Chaos Runes when Season 3 starts after maintenance.

Fight back invaders from the Arkeum Legion for unique rewards, like an event gesture, Amitoi, and Morph after maintenance through July 23. Remember to exchange your event currency with special NPCs in town to reap your hard-earned spoils of war.
The Arkeum Invasion field event will spawn 3x per day on weekdays and 4x per day on weekends, across multiple zones.

New Rune Box reward: Guild Field Bosses now offer a Rune box that guarantees a rune, plus the occasional Rare or Epic Chaos Rune. Both guilds will receive 1 million Weapon Mastery Experience per participant upon victory.
Obsidian Fragments have been added to the Arena reward shop for purchase.
Obsidian Fragments now have a chance of dropping from mining nodes on Gigantrite.

Items: Added two new earring drops to the second encounter in Altar of Calanthia.
Items: Polished Crystals dropped during the Altar of Calanthia raid will now go directly to personal inventories and not into guild loot distribution.
Calanthia: Fixed an issue where the Fury attack indicator for Chain Lightning appeared for the wrong players.
Codex: Altar of Calanthia: Fixed an issue where the third stage of the Exploration Codex for the Altar of Calanthia raid didn't recognize completion.
The Forbidden Ritual milestone end date has been extended by two weeks to August 21. This milestone will unlock the new Altar of Calanthia Nightmare difficulty.
New Accessories have been added, including set bonus effects for four different sets.
These accessories provide additional defensive stats that pair well with the increased offensive power gained through upgrading Heroic raid weapons.
12 new Accessories can be acquired from each of the following sources:
4-Star Dungeons and Dimensional Trials
All Things Workshop
Material Transmutation
Nightmare difficulty Hall of Illusion
14 new Accessories can be crafted from Crandace the Special Equipment Crafter, requiring a Lv. 12 version of their existing counterparts as material.
Expanded the level cap for Runes to level 90.
Rare quality Chaos Runes can now be obtained from a variety of gameplay sources.
Nebula Island: Added a Nebula Accessory Chest purchasable at the Nebula Stone merchant for 350 Nebula Stones.
Weekly Missions: For the following two weeks, Chaos Prisms can be obtained through Weekly Mission rewards. These replace the previously available Entropy Shards.
Inter-Server Siege: The team with the most attempted throne captures will now properly determine results in the case of a tie between teams.
Inter-Server Siege: Fixed an issue causing all participation rewards for Inter-Server Sieges to get sent to a single guild.
Inter-Server Siege: Reduced the duration of the preparation time from 10 minutes to 4 minutes to reduce the overall wait time before matches.
Field Boss events: Reduced the duration of the preparation time from 5 minutes to 3 minutes.
Raid matchmaking: Your currently active raid progression is now selected by default when opening the Raid matchmaking or party board UI.
Battle Pass: The "Use Recovery Crystals" Battle Pass mission will now progress when using Precious Recovery Crystals.
Spectator Mode: Fixed players incorrectly entering a dungeon or raid as a spectator if they were invited to join the group after previously observing them as a spectator.
Movement: Fixed abnormal rubberbanding at the top of waterfalls.
Movement: The camera will no longer rotate on its own when teleporting while moving the camera.
Settings: Fixed a variety of UI issues that occurred if a non-default Contrast setting was used.
UI: Fixed an issue causing a placeholder string to be shown in the Matchmaking Success popup.
UI: The search bar in the Party/Raid Board is no longer case-sensitive.
Console: The Chatbox Settings menu is no longer empty.
Wand: Vampiric Contract: Fixed an issue where the range for the passive effect was being determined by equipped weapon melee range.
Wand: Calanthia's Doctrine of Chaos now animates appropriately.
Longbow: Blitz can once again reset the cooldown of Swift Healing, Frenzied Sword Dance, and Valiant Brawl.
Longbow: Flash Wave's visual indicator now properly matches the ability's range.
Spear: Culling Arc will now automatically re-trigger when the respective Ability key is held down.
Sword and Shield: The Mastery effect Roar Amplifier now only activates on melee damage.
Cordy's Warblade of Creeping Doom: Giant Cordy's Spore Poison effect now follows the victim of Death Blow.
Deluzhnoa's Serrated Shard: Increased Rising Slash damage by 60% for the Deluzhnoa's Waves effect.
Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Fixed an issue where Deluzhnoa's Cold effect would trigger even when blocking Arrow Vortex.
Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Deluzhnoa's Cold effect has been changed to deal damage to the first enemy hit by Arrow Vortex, then deal damage and collision effects to targets within a 3m radius.
Deluzhnoa's Edge of Eternal Frost: Replaced the Deluzhnoa's Annihilation effect with a new skill, Deluzhnoa's Touch.

Deluzhnoa's Touch: Controlling Rake's hit area width increased to 4m and reduces movement speed of all enemies in the area by 60%. On hit, increases damage reduction by 3 for 5 seconds, stacks up to 10 times.
Velentra: Defense is reduced even further if Velentra is stunned.
Velentra: Reduced the hit radius of Velentra's Phantom Bullet.
Fixed icons and tooltips that appear when Velentra becomes charmed by players with the 'Echoes of Seduction' status.
Fixed an issue where Velentra's charm status would occasionally not be removed after being charmed by players with the 'Echoes of Seduction' status.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.17.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on July 2 and last approximately 3.5 hours. Various improvements have been made to the Altar of Calanthia Raid. Find the full list of changes below.
Fixed an issue that allowed Dragaryle to be fought outside its intended area.
The stairs leading to Calanthia during the third stage now always regenerate after wiping or exiting and re-entering the instance.
Fixed an issue that blocked progression in the first stage if the Arkeum Shadowmancer was killed before the respective objective had started.
Using Party Matchmaking to fill an empty slot no longer resets progress in the instance.
Fixed an issue that caused players to be removed from the instance after another player joined via Party Matchmaking.
Fixed an issue that caused players to get kicked when joining while a Spectator was present.
Stage progress is no longer reset upon transferring servers.
Fixed an issue where damage from Zairos' Shield Explosion mechanic could be blocked.
Fixed an issue that caused a third player to be tethered during the Zairos/Vulkan chain mechanic on Difficult mode.

Fixed an issue that caused the arena to not reset in stage 2 if the Vanguard wipes just before Zairos and Vulkan transform into Radeth on Difficult mode. If this occurs, the fight will now automatically reset after 30 seconds.
Fixed 7/1: Players affected by Dragaryle’s Petrification cannot be healed after debuff expires.
Fixed 7/1: Resolved an issue that prevented the use of Entropy Shards locked before the 2.16.0 release. If you have shards in storage, removing them from storage will put them into your currency tab.
Fixed 7/1: Controller: Fixed the 'Select Role' popup issue that prevented matchmaking confirmation when role quotas weren't met.
Fixed 7/1: Controller: Corrected an issue that caused the D-Pad interaction to require multiple right presses to accept matchmaking invitations.
Heroic Equipment: Dissolving Trait Extracts from Heroic Equipment now properly grants 40x Precious Magic Powder instead of Entropy Shards.
Heroic Equipment: Weapon skills granted by Skill Cores are now shown in the Equipment Skills section of the Skills menu.
Traits: Fixed an issue that caused a Heroic Trait to be displayed as the result of using Trait Chance Conversion with a Normal Trait on Heroic equipment.
Auction House: Fixed an issue that caused various placeholder items to be shown in the Auction House.
Items: The Windsheer Spear Lithograph can now be sold on the Auction House again.
Codex: Getting knocked back by Velentra at the start of her dark/light phase no longer counts as being hit by a Fury attack for the sake of the Unhealthy Obsession Exploration Codex quest.
Secret Dungeon: Scorpos will now appear correctly after tunneling underground then re-emerging.
Mystic Portals: Fixed an issue that caused Mystic Portals to appear as Mystic Globes.
Swamp of Silence: Fixed an issue that prevented players from interacting with the mud piles required for completing Contracts in the Swamp of Silence.
Skills: Casting can now be canceled when the target moves out of range.
Skills: Spear: Fixed an issue that caused the Heavy Attack Chance and Back Heavy Attack Chance values to be swapped in the description of Malice Surge.
Arch Boss: Collision on various objects above Tevent has been adjusted to ensure they cannot be stood on.
Arch Boss: The correct icons are now shown after signing up for an Ascended Arch Boss event portal.
Localization: Korean text is no longer shown in the window displayed when a Vanguard Captain creates a Raid instance.
