Tutorial: Progress through Wisp Island is no longer blocked after relaunching at specific points.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.16.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on June 25 and last approximately 5.5 hours. It includes the first 12-player Raid, Ascended Arch Bosses, and more. Find the full list of changes below.

Vanquish Calanthia before her dream becomes a nightmare for all of Solisium. Fearsome bosses will attempt to stop you on your way to the altar. Upon your arrival, you’ll face the Command Marshal General of the Arkeum Legion.
Complete the Two Wings of Sylvaeth Codex part I and II to enter Altar of Calanthia. Entry portals and related crafting NPCs can be found in the north end of Herba Village.

Party Matchmaking and Party Board listings for the Altar of Calanthia can be accessed through the Raid UI at the entry portal. The standard Party Matchmaking UI will not show the raid. Matchmaking can only be used to enter Normal difficulty.

The Raid matchmaking system will form two parties consisting of one tank, one healer, and four DPS roles. Pre-formed Vanguards do not have role restrictions on party formation. Teams can structure their Raid group as they prefer.
Normal mode requires players to be at least 5,000 Combat Power.
Difficult mode requires players to be at least 6,000 Combat Power. Difficult mode has increased boss stats, mechanics, and phases.
Players can complete and receive rewards from both Normal and Difficult mode each week.

Checkpoints: Defeating a boss in Altar of Calanthia counts as a checkpoint. Groups will be able to re-enter and pick up from checkpoints at a later time within the week. Players are not locked to specific group progress and can join multiple groups in a week. Defeating previous bosses again will not offer additional rewards until the week resets.

When a team is fully defeated on any boss in Normal Mode, all players will receive a damage and HP buffs for additional attempts. This buff stacks up to 10 times and can only be applied once every 3 minutes.

Rewards: Each week, killing Calanthia on any difficulty guarantees a Heroic Armor or Weapon. Difficult mode offers higher chances for Weapon drops or Selection Chests instead of random drops. Heroic Accessories will be available alongside an even more difficult version of the Raid in the future.
Altar of Calanthia introduces two new materials: Entropy Shards and Chaos Prisms. These materials are used to make Heroic enhancement materials, Heroic Skill Core management items, and Heroic gear.

Transform your look with our biggest style update yet when the Solisium Style Pack comes to the Shop on June 26! Discover new hairstyles, hats, helmets, plus Dye and Sewing Thread to further personalize your favorite outfit.
[img src="https://images.ctfassets.net/z7aj1lm9rbu3/4Yj5SXvt97fhIM75eh1Q11/90161516e1b1499bd23079751bc2007b/TL_Solisium_Style_Pack_Final_1920x1080_CT-000019407.jpg"]
30x Illusion Scroll
100x Dye
40x Sewing Thread
Hairstyles: Polished, Free Spirit
Hats: Leather Bush Hat, Admiral’s Bicorne
Helmets: Crested Centurion, Basic Bruiser
The Altar of Calanthia raid introduces a new grade of equipment drops: Heroic grade.
Characters may only equip one Weapon and one Armor of Heroic grade at a time.
Heroic grade is a higher grade than existing Epic gear. A base powered Heroic item is equivalent to a max enhanced Tier 2 Epic item.
Heroic items have primary and secondary stats as well as three slots for traits, similar to other gear grades. They also have a Heroic Trait that enhances one of the 5 base stats.

Heroic Weapons do not come with passive skills. Instead, you can extract the passive skill as a Skill Core from any Tier 1 Arch Boss Weapon or any Epic Tier 2 weapon and apply it to your Heroic weapon.
Craft Skill Core items at the Skill Core NPC near the Altar of Calanthia Raid portal.
Heroic gear is leveled using the new craftable Heroic Growthstones as materials.

notes.title: Ascended Arch Bosses: Queen Bellandir and Tevent

items.text: New upgraded difficulty versions of arch bosses Tevent and Queen Bellandir are now on the weekly schedule:
Ascended Arch Bosses take place at 4:00pm local server time on Tuesdays and Saturdays. The regular Queen Bellandir previously scheduled on Saturdays will now take place on Friday.
These new Arch Boss versions drop materials used to upgrade your existing Arch Boss weapons.
Tier 2 versions of the Tevent and Bellandir Arch Boss Weapons can now be crafted at any Weapon Crafter.
Crafting a Tier 2 Arch Boss weapon requires a Tier 1 Arch Boss weapon of the same type as crafting material.
For the consumed Tier 1 Arch Boss weapon, all traits will be reset and do not carry over to the Tier 2 weapon.
Tier 2 Arch Boss weapons have an enhanced weapon skill compared to their Tier 1 counterparts.
Arena Season 2 will end at the start of maintenance.
A month-long 6v6 Arena event season will begin after maintenance completes.
Markers: Ground markers can now be placed in the world to indicate tactical locations for your party.
By default, the Party Leader has access to place ground markers, but permissions may be managed through the Party UI.
Observer Mode expansion: Observer Mode can now be activated on PvE content such as Raids, Guild Raids, Dimensional Trials, and more. Manage Observer mode settings through the Party Management UI.
UI: Item Quickslots have been expanded from 4 slots to 8 slots.
Weapon Mastery: Tooltips for Weapon Mastery nodes now show the current stat benefit applied from the node, the value gained by the next level, and the value gained at max level.

Siege: Tax Delivery and Castle Siege now take place back-to-back on the same day instead of split across 2 weeks. The alternate week is now scheduled for Interserver Siege battles. These 2 events will cycle on a biweekly schedule.
Siege: Increased the duration of Fonsine's Blessing spawn protection provided when spawning during Sieges.
Chat: A variety of pre-set chat messages have been added that can be assigned to the ring menu for quick selection.
Chat: Message triggers may now be set to send pre-written chat messages based on activity triggers, like logins or party joins.
Riftstones and Boonstones: Increased the stat bonuses provided by Riftstone and Boonstone owner buffs.
Riftstones and Boonstones: Decreased the preparation timer at the start of Riftstone and Boonstone battles from 5 to 2 minutes.
Nebula Island: Adjusted the portal location for the boss portal in Seal Sanctuary to be further south.
Nebula Island: Grimturg: Adjusted some cases where Grimturg unexpectedly moved during mechanics.
Urstella Fields: Adjusted mob density in some areas.
Dungeons: 3 and 4-Star Dungeon reward chests may now be opened two times per run.
Nebula Island: The corruption debuff from Exodus will now be removed upon moving to a safe zone.
Contracts: Fixed an issue where interactable bottles in Talandre for the 'Collect Letters in a Bottle' contracts were only visible while within 5m of range.
Food: The buff granted by Enticing Cream Pudding now matches its description.
War Games: Players on different teams can no longer form a party together.
Crafting: Fixed an issue where the quantity button was inactive when supplementing materials from a selection chest during crafting.
Adventure Codex: Chapter 4: Fixed a case where the Rescue Operation codex could sometimes not be progressed.
Siege: Fixed a case where players could swap weapon types without incurring an intended ability cooldown.

Flash Arrow: Increased area of effect by 2 meters. Now always attempts to hit, but the effect can be resisted by the target. On hit, applies a ranged evasion debuff to the target. Cooldown reduced from 60 seconds to 36 seconds, damage increased from 150% to 250%.
Brutal Arrow: Now increases damage by 40% against stunned or bound targets.
Weapon Mastery: Rhythmical Shooting: General weapon damage increases by 3~12 for 3 seconds each time you use different skills in sequence. Stacks up to 5 times.
Healing Touch: Added a fourth specialization that changes Healing Touch to a self-buff, adds a damage bonus when using longbow skills, but also reduces your movement speed for 4 seconds while active.
Phoenix Barrage: Reduced base damage. At Epic Lv 5, damage reduced from 91% of Base Damage +23, to 73% of Base Damage +19. Damage boost against monsters increased from 125% to 180%.
Explosive Fury: Reduced base damage. At Epic Lv 5, damage reduced from 360% of Base Damage +100, to 288% of Base Damage +80. Damage boost against monsters increased from 40% to 75%.
Thundering Bomb: Reduced base damage. Reduced damage bonuses applied when striking from the back or when target is under Weaken effects. Damage boost against monsters increased from 15% to 40%.
Shadowy Escape: Fixed an issue where players would rarely teleport back to their casting point upon teleporting with Shadowy Escape.
Fixed an issue causing Death Blow and Guillotine Blade to be canceled if used a 2nd time while it's being charged.
Burning Smokescreen: Added a short cooldown before a 2nd Burning Smokescreen can be used to prevent it from accidentally being cast twice.
Amitoi and Morphs: Tooltips on Amitoi and Morph icons now tell you if you've acquired that Amitoi or Morph.
Controller: Added the ability for controller shortcuts to be assigned to main menus such as Inventory.
Matchmaking: Changing zones or closing a menu no longer closes the 'Matchmaking Successful' popup resulting in it being declined.
Trials: Fixed an issue causing Trial-specific Dungeon UI elements to rarely not be displayed.
Codex: Fixed an issue causing the camera to occasionally get stuck when attempting to teleport to the Amitoi house while the camera pans during a cinematic scene.
PlayStation 5: The sun now appears without a black object in front of it.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.14.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on June 11 and last approximately 6.5 hours. It includes the Archboss Guild Raid event, Road to Raid activities, and special login rewards. Find the full list of changes below.

Road to Raid continues with additional rewards for Dimensional Trials as well as Dynamic Event player kills and assists (PvP). Whether you return to Nebula Island, Dimensional Trials, or look for new guild members, crafting with Abyss Contract Tokens will further improve your gear before your destined showdown against Calanthia on June 26.
Claim special login rewards to finish your Raid preparations during Storm's Eve from June 19 through 26.
Day 1: 5x Random Chaos Rune Chests
Day 2: 30x Rare Artifact Chance Chests
Day 3: 50x Precious Rune Chance Chests
Day 4: 4x Nebula Conquest Chests
Day 5: 25x Adventure Coin: Loyalty
Day 6: 10x Trait Resonance Stone
Day 7: 7x Chaos Soul Shard: Calanthia
Milestone 10, "Vengeance Ascendant," leads up to the Raid, opening with in-game milestones to take part in.

notes.title: Guild Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event

items.text: Between June 12 and June 25, guilds will have access to a special version of the Tevent fight as a Guild Raid.
The Guild Raid version of Tevent has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
Guilds may enter the Tevent guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
Defeating the Guild Raid version of Tevent will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
Arena Season 2 officially comes to a close on June 26th.
Four new kinds of high-tier Recovery Crystals are now available for crafting via the Cooking skill.
Recipes to craft these new Recovery Crystals can be purchased from the Contract Coin Merchant for 3,000 Contract Coins each.
Items: Rune chance boxes for non-Chaos runes now auto-open when acquired.
War Games: Scoreboard healing values now only include applied healing amounts and do not count healing above full health.
Wand: Vampiric Contract: Now grants its healing buffs when using targeted skills.
Crypt of Augmentation: Adjusted boss abilities so they're less likely to kill revived players standing outside of the boss arena.
Crypt of Augmentation: Fixed several issues preventing proper credit of exploration codex quests in this dungeon.
Crypt of Augmentation: Fixed an issue where the door to the final boss arena would remain closed after the boss was defeated, preventing revived players from accessing the reward chest.
Guild Raids: Equipment acquired from Guild Raids will no longer be tradeable.
Field Boss: Players will no longer be pulled into the same instance as old party members after leaving a party that has signed up for a Dominion event, then signing up again.
Dimensional Trials: Trials: Fixed an issue rarely resulting in Trial Season Rankings not updating after clearing a new tier.
Arena: Defensive food buffs are now properly removed when entering the Arena.
Arena: Additional ranking points are now granted during win streaks, as well as when breaking a lose streak.
Codex: Fixed various interactable objects not appearing throughout the Adventure Codex quests.
Codex: Wings of Sylaveth Part 1: Fixed an issue where a combat effect could get stuck when fighting Velentra.
Adventure Codex: Adjusted the quest steps for Chapter 10 when dispelling the Moonlight Spell to make the necessary actions clearer.
Nebula Island: Fixed a case where the Corruption debuff did not get removed even when leaving the boss area.
Quests: Corrected the timing of some dialogues where auto-advancement took longer than it should to proceed.
Wisp Island: Helpie's face will no longer appear distorted during the tutorial on Wisp Island.
Cosmetics: Black Swan outfit: The transparent areas of this costume now properly show the texture beneath.
Shop: Earring Runes can now be obtained from the Precious Rune Chance Chest available in the Ornate Coin section of the Shop.
PC: Added a setting to limit FPS of the client to 30 FPS when not in focus.
Cosmetics: As it cannot be dyed, the dye window will no longer appear when selecting the Checkpoint Officer Hat within the Mirror Boutique.
Item: Wand: The Forbidden Demonic Lexicon appearance now properly matches its icon.
Console: UI: Fixed a case where equipped weapon UI would not appear on the HUD after changing weapons.
UI: Name transparency settings for non-selected characters now always apply even when no target is selected.
Weekly Mission: Fixed the alignment of reward icons on the Weekly Mission Reward UI.
Controller: Accepting a Party Matchmaking pop-up while viewing a product in the Shop will no longer result in the viewed product from being purchased as well.
Controller: Custom chat tabs can now be renamed.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the Aftereffect Cure button from being usable.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the conversation history output window from being scrolled.
Bronze, Silver, and Gold Nature’s Celebration Packs will be available at 10 a.m. PT on June 12.
Call upon the power of nature with the Nature's Celebration Pack: Bronze. The Gigantrite Gneiss Amitoi is here to accompany you on your next quest alongside 1,125 Lucent.

Tap into the power of nature with the Nature's Celebration Pack: Silver. Swim like a mobile fortress as the Castle Dracoryft Turtle morph and strike fear across the land as the Sigil Ursa dash morph. You'll also receive 2,875 Lucent.

Command the power of nature with the Nature's Celebration Pack: Gold. Glide across Solisium as the majestic Barn Owl morph and leave a lasting impression on friends and foes with the Bloodcrystal Plate and Headpiece. This pack also includes 6,000 Lucent.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.12.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on May 28 and last approximately 5 hours. Descend into the depths of a new 4-Star Co-Op Dungeon, gain more power with new Earring equipment, and experience new events on your Road to Raid. We also have a new episode of Tico Talks covering the latest updates.
Find the full list of changes, including various fixes, listed below.

Welcome back to Tico Talks, featuring THRONE AND LIBERTY Globalization Design Manager, Tico. This episode covers Raid gear, PvP meta changes, Dimensional Trials, Nebula Island, and Interserver Castle Siege. What do you think is going to be the meta for beating the raid? Let us know your answer to this episode's community question in the comments section of our YouTube video or on Discord.

Confront the necromancer Velentra in the Crypt of Augmentation for substantial rewards, including essential Tier 2 equipment drops, that will accelerate your gear progression. Once a professor of light magic at Venelux, Velentra's life changed forever when she witnessed the extraordinary powers of the Arkeum knight Calanthia. Now transformed by dark magic, this mysterious necromancer stands before us, commanding ancient powers in devoted service to her dark mistress.
The Crypt of Augmentation will require a Combat Power of 5000 to enter. Master it for an easier time against Calanthia no matter how badly she wants your Star Fragment.
A new accessory equipment slot has been added: Earrings!
The Earring slot is available automatically to all characters after the 2.12.0 update.
Earrings can be acquired through various content such as Tier 2 tokens at the All Things Merchant, Nebula Island, Co-Op and Solo Dungeons, and Talandre Arch Bosses.
The combat system now recognizes when an attack comes from front, rear, or flanking directions.
Multiple abilities have been updated with positional damage or effects based on attacking from the flank or rear of the target, so take a moment to review your skills for potential benefits!
Castle-owning Alliances can now take part in an Interserver Siege event every 3 weeks, pitting castle owners on different servers against each other in Siege combat.
Alliances will be paired up and both sides will have an opportunity to attack and defend.
A portion of tax revenue from each participating server will be added to the reward pool, and divided among the participating alliances based on the outcome of the battle.
Emerging victorious will reward participants with a temporary title, temporary cloak cosmetic, chaos runes, and consumables.
Victorious alliances will also bring a 48-hour server wide buff to their home server, granting all players on that server increased Abyss Point efficiency and combat damage bonus.
The less-victorious Alliance members will receive a selection of consumables and chaos runes for their efforts.
The first Interserver Siege is slated to take place June 15, with eligible participants based on the outcome of the regular Sieges on June 1.
Mystic Globes and Mystic Portals have inexplicably been swapped for Lucky Bags. Gather Lucky Bags around Solisium from May 29 until maintenance on June 11 for additional rewards and Sollant items.

Fortune beckons from May 29 until June 11. Complete various activities such as Co-op Dungeons, Dynamic Events, Field Bosses, and Amitoi Expeditions for a chance to net extra rewards like the Golden Archboss Weapon Selection Chest.

We asked you to color in Growling Wolfie Amitoi images with your own personal touch as part of the Color Craft: Amitoi Edition Discord event. Following the final community vote, we’re excited to announce the winner in Discord. Their Amitoi will be added to the game as a future reward.
New Adventure and Extra Codex entries have been added with additional story quests and rewards.
Interlude: The Order of the Swan and Extra: Two Wings of Sylvaeth introduce story related to the upcoming raid release.
Collection Codex: Added the Miscellaneous Collection Codex with additional collections to complete and new rewards, including materials and profile frames.
Morphs: Increased the level cap for Dash, Glide, and Swim Morph levels and bonuses!
Nebula Island: Combined basic and greater Nebula Stone merchants into a single shop merchant.
Field Boss: Players will no longer be pulled into a Dominion event after leaving the party that signed up for it.
Events: Festival of Fire: Fixed a rare issue causing Phase 2 to not complete after extinguishing all fires around a Chief Priest's Brazier.
Cooking: Enticing Cream Pudding: Changed the bonus Wildkin damage and resistance effect to bonus Construct damage and resistance effect.

Cooking: Added more types of Cooking contracts to the Contract NPCs in Laslan, Stonegard, and Talandre. This should also fix cases where players ran into empty Cooking contract lists when pursuing them.
PvP: Removed the setting for 'Always Use Amitoi Recovery in PvP Combat' which did not actually use recovery items.
Siege: Slightly increased the duration of Fonsine's Blessing applied when respawning during Siege or Tax Delivery events.
Crimson Manor: Fixed an area where players could get stuck if landing from a glide near Snowburn Summit.
Cosmetics: Fixed various rendering issues with the Casual Chic outfit.
PlayStation-Only Servers: New characters created on PlayStation-Only servers will once again receive a complimentary server transfer ticket.
Controller: Fixed a rare issue causing UI navigation to continue even after the joystick was released.
Console: Xbox Series S: Fixed an issue causing NPC's to occasionally T-pose upon log in.
Voice Chat: Fixed an issue causing voice chat to deactivate when entering/exiting instances.
Party Matchmaking: Added the ability to sort the list of available dungeons and Dimensional Trials in ascending or descending difficulty.
Targeting: Added icons to Boss NPCs to indicate their Boss status.
Guild: Adjusted the layout of the Guild UI to reduce the size of the Friendly Guild list and display more Guild Notices.
HUD: Weather info will no longer be hidden after collapsing then expanding the minimap.
HUD: Icons on the minimap are now displayed correctly when the minimap size is expanded beyond the default setting.
Minimap: Fixed an issue where icons for former party members could remain visible on the minimap.
Minimap: Added options to allow or prevent click interactions on the minimap.
Settings: Added options to allow rotating character in place through mouse drag.
Settings: Added options to reduce the transparency of visual effects.
Settings: Fixed an issue preventing some HUD UI sizes from being selectable in the Settings menu.
Settings: Added options to reduce the transparency of floating damage numbers.
Stats: Added new bonus effects for reaching stat values of 80 or more.
Items: You can now receive buff effects from both attack and defensive food at the same time.
Akman's Bloodletting Crossbow: Akman's Fragment effect will now only trigger when the Selfless Diffusion skill is active.
Wild Barrage: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon to be displayed in some locations when the Wild Barrage specialization was active on Merciless Barrage.
Nimble Leap: Whirlpool Specialization: Movement speed increase within the Whirlpool area reduced from 20% to 15%.
Wind Snatcher: Maximum movement speed bonus reduced from 50% to 30%.
Mastery: Agile Strike: Reduced the movement speed bonus from 3% to 2%.
Mastery: Mirage Dancer: Reduced the movement speed bonus from 10% to 8%.
Camouflage Cloak: Duration reduced by 3 seconds. Slightly reduced the duration extension provided through specialization.
Mastery: Reckless Assault: Fixed an issue where Reckless Assault was not applying the additional 50% boost to Raging Frenzy.
Blood Devotion: After being affected by Blood Devotion, players will now be unable to receive the affects of Blood Devotion again for 45 seconds.
Healing Touch: The amount of healing provided has been reduced by 16%.
Blitz: Can no longer reset the cooldown on Wand's Fountain of Life.
Rupture: Fixed an issue where Rupture ignored Weaken Resistance.
Predator: Added a function to Predator that removes stacking recovery effects applied by player skills in the order they were most recently applied, one stack at a time.
Provoking Roar: This ability now forces the user to the top of the target's aggro list for 6 seconds.
Blessed Barrier: Fixed an issue causing the player's Buff Duration Bonus to not apply to the secondary buff applied by Blessed Barrier.
Swift Healing: Mana cost of tier 2 and 3 Swift Healing has been reduced to match the cost of Tier 1, however the amount healed by tier 2 and 3 is also reduced.

Spectator Mode: Additional features added to Spectator Mode including quick-swap saves for following specific characters, UI improvements to reduce on-screen clutter, and camera rotation sensitivity settings.
Fixed an issue causing the camera to become stuck underground when entering a War Games match as a Spectator while dead.
Fixed an issue causing Spectators to occasionally swap from Tracking Mode to Free Roam Mode without input.
Fixed an issue causing the camera to become stuck when navigating to specific areas.
Portals and Pitons can no longer be targeted while in Spectator mode.
The Camera Speed setting now affects the camera's zoom in/out speed as well.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

topNew: A new accessory equipment slot has been added: Earrings!
The Earring slot is available automatically to all characters after the 2.12.0 update.
New Adventure and Extra Codex entries have been added with additional story quests and rewards.

items.text: THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.10.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on May 14 and last approximately 3 hours. Queen Bellandir has been defeated countless times, but they’re ready for revenge from May 15 through May 29. Conquer new mechanics and discover altered loot tables as you take on a trickier variant of this familiar foe. Bonus weapon mastery points and expedited fishing progression will also be available from May 15 through May 22.
Find the full list of changes below.

notes.title: Guild Call to Arms: Archboss Guild Raid Event

items.text: Between May 15 and May 29, guilds will have access to a special version of the Queen Bellandir fight as a Guild Raid.
The Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir has adjusted mechanics and is balanced for a smaller group of players to tackle.
Guilds may enter the Queen Bellandir guild raid up to twice per week while the event is active!
Defeating the Guild Raid version of Queen Bellandir will always drop a Tier 2 armor, a Tier 2 accessory, a non-boss Nebula Island accessory, and may drop Arch Boss Weapons or Accessories.
Pick up special Fishing Bait from event NPCs in Kastleton, Vienta Village, and Herba Village between May 15 and May 22 and get to your nearest shoreline to put it to use!
Anglers of all levels can benefit from this bait, as it can catch special fish that provide bonus Fishing experience as well as additional items when reeled in.
This update adds Spectator Mode cameras that allow anyone to watch the action during a War Games match.

Browse the list of upcoming War Games and join public matches as a Spectator. Match owners retain control over whether matches are public or private, and the access of individual participants including spectators.
Both Free Camera and Target Follow Camera options are available in Spectator Mode.
Free Camera allows you to fly around the match space to view any part of the action that most interests you, or set up to view critical map points.
You can also save specific camera angles to function keys and quickly swap between them later.
Follow Camera lets you select the player you wish to follow from the list of active players in the match to lock the camera to their movement.
After reviewing player feedback and gameplay data, equipment drop rates will be slightly increased across a variety of content, with an emphasis on increased accessibility of Tier 2 equipment.
Boss-type content: Guild Raids, Field Bosses
Dungeon content: 3-Star Dungeons, Hall of Illusion
Open-world Content: Abyss Dungeons, Nebula Island (Blessing Pouches and Conquest Chests)
Material Transmutation rewards
All Things Workshop: Added a variety of miscellaneous crafting recipes that exist on other crafting merchants to the All Things Workshop.
Guilds: Added the option to teleport to zones currently controlled by the guild through the Guild UI.
Map: Added the ability to share your map pins to others via chat link, by either selecting the link button on the pin or by Alt-Left Clicking the pin.
Chat: Added a category for recently used stickers to make them more quickly accessible.
Party Board: Added the ability to Favorite individual Party Board categories and view them through the shorter Favorites list.
Codex: Players will no longer be stuck in an invisible state when exiting the instanced area during the One-Eyed Hawk Exploration Codex in Urstella Fields.
Crimson Manor: Adjusted the event area of 'Best Way to Prevent the Worst' so it no longer overlaps with the waypoint.
Grayclaw Forest: Wolf King Hill: Fixed a spot where players were blocked by unexpected collision.
Localization: Updated tooltips on several abilities for clarity on how they function.
Vanguards: Fixed an issue where the previous Vanguard leader would still be labeled as such after changing Vanguard leadership.
PlayStation 5: Controllers will now vibrate again when playing on PlayStation 5.
Controller: Cooking: Results are now immediately shown when using the search bar in the Cooking menu.
Morphs: A Swim Morph will no longer be entered when using a Dash Morph in shallow water.
HUD: Removed the red dot notification from the Upcoming Schedule widget.
Party: Party invitations are now automatically declined upon changing instances.
Removed the camera shake effect when being hit by broad area effect abilities.
Staff: Fixed an issue causing the Mana Regen effect from Inner Peace to be lost upon receiving a CC effect while the Immune to CC Specialization was active.
Crossbow: Fixed an issue causing the incorrect icon to be shown in various locations when the Wild Barrage Specialization was active on Merciless Barrage.
Wand: Ray of Disaster now deals damage to moving targets.
Greatsword: Mastery: The Reckless Assault Mastery Node now grants the described effects.
Fixed an issue causing the VFX on the Dawnlight Crossbows weapon skin to be displayed in the incorrect position.
Fixed an issue causing lightning VFX to not be shown on parts of the Stormcaller Shroud outfit.
Fixed an issue causing the book to be held upside down when the Abyssal Wand weapon skin was equipped.
The Adventurous Pioneer outfit can now be dyed.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.8.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 30 and last up to 3 hours. Search for treasure in the Mystic Portal event, experience the new Trait Resonance feature, and show off your favorite looks with Illusion Workshop. There’s even an Ornate Coin Twitch Drop waiting to be claimed.
Find the full list of changes, including various fixes, listed below.
From May 1 through May 15, daily login rewards will grant you special Mystic Keys. Open Mystic Portals to play a treasure-hunting minigame!
Hunt down hidden treasure chests through different puzzles for a variety of rewards including an Amitoi, Morph, and character progression materials!
Equipment that has fully developed Traits - all 3 unlocked and at max tier - can now take on a fourth trait through Trait Resonance.

When you unlock Trait Resonance on an item, the fourth trait can be added randomly or specified at unlock through the use of Trait Resonance Stones. Trait Resonance can be re-rolled at any time after unlocking.
Re-traiting one of the base three traits on an item will cause the Trait Resonance to become inactive, but not lost, until the base traits are at max tier once more.
Trait Resonance Stones are acquired by obtaining fragments through Material Transmutation and crafting them along with ores into Trait Resonance Stones at any crafting merchant.
New Lithograph Book entries have been added which grant Trait Resonance Stones as rewards.
Take character customization to even greater heights by customizing the appearance of individual gear pieces through the new Illusion Workshop!
Use consumable Illusion Scrolls to capture the appearance of gear collected in the world and then transform it into a usable Illusion for your cosmetic collection.
Illusion appearances can now be dyed, allowing for even more variety in what you wear.

Apply these appearances to your currently worn equipment to customize your look! Additional illusions will be added to this system over time. At this time, only Epic gear items are available for Illusion Workshop.
Check out our official announcement for additional details.

Top up on Ornate Coins with the latest THRONE AND LIBERTY Twitch Drop. From activities that will help fast track progress to an open tournament with over one million in Lucent on the line, May is all about rewarding players through unique events. To kick off the festivities, the Ornate Coin Twitch Drop will be available following maintenance on May 1.
Whether you watch your favorite streamer or hang out with a few new Creators, simply tune in for 5 hours of cumulative watch time before May 14 to claim yours.
200 Ornate Coins (2 total hours watched)
300 Ornate Coins (5 total hours watched)

If you haven’t done so already, make sure your Twitch account is linked to your Steam, Xbox, or PSN account (depending on which platform) you play on. Twitch Drops can only be claimed once per account.

Dimensional Trials: Party Matchmaking rewards for Dimensional Trials matchmaking are now acquired after opening the tier's treasure chest, and only acquired on the first tier after a group uses matchmaking to form.
Arena: When a match ends with no deaths on either team, both teams will see a Loss result but team members will not lose ranking points or matchmaking reward counts.
Party Matchmaking: Icons now display on the Party UI for each member of a party that shows which role they selected for matchmaking - tank, healer, or damage.
Party Board: Added Abyss Dungeons and Nebula Island as categories to post Party Board recruitment notices.
A shortcut to the respective Party Board section has been added to the Map Region List for each Abyss Dungeon.
Hall of Illusion: Haylock: Fixed the display of the Ice Pillar explosion attack so that it shows as a Fury attack instead of a Wrath attack.
Items: Purchasing items with max purchase limits now works with partial remaining quantities when using the Purchase All button.
Items: When filtering merchants for Limited quantity items, the display now also shows items in the list that you have already purchased max quantities of.
Gameplay: Fixed an issue where NPCs and objects occasionally need to be interacted with twice after leaving or joining an instance.
Gameplay: The Map and Minimap are now hidden while inside various instanced locations that don't have map to be shown.
Cooking: Honey Roasted Apple recipe text no longer appears in Korean.
Gameplay: Codex: Fixed an issue where players could get stuck on the wrong side of the Inner Castle Gate as a Jumping Golem.
Schedule: Fixed an issue where later events (such as Gigantrite spawns) would sometimes appear before other events on the schedule.
Amitoi House: Additional cinematics are now available from the Memories of Adventure book in the Amitoi House.
Shop: Server Transfer Tickets should now appear available on the Server Transfer page as soon as they've been purchased.
Nebula Island: The weekly time cap (playable hours) for Nebula Island has increased to 10 hours per week. This is a hard time limit cap and cannot be exceeded.
Deluzhnoa's Edge of Eternal Frost: Added an effect on hitting a target that increases Damage Reduction by 3 for 5 seconds, up to 10 stacks. Increased damage by 50% against monsters.
Deluzhnoa's Permafrost Razors: Added an effect that reduces the cooldown of Phantom Mist by 30%.
Deluzhnoa's Arc of Frozen Death: Added an effect that reduces the cooldown of Whirlwind Arrow by 30%. Increased damage by 50% against monsters.
Deluzhnoa's Ancient Petrified Staff: Now Reduces the casting speed of Infernal Meteor by 50%. Changed Cooldown Speed 4% to Perception 4 on the item stats.
Cordy's Grasp of Manipulation: Fixed the text of the equipment skill, Giant Cordy's Blessing, so that it no longer refers to the wrong skill in the description.
Daigon's Stormblade: After using the Whirlwind Shield skill, when the One-Strike Shield skill hits, there is an 80% chance to fire a Whirlwind Shield projectile that deals 135% of the base damage.
Cloak of the Frozen Expanse: Crafting this item no longer results in receiving a Shaikal's Mindveil Spear.
Forgotten Lotus Gloves now properly drop in Bercant Estate.
Crimson Doomblade: Fixed the text of the equipment skill, Kasier's Thirst, so that it no longer incorrectly states that it increases Witty Retort's healing.
Weapon Mastery: Adjusted the text descriptions of multiple Weapon Mastery nodes to better clarify their effects.
Mastery: Tactical Counterattack: Now has a 1-second casting time.
Mastery: Movement Speed Focus: Fixed this Tactics Mastery so it no longer decreases Buff Duration by 14% instead of 1.4% at 8/10 points.
Guillotine Blade: The effect that reduces incoming healing effects is now subject to the target's Weaken resistance.
Blessed Barrier: Duration increase specialization will no longer cause the duration to end prematurely.
Celestial Boost: Fixed an issue where the tooltip was not updating with dynamic values.
A Shot at Victory: Annihilation Blade specialization: Reduced the required points from 10 to 7.
Mastery: Blade Momentum: Fixed an issue where specific dynamic values in the description were not being retrieved correctly.
Controller: UI layout customization can now be performed using a controller, including on consoles!
Controller: The input button can now be held when donating to a Guild to do so multiple times.
Controller: A variety of controller optimizations for better controller interactions with menus and UI.
Controller Settings: Added the ability to adjust both the character and crosshair position offset on screen.
Mouse/Keyboard: Hotkeys have been added to the Refresh, Accept, and Share with Party buttons when viewing Contracts.

Party List: Party member numbering no longer changes automatically when a party member leaves. Remaining party members keep their assigned numbers in the party list, and as new members join they fill in the empty numbers left by departed party members.
Party Matchmaking: Removed the "create invitation link" option from appearing on the Party Matchmaking UI.
Weapon Mastery: Improved the display of affected stats in Weapon Mastery details, such as when a stat is reduced by the Weapon Mastery effect.
Weapon Mastery: Fixed an issue where remaining Mastery Points displays negative numbers after a level swap with another weapon on a secondary set.
Cooking: Added Search functionality for the Cooking UI.
Crafting: Tabs for crafting groups you don't have recipes under are no longer shown.
Dynamic Events: The Event UI has been updated to better show Regional Contribution Certificates you've earned and how they impact your event rewards.

Dynamic Events: Selecting a Dynamic Event icon from the HUD will now open the event details window for the respective event. For events with multiple turn-in locations, clicking on the respective icons will pan the map to where the exchange location is.
Rune Book: When obtaining a rune and it does not level up, the system message shown now includes the rune's current Growth Points and amount required for a guaranteed level.
Inventory: The 'Unequip from All Equipment and Stats Sets' option can now be used on gear directly from the Inventory
HUD: Added Regional Contribution Certificates to the list of currencies in the on-screen tracker, and removed Mystic Keys.
Guild Distribution: Adjusted the alignment of the member list in the Guild Distribution UI to make it easier to find the list of people selected for distribution.
Vanguards: Dead party member health bars no longer appear as full.
Vanguards: Players who take damage while in another instance no longer appear to have zero health.
Morph: The icon for the Swim Morph Tide Tsarca in the Morph menu is now more consistent with the morph's appearance.
Chat: 'Viewer Transparency' setting should now affect more than just the primary chat window.
Chat: Attempting to use chat while under a chat restriction no longer displays the error message in Korean.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.7.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 23 and last approximately 8 hours. Based on completion of additional maintenance tasks this week, the downtime may end significantly earlier. From April 24 through April 30, the Loot Goblin Festival event will descend upon Solisium. Golden Goblins have recently pulled off a successful vault heist. If you catch them, their spoils can be yours!
Find the full list of changes, including bug fixes listed below.

Golden Goblins and Golden Goblin Chiefs will spawn randomly throughout the world, including in recently added Talandre zones. Golden Goblin Chiefs have been entrusted with particularly large quantities of Sollant from the Goblins' stash.
A system message will appear when a goblin spawns — so keep an eye out.

Hunting Golden Goblins can reward enterprising adventurers with a title, playful morph, Adventure Coin: Loyalty, Runes, Artifacts, Growthstones, Sollant, and occasionally Tier 2 and Nebula item drops!
UI: Moved the 3-Star Weapon rewards to the top of the Expected Rewards list in co-op Dungeon menus, rather than the bottom.
UI: Hall of Illusion: Moved the accessory rewards to the top of the Expected Rewards list rather than at the bottom.
Items - Grayeye's Bloodlust Greatsword: Fixed a text error in the description of Grayeye's Vitality, which stated "Base damage increases by 16%" instead of "Base damage increases by 16."
Cooking: Roast Honey Apple is back on the menu.
Controller: Fixed an issue causing all Pins to be removed when switching between mouse/keyboard and controller.
Items - Argent Justice Headpiece: Fixed the eye color not matching the color of dye used when dyeing this cosmetic.
Items - Forward General's Cloak: Corrected this item appearance so it no longer duplicates the Cloak of Accuracy.
Items - Cloak of Frozen Expanse: Fixed this item not being listed for crafting at the Armor Crafter.
Localization: Fixed an issue occasionally causing Korean text to display in the Guild skills menu.
Localization - Brazilian Portuguese: Fixed an issue causing "plus que" to appear in front of every number while playing in Brazilian Portuguese.
Addressed several client crash issues to increase stability.
Items: Bercant's Steelstring Bow: Fixed an issue causing some values to be swapped in description of Limuny's Last Shot.
Performance: Fixed the client hitching when entering the cave in the Doomrot Grove 3-Star Dungeon.
Daggers - Cleaving Moonlight: Increased Cleaving Moonlight's cast distance to 4m.
Daggers - Shadowy Strike: Fixed an issue preventing the Shadowy Escape Specialization from moving players back to the casting location.
Sword and Shield - Piercing Strike: Fixed an issue allowing Piercing Strike's cooldown to immediately reset each time it was used when Counter Barrier and Gerard's Precision were active.
Crossbow - Mother Nature's Protest: Adjusted the description text to make it clear that the Mana Cost Efficiency stat does not impact its usage mana cost.
Sword and Shield: Annihilation Blade: Fixed an issue causing the Power Breach Mastery effect to not activate when Annihilation Blade was used.
Greatsword: Cold Warrior: Adjusted the skill description to state "Hit Chance" in place of "Heavy Attack Chance".
Wand: Warrior's Gambit: Adjusted the text to make it clear the Base Damage is increased by 25% of the healing that was received by Noble Revival, not a flat 25% Base Damage increase.
Daggers: Camouflage Cloak: Adjusted the skill description to make it clear that Stealth is removed upon attacking another player, not when being attacked.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.6.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on April 16 and last up to 8 hours. Based on completion of additional maintenance tasks this week, the downtime may end significantly earlier! It includes dyeable weapon skins, new Solo Dungeon bosses, and more. Find the full list of changes listed below.

notes.title: A word from the Breezeline Management Association

items.text: Herba Village: Adjusted voice lines from Breezline Manager Haize to reduce repetitive announcements. Don't worry. If you're in the Resistance, it's still free.
Hall of Illusion difficulty tiers have been reduced to three tiers from five.
New Hall of Illusion bosses have entered the rotation! Verence and Marta make their first appearances on April 17.

This new set of Hall of Illusion bosses offer Nebula Island necklaces and belts as possible rewards. Ring and bracelet accessories will return to the potential drop table when the prior set of bosses return!

Perhaps you love that weapon skin, but wish it came in a different color? Stylish Solisians rejoice; we're adding the ability to dye your weapons through the Mirror Boutique. While not every weapon skin will be dyeable right away, we'll add more to this system over time.

notes.title: Several lines of weapon skins are now dyeable, including

items.text: Stormcaller Weapons
Abyssal Weapons
Sanguine Weapons
Fortunate Weapons
Add more flair to your outfits with stylish new print patterns that can be used in various Mirror Boutique outfit customizations.
Dimensional Trials: Matchmaking Reward boxes have been temporarily removed from Dimensional Trial completion rewards and will return in a future update.
3-Star Dungeon Weapons have been added to the dungeon reward pool. These weapons are now also obtainable from the All Things Merchant.
Nebula Island event schedule now runs off of server region time, aligning boss and other event times to the same day of the week for all regions.
Dimensional Trials: Chapel of Madness, Halls of Tragedy: Fixed collision adjustments in the boss arenas to prevent players from attacking without retaliation.
Bosses: Dominion and Guild vs. Guild bosses now give higher Activity Point values, and Peace mode bosses give slightly less.
Field Boss: Fixed an issue causing Daigon to not reset appropriately when attacked from higher terrain while no other targets were present.
Combat - Wand - Blessed Barrier: Fixed an issue causing the Duration Increased Specialization to not function if used on a player that does not have the same Specialization active.
Weapon Mastery: Significantly improved the text descriptions on several Weapon Mastery nodes to better convey their functionality.
Battle Pass: Increased the quantity of Abundance Fruit and Mastery Report received from the Abyssal Star Battle Pass Shop.
Exploration Codex: Adjusted the Torture Chamber of Screams codex requirements to be achievable with prior changes to dungeon mechanics.
Exploration Codex: Chapter 3: Fixed an issue preventing players from interacting with the NPC required for "Guard the Starlight Observatory Ruins."
Combat: Increased Training Dummy health values to keep up with increased player damage output.
Combat: Fixed a case where custom outfit colors could revert to default when using certain skills.
Guardians: Fixed an issue allowing Feral Wolfer Aranka's Song of the Wild effect to be permanently active.
Morphs: Fixed an issue causing the Armored Diatrima Dash Morph to not be shared across all characters on an account.
Guilds: Fixed an issue preventing Guild Tags from being added or edited.
Cosmetics: Fixed an issue causing the Darkfire Ember and Lucid Weapon Skins to appear incorrectly.
Material Transmutation: Fixed an issue causing materials to be selected when using the rarity filters in Material Transmutation.
Fixed an issue causing the stats displayed for various equipment pieces to not match the actual stats granted. Most of these were Rare Tier 2 items.
Fixed an issue that prevented players from crafting the Crown of Icebound Infinity.
Fixed an issue causing the Black Anvil Passion weapon buff to increase the Sollant Bonus by a different amount each time it was equipped.
Synch: Fixed an issue causing equipment to become temporarily untradeable after being Synched to another gear piece.
UI - Material Transmutation: Combined the weapon, armor, and accessory tabs into a single equipment section.
UI: Fixed an issue where the Resurrection button would disappear after opening and closing another fullscreen UI.
Vanguards: Added new nameplate colors to better distinguish members of your own and other parties within a Vanguard.
Vanguards: Fixed an issue causing the health bars within the Vanguard UI to flicker and display incorrect HP values.
Controller: Fixed an issue preventing the Settings menu from being navigated while having a Fishing Rod equipped and aimed at a body of water.
Controller: Fixed an issue causing the skill target preview area to be shown on the left or right of a target instead of directly on them.
Runes: Fixed an issue causing Korean text and the incorrect Runes to be shown when previewing another player's weapons.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY update 2.4.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on April 2 and last approximately 3.5 hours. It includes a new system to manage your runes, adjustments to Guild and Riftstone Boss loot, and more. Find the full list of changes listed below.
A new Rune Book UI has been added to the Item section of the Main Menu.

Instead of obtaining multiple copies of each rune as an item, obtaining runes now unlocks and levels up a single unified entry in the Rune Book UI - these unified basic Rune can be equipped to multiple items at once. Chaos Runes can only be equipped to one item at a time.
Rune Synergies have been simplified by removing the various quality tiers and providing a single maximized Synergy benefit for each rune color combination.
The Rune listings allow you to search, favorite, and filter through the list of your available Runes.
When selecting an item to modify equipped runes, the rune list will only show runes that are eligible to equip to that item type.
Drag and drop Runes from your collection list to the Item's unlocked Rune slots in the top section of the UI to equip Runes to an item.
The rune list now displays the level, stat benefit, and stat value of each collected rune along with a progress bar that displays along the bottom of each Rune entry.
This progress bar acts as a Rune leveling progress guarantee; now when you receive Runes of the same level as the one you have collected, this progress bar increases until it fills.
Once filled, that rune will increase to the next level; setting a maximum amount of times, you can receive an individual rune of the same level before receiving a rune level increase.
Chaos Runes: A maximum of 100 Chaos Runes can be stored in the Rune UI. Chaos Runes you don't intend to use can be deleted from the list, freeing up a slot.
Rune Fragments will no longer be able to be acquired, and any existing rune fragments in your inventories or storage will eventually be removed!

Adjusted the loot drop tables for Talandre Guild Raid and Riftstone bosses (Daigon, Leviathan, Pakilo Naru, Manticus Brothers) to include a guaranteed T2 Armor or Accessory drop on each kill in addition to the current drop pools.
Material Transmutation: Implemented options to auto-add designated material types and grades to your Material Transmutation progress.
Material Transmutation: Added the ability to split stacks of items with Shift-Left Click when adding items to Material Transmutation.
Material Transmutation: Bulk-adding materials now selects up to 300 eligible items, increased from the previous cap of 20 at a time.
Dimensional Trial: Fixed an issue preventing groups from posting Party Board recruitment above Tier 1 for Dimensional Trials.
Added the option to copy skill and specialization presets to a new preset for editing as an alternative to creating skill presets from a blank state.
Skill presets can now also be pasted as a chat link that allows others to copy the preset skill and specialization contents.

Replaced Rare Rune chests with Epic Rune chests for the following reward types: Dimensional Trials, Weekly Missions, Arena Coin shop, Abyss dungeons, World Bosses, Guild Raids, and Material Transmutation. Items: Removed Epic Tier 2 and Tier 1 equipment drops from basic zone population mobs.
Adjusted the crafting menu for items like Skill Books to enable you to combine component ingredients that have multiple substitutes into a single craft.
Herba Village: Added Arena Sundries Merchant to the available town NPCs.
Guilds: Tax Deliver, Siege, and Interserver Riftstone and Boonstone award distribution can now be distributed unevenly when distributing to all members, not just participants.
Gate of Infinity, Taedal's Tower: Added the ability to move to other floors without exiting the dungeon.
Targeting: Added an option to target nameplate settings to prevent nameplate transparency being applied to targets who are actively attacking you.
Siege: Small adjustments to the defense area boundaries to teleport out non-defenders from walls at the start of a Siege.
Arena: Fixed a situation where some food buffs that should be removed on Arena entry were not being removed properly.
Nebula Island: Removed some ceiling clutter from the boss arena that interfered with viewing angles.
Nebula Island: Fixed an issue where Grimturg's attack pattern could behave unexpectedly when its aggro target was at a distance.
Guild Raid: Fixed boss reset behavior for Pakilo Naru.
Character: Wind indicators on your character are now hidden during cutscenes and interaction camera views.
Added checkpoints to Hall of Illusion levels to allow players to take breaks between fights.
Molgras: Fixed an issue where Molgras could occasionally teleport outside of the attackable area.
Molgras: Festive Trees now respawn 10 seconds after Molgras returns to the center of the arena.
Hall of Illusion: Lionhead: Fixed an issue that could cause the Zone of Pain effect to apply even though your interaction was interrupted.
War Games: Added a display of which weapons members of the team are currently using to better inform team-making strategy.
War Games: Can now edit the display name of War Game Lobbies.
War Games: Minor adjustment to the color displayed for Yellow Team to avoid overlap with the yellow used for Friendly guilds.
Chained damage or healing now displays as an increasing floating damage number that sums up the total damage or healing done rather than separate numbers for each hit.
HUD: Added setting to enable/disable Item Acquisition popup messages.
Weapon Specialization: Added shortcuts to open material containers in your storage for material costs needed to unlock Weapon Specialization nodes.
Adjusted the Hall of Illusion reward popup to clarify the rewards can only be claimed once.
Guild Menu: Adjusted display of Friendly guilds in the Guild info UI.
Added HUD shortcuts for Amitoi House and Fishing mode that can be arranged within the UI.
Currency display: Removed outdated event coins that had zero-quantities from token lists in the UI.
Items: Minor adjustments to the display of Lithograph information when viewing item tooltip details.
Controller: Made multiple adjustments to UI windows for controller focus areas and window priority.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.3.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on March 26 and last approximately 4.5 hours. Race to the finish in the Starbloom Festival event, claim your leaderboard spot in the new Dimension Trial and Arena season, and look forward to new Arch Bosses.
Find the full list of changes, including various bug fixes listed below, plus the latest episodes of Tico Talks and Eye on Solisium.
Set aside some time for Tico. This month's episode covers gear distribution, guild vs guild and dominion mode bosses, solo dungeon difficulty, trait resonance, and more.

Catch up with Publishing Producer godspeed for the latest on all things THRONE AND LIBERTY: Wilds of Talandre. Let us know your answer to this month’s community question. With the new Weapon Mastery and Artifact Systems, will you try different weapon combinations? If so, which weapons and why?

Race to the finish when the Starbloom Festival event blossoms across Solisium on March 27 through April 16. Event-only morph races, unique prizes like the Rainbewe sheep morph, seasonal delicacies, and festive village decorations await. Spring cosmetics, including the Blossom outfit and Alluring weapon skins will also be available. Check out our event announcement for additional details on Morph races, rewards, and more.

notes.title: New Dimensional Trial and Arena Season

items.text: The next season of Arena and Dimensional Trials starts after maintenance. Triumph in either endgame activity for unique morphs, titles, and other desirable rewards. Even if you fall short of your goal during one round, failure is sometimes the best lesson for improvement. Another effective way to get better is through these tips from Twitch Creators NorgannonHH and Grenton.
Topple new Arch Bosses like Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy for unique rewards on your way to the throne.

Long ago Deluzhnoa, a Lightbringer Society wizard, harnessed Quietis' Heart to stop the Shadowmancers invading Einar Temple. However, using this forbidden power sent her into a frenzied state, and she was transformed into a monstrous being. She has been encased in frozen armor and wields a colossal icy spear, and will pose a challenging threat.
The first Deluzhnoa Arch Boss battle will take place on March 29.

A tiny poisonous mushroom spore landed on a fragment of Sylaveth's Star, absorbing ritual energy and mana before transferring its consciousness to another spore. This spore infected a Chief Mitran seed on Mount Snowburn, taking control of its host and absorbing ambient mana to grow tremendously strong. The resulting creature, known as the Giant Cordy, has been linked to numerous disappearances in the Snowburn District.
The first Giant Cordy Arch Boss battle will take place on April 2.
Added the ability to use Party Matchmaking to form Dimensional Trial groups, accessed through the Co-Op Dungeon > Dimensional Trial tab.
Dimensional Trials now drop Epic Runes and have received additional loot table updates!

Added new Victory Rewards for Arena matches that award Tier 2 Tokens and potentially other items based on your Arena Ranking. The number of Victory Rewards you can claim is limited and recharges over time, similar to the Dimensional Contract Token system.

Arena Coins that are part of Weekly Objective rewards have been replaced with new Arena Coins: Flames for rewards as well as purchasing currency in the Arena Shop. Existing Arena Coins will expire during this maintenance.
Anonymized the names of Arena opponents on the matchmaking and mid-match screens. Opponent names will be displayed on the Results popup at the end of matches.
Field Boss: As of 3/20, Dominion bosses now slowly lose HP over time after 20 minutes have passed, until they reach 10% HP remaining.
With the addition of this change, the previous 30% HP reduction to overall Dominion boss HP has been removed.
Arch Bosses: Reduced the preparation phase after entering an Arch Boss portal to 1 minute from 5 minutes.
Arch Bosses: With the unlock of Arch Boss fights for Deluzhnoa and Giant Cordy, their respective Fragment items may now be obtained from Amitoi Expedition and Fishing reward pouches.

Bosses: Guild Portals now attempt to matchmake earlier than Dominion or Peace portals at the 3 minute mark, allowing players who fail to find a Guild portal match additional time to participate in one of the other modes.
World: Adjusted a piton in Bercant Manor that could appear to be floating in midair at lower graphic settings.
Cooking: Grilled Crown Fish: Added Solisium Carp as an eligible fish ingredient for this recipe.
Twisted Laboratory: Kaiser Crimson: Added numbers to the Fear overhead visual effect.
Items: Added tooltip indicators for items that can be acquired through Dissolving.
Items: Increased item stack limits for Potions and Food items.
Items: Poultry-type cooking ingredients have been consolidated to a unified Bland Meat ingredient.
Targeting: Adjusted Tab-Target picking to hopefully improve the logic of targets chosen based on proximity and direction from your character.

Improved Hall of Illusion rewards by replacing Rare tier runes with Epic tier (purple) runes, artifacts, and replacing the Tier 1 Equipment Chest with Tier 2 Tokens. Tier 5 has a chance of dropping Nebula Island accessories.
Adjusted boss HP and damage output to reduce overall difficulty of Tier 1 and 2.
Added the ability for players to trigger a life-steal effect during Tier 1 through 4 to increase self-healing opportunities.
Umbrakan: Adjusted defensive skill timing for Tier 5 to better reflect Tier 1-4.
Umbrakan: Slightly increased the time available before Umbrakan uses its execution skill in Tier 5.
Umbrakan: Changed the execution skill used by Umbrakan in Tier 1-4 to deal damage instead of instant death.
Deadly Marker: Cooldown reduction effect no longer stacks, even if multiple Deadly Markers are applied to the target.
Deadly Marker: No longer affected by Evasion. Deadly Marker can still miss based on Weaken Resistance. Added Weaken tag to the Deadly Marker tooltip.
Zephyr's Nock: Added additional 20% damage vs NPC targets effect.
Decisive Sniping, Decisive Bombardment: Increased damage bonus against NPC targets from 60% to 85%.
Brutal Arrow: Added additional 100% damage vs NPC targets effect.
Strafing: Increased damage bonus against NPC targets from 15% to 25%.
Curse Explosion: Improved hit area detection for instant damage.
Auction House: Moved Lithograph auction listings to their own category.
Swapped the order of Equipment Sync and Combat Settings buttons on the Character window.
HUD: Added the ability to hide certain UI elements from the Edit HUD customization.
UI: Added icon indicators for a target's species type (Humanoid, Construct, Wildkin, etc) to the target UI.
UI: Additional highlighting on the Target-of-Target nameplates to improve indication of these sub-targets.
Ornate Coin Shop: Replaced missing text descriptions on several items.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.2.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (5:30 a.m. UTC) on March 19 and last approximately 6 hours. It includes various fixes for Dimensional Trial season rewards, boss reset behavior, and more. Find the full list of changes listed below.
Additional Dimensional Trial season reward titles will be sent out during this maintenance for characters who were missed in the March 13 maintenance.
Party Matchmaking

Fixed recent issues related to party matchmaking that caused party members to be placed into separate instances, and prevented claiming of the random matchmaking rewards even after rejoining the rest of the formed party.
Nebula Island: Several Rift Fracture mobs now use the party contribution system to determine item drops.
Contribution will be determined by the efforts of the entire party. Once an item drop has been assigned to a party, all party members have an equal chance of receiving the item.
Combat Settings: Added new Target-of-Target and Target-of-Other-Player display options to the UI that appear below the current Target bar.
Vanguards: Designated Party leaders can now properly place party target markers.
Weapon Mastery: Added the ability to Alt-Click on Mastery skills to link them in the chat window.
Weapon Mastery: Staff: Flame Discipline: Adjusted the auto-firing behavior from this Mastery ability.
Weapon Mastery: Staff: Burning Ripple: This will now properly affect other players in PvP.
Bow: Deadly Marker: Fixed an issue causing Deadly Marker to not grant cooldown reduction in some cases while on higher ground.
Artifacts: The 'Ruling Demon' set bonus should now properly grant 6% Shield block chance.
Adventure Codex: Added retry buff mechanics to several elite boss fights encountered throughout the story quests.
Adventure Codex: Fixed an issue that caused stat debuffs to remain applied after completing a story instance.
Adventure Codex: 'Hidden Treasure in the Waterfall' now correctly rewards an Artifact Chest.
World: Adjusted the placement of a piton near Deluzhnoa Temple to make it easier to use.
Bosses: Improved boss reset behavior for Nirma and Minezerok.
Morph: Totem Ursa is now available account-wide.
Gamepad: Removed the default reverse-direction behavior from the L2 stick and added the ability to customize this behavior in the Gamepad preferences.
Audio: King Khazaizin: Fixed a set of Korean language audio lines.
Gamepad: Fixed an issue causing party members to incorrectly display Party Leader icons on the Gamepad party UI.
Chat: Added new chat stickers including numbers 0-9 and a Spear visual.
UI: Added a button to navigate to the Skill menu from the Weapon Mastery window.
Items: Corrected some Tier 2 equipment tooltips that were missing links to view their trait extract listings on the Auction House.
Items: Fixed some Tier 2 items incorrectly displaying as available from the Contract Coin Merchant.
Console: Cutscenes: Updated some low-resolution textures causing Helpie to be less expressive than usual.
Ornate Coin Shop: Replaced missing text descriptions on several items.
Fixed several additional minor UI interaction and focus related bugs related to new features.
Thanks for your support! We'll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 2.1.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on March 12 and last approximately 7.5 hours. It includes Nebula Island, Artifacts, new solo dungeon bosses, and new 3-Star Dungeons. Find the full list of changes listed below, plus a guide on our new features from GrobsXO.

“For me, one of the biggest highlights of Talandre is Nebula Island and the Artifact System,” GrobsXO said. ”If you’re into PvP and love tweaking your character’s build, you're going to love these updates.”

Nebula Island is a new interserver activity accessible to level 55 players through the Secret Dungeons' Lawless Wilds tab. Players can spend up to 5 hours per week there, with additional time available through Nebula Charge Stones.

The island consists of a central village and six distinct regions, including one peaceful zone and four war zones where PvP is always enabled. Players can access various hunting grounds through portals in the central village and collect Lesser and Greater Nebula Stones to exchange for items. The island features hourly events and periodic field boss battles with limited participation capacity. A new exclusive accessory system called Artifacts has also been introduced specifically for Nebula Island content.
Redefine your playstyle through unique skills with Artifact item sets. Artifacts can be obtained from Nebula island and Abyss Dungeons in Talandre.

The system consists of six parts: four Talistones, a Solarstone, and a Lunarstone, each with unique stats and effects. There are 14 different Artifact sets across three grades (2 Common, 4 Uncommon, and 8 Rare), with some stats being randomly determined upon acquisition. Players can trigger set bonuses by equipping 2, 4, or 6 matching pieces from the same set. The Solarstone provides an Active Skill while the Lunarstone grants a Passive Skill when equipped.
Conquer new solo dungeon bosses like Umbrakan and Lionhead for unique rewards on your way to the throne.
Umbrakan

The ferocity of a beast, the intelligence of a human, and the vitality of a great tree. This grotesque being hid in the forest to eat small animals and insects for nutrients. However, after absorbing the mana from a human wizard, it began hunting humans. Now it casts illusions to slaughter intruders.
Lionhead

The Arkeum subjected Demian, a child born between a demon and a human, to intense training, including mana infusions from the Abyssal Meteor. Demian achieved remarkable feats on the battlefield. However, upon seeing blood he caused excessive slaughter. His steel lion helmet became a symbol of death and terror.

Norn Bercant was kidnapped by the Crimson family and turned into a ferocious, mutated creature. With a power as immense as her deep grudge, she created Doomrot Grove, a secluded garden cut off from the outside world.
Bioweapons leaked out of the Crimson family’s lab and killed most people in the manor. The mystery of Kaiser Crimson’s survival remains. Those who discovered the truth have taken it to their grave.
We now support raids (multi-party groups) of up to 8 parties and 48 players.
Vanguards can be created through the Party Management window.
The player who first forms the raid becomes the initial Vanguard Leader, and can transfer the role later.
Vanguard Leaders can adjust party composition or remove members from the vanguard.
Vanguard Leaders may also set join conditions such as 'Guild Members Only','Allied Guilds Only', or open-entry.
Various content can be completed while in Vanguards with some exceptions.
You cannot join party-based instances such as Dungeons or Dimensional Trials while in a vanguard.
Field Boss instances are also unavailable for entry as a vanguard.
If a player enters a Dominion event they will be removed from the vanguard.
Entering Siege or Tax Delivery events as a vanguard will remove all members not in the Vanguard Leader's guild from the parties.
New targeting features have been added to Settings > Gameplay > Character > Large Scale Combat Mode.
When Large Scale Combat Mode is activated, an effect is added that emphasizes the target's nameplate more.
Additional options are available in this new setting menu to customize your targeting experience:
Character nameplate transparency
Non-target character nameplate transparency
Target color adjustments
An additional new option has been added to Settings > Gameplay > UI > HUD to adjust the size of the vertical target indicator line that appears on the nameplate of targeted characters.
Ranking rewards from Dimensional Trial Season 1 will be distributed after this maintenance, to characters who had eligible scores prior to Server Consolidation. Check your mail to receive these!

All Talandre field bosses will have their health nerfed by 30% to account for those struggling to kill them in guild vs guild and dominion events. This is a temporary measure and a permanent feature will arrive in a future update.

Reduced wait time at the start of Field Bosses: Party formation portals will continue to remain open for 5 minutes, while the Boss preparation time after parties have entered the instance has been reduced to 1 minute, down from 5 minutes.
Field Boss: Daigon: The boss will now reset properly when the last player dies during his leap phase.
Field Boss: Fixed an issue that caused allied players to appear as targetable during Dominion or Peace Field Boss events.
Battle Pass: Fixed an issue where the "Craft 3 Uncommon or higher equipment items" mission would not complete after 3 successful crafts.
Battle Pass: Abundance Fruit and Weapon Mastery Book items now have a 30 minute effect duration when consumed.
Unfortunately, Golem shapeshifts acquired while on the quest 'When the Day Comes' will now have to remain in the quest area and may not go on adventures to boss fights or other world locations.
PvP: Adjusted the Fonsine's Blessing timers for respawn locations used during Siege and Tax Delivery.
Cooking: Fixed several instances of incorrect utility buff icons on craftable food items.
The opening Talandre cutscene now only plays automatically once when entering the game after the Talandre update.
Black Anvil Forge: Fixed an issue that caused team colors to not display when re-entering the Dominion event in Black Anvil Forge.
Console: Fixed several issues related to automatic party matchmaking for Dominion bosses on consoles.
Fixed an issue that caused healing reduction effects between Meteor and Focused Fire Bombs to stack to excessive values.
Fixed an issue that prevented the following combat abilities from firing successfully when using the auto-move to target settings. Affected abilities:
Greatsword: Devastating Smash, Guillotine Blade
Dagger: Inject Venom (Secondary Ability), Frenzied Sword Dance
Spear: Death From Above
Bow: Zephyr's Knock, Ensnaring Arrow, Strafing, Deadly Marker
Crossbows: Quick Fire, Recoil Shot, Weak Point Shot
Wand: Cursed Nightmare, Time for Punishment, Ray of Disaster
Fixed an issue that caused enemies to continue to spawn after the completion painting appeared.
Adjusted a water height that caused players to drop out of swim morph in the Waterways section of Hall of Illusion.

Fixed multiple mismatches between English voiceover and in-game subtitles in the Talandre Adventure Codex. Additional subtitle polishing will continue to address remaining mismatch issues in future updates.
Updated Weapon Mastery description tooltips across multiple skills to better reflect their functional behavior.
Party Window: Fixed the display of the controller version of the party menu that showed all members with the Party Leader icon.
Field Bosses: Updated text to fix Korean strings being displayed on Field Boss reward UI.
Ring Menu: No longer displays unacquired Emotes or Morphs when customizing the ring menu.
Characters below level 55 should no longer be able to access the Hall of Illusion UI when using a controller.
Players will no longer be blocked from leaving the Lithograph menu when using a controller.
Thanks for your support! We’ll see you in Solisium.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.15.0 downtime will begin at 10:30 p.m. PT (6:30 a.m. UTC) on February 12 and last approximately 6 hours. It includes the start of the Solisium Valentine's Day event. Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below.

notes.title: Free Server Transfer Period Begins - Server Consolidation

items.text: Following maintenance on February 13 PT, all players will be able to purchase one free server transfer per character from the in-game shop. Transfer cooldowns will be reset for all characters and temporarily reduced to 72 hours. Players may choose to transfer to any eligible server during this period.

At the end of the free-transfer period on February 27 PT, all characters remaining on consolidation servers will be transferred automatically to the new destination server. No manual action is required. Character transfer cooldowns will also be reverted back to the standard 30 days.
Check out our Server Consolidation announcement for more details.

notes.title: Bonus Buffs and Items - Server Consolidation

items.text: All characters on all servers will receive the following buffs for the duration of the open transfer period from February 13 PT until February 27 PT:
Sollant Buff: Gain 20% more Sollant from hunting monsters.
Mastery Buff: Gain 50% more Mastery experience from defeating mobs in Abyss Dungeons when Abyssal Tokens are consumed.
Training Dew: Receive 50% more Training Dew from sources that reward it.: Example: If a Contract normally awarded 4 Dew, you would receive 6 Dew during this Event.
Log in daily for additional bonus awards granted through the daily login event running through February 27 PT.
As a token of our appreciation, please enjoy some seasonal crafted recipes, daily login rewards, and event vendor rewards in honor of Valentine's Day through February 26!
After maintenance, the Violetta's Star Battle Pass will come to an end, and the new Ember's Star Battle Pass begins!
Reminder! Season One of Arena and Dimensional Trials will come to an end at the start of maintenance on February 26.
PvP: Assist points are now granted to healers when party members they have healed successfully defeat other players.
Items: Many common items have had their stack sizes increased to a limit of 10,000.
1-Star Dungeons: Boss rewards for completing 1-Star dungeons can now be opened 3 times at the end of the run for increased rewards.
Guilds: Expired Guild Alliance requests no longer block guilds from sending a new Alliance request in the future.
Arena: Corrected the Imperator rank requirement to 2,200 points.
Arena: Fixed an issue preventing players from starting 3v3 Friendly Arenas.
Parties: Fixed an issue on consoles where parties may not form after accepting system-level party invites.
Combat: Auto-Move within range to use beneficial skills setting should now work properly with the Bow's Healing Touch and Purifying Touch, as well as Greatsword's Blood Devotion.
Players can now use Special Resistance Medals to craft Polished Crystals and Training Dew at the Sundries Crafter.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.14.0 downtime will begin at 10:30PM PT (6:30AM UTC) on February 5 and last approximately 11.5 hours while we merge the auction house. Check out our server consolidation article for more details on the auction house merge. This update also marks the end of the Lunar Celebration festivities. Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below.
Season One for both Arena and Dimensional Trials will come to an end at the start of maintenance on February 26.
Mouse and Keyboard input devices are now supported for console players.
Arch Boss:
Tevent: Fixed an unintended Peace location that could be accessed during War mode Tevent to gain contribution without being attackable.
Vendors: Fixed an issue causing NPC vendor tax rate to be set to 40% instead of 20%.
Arena: Removed the stat cap that was erroneously applied to non-ranked Arena matches.
Culinary Contracts: Returned food items to the pool of Culinary Contract rewards.
Dagger: Block Blade: Fixed an issue that gave the character a movement speed increase when blocking a Fury attack skill while stationary.

Greatsword: Ascending Slash: Fixed an issue that prevented players from being knocked prone after being put to Sleep with the Wand’s Cursed Nightmare skill when the Deep Sleep Specialization was active.
Lunar Celebration: Event items that displayed an incorrect expiration date of February 18 now properly show February 13, the same date that the Event NPC exchange shop expires.
Items: Spears may now be obtained from the Precious Blessing Pouches purchased from the Arena Merchant.
Items: Amitoi received for linking an AG ID account are now account-wide instead of character-specific.
Changes have been made to the following spawn buff durations:
Respawn at a Resurrection Location - 30s
Respawn via the Instant Resurrection Guild Skill - 3s
Teleport using the Guild Summon Gate - 3s
For Castle Siege, all protection buffs are removed when entering the courtyard leading into the throne room.
Fixed an issue causing players to occasionally be disconnected when opening various inventory windows.
Fixed an issue preventing display of crafting NPC icons on the minimap in all cities during a Siege event.
Debug/Placeholder text is no longer shown when using the "Unequip from All Equipment and Stats Set" option on gear from the Character Info menu.

THRONE AND LIBERTY Update 1.13.0 downtime will begin at 9:30PM PT (5:30AM UTC) on January 22 and last approximately 6.5 hours. With festive decorations like a giant cobra statue in every village, the year of the snake has come to Solisium. Find the full list of changes and fixes listed below.
